### [92] [Comparison of Deep Learning Frameworks For Rice Disease Mapping From UAV Multispectral Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06359)
*Yadav Raj Ghimire,Jagrati Talreja,Tewodros Syum Gebre,Timothy Agboada,Shikha V. Chandel,Leila Hashemi Beni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 利用CNN和Transformer模型对水稻白叶枯病严重程度进行UAV多光谱影像语义分割，结果表明轻量级CNN（U-Net++/EfficientNet-B3）以97.62% mIoU达到最优性能，植被指数的加入带来小幅但一致的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水稻细菌性白叶枯病（BLB）的精准监测对作物管理至关重要，但现有方法在可操作性、推理速度与分割精度之间难以权衡。此外，缺乏标准化的UAV数据集来公平比较不同病害制图方法。

Method: 使用公开BLB数据集，统一训练流程下评估五种架构：U-Net (ResNet-101)、U-Net++ (EfficientNet-B3/B7)、DeepLabV3+和SegFormer；每种模型测试三种输入配置（纯多光谱、多光谱+NDVI、多光谱+NDRE）；评价指标包括mIoU、mF1、mAcc、Precision和Recall。

Result: U-Net++搭配EfficientNet-B3取得最高性能，mIoU达97.62%；SegFormer分割精度较低但推理速度相当；植被指数的融合在所有模型中均带来小幅但一致性的性能改进。

Conclusion: 轻量级CNN骨干网络在可操作的BLB监测中比Transformer模型更可靠；植被指数作为额外输入通道可稳定提升分割精度；标准化UAV数据集对病害制图方法的比较研究具有重要价值，推荐CNN架构用于田间实际部署。

Abstract: In this study, UAV multispectral imagery is used to segment the severity of bacterial leaf blight (BLB) in rice using convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and transformer-based models. The evaluated architectures include U-Net with a ResNet- 101 encoder, U-Net++ with EfficientNet-B3 and EfficientNetB7, DeepLabV3+, and SegFormer, all trained under a common pipeline with three input configurations (multispectral only, multispectral+NDVI, and multispectral+NDRE). Experiments are conducted using the publicly available BLB dataset with performance reported using mean IoU (mIoU), mean F1 (mF1), mean accuracy (mAcc), precision, and recall. U-Net++ with EfficientNet-B3 achieved the highest performance, with an mIoU of 97.62%. SegFormer obtained lower segmentation accuracy but comparable inference speed. Overall, the results indicate that lightweight CNN backbones remain more reliable for operational BLB monitoring while integration of vegetation indices provides small and consistent improvements. The study also highlights the value of standardised UAV datasets to compare disease mapping methods and encourages the use of CNN architectures for field implementation.

</details>


### [93] [Physics in 2-Steps: Locking Motion Priors Before Visual Refinement Erases Them](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06361)
*Woojung Han,Seil Kang,Youngjun Jun,Min-Hung Chen,Fu-En Yang,Seong Jae Hwang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文揭示扩散模型在图像到视频生成中，随着去噪步数增加，相位信息会显著退化（50步比2步下降约18%），导致物理一致性变差。基于此提出PhaseLock：一种无需训练、从2步推理中提取运动先验并通过Latent Delta Guidance注入高保真生成过程的方法，以6.2点平均提升物理一致性，且几乎不增加计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像到视频扩散模型虽然生成质量高，但常违反物理定律。作者发现反常现象：2步生成比50步生成物理一致性更好。通过频谱分析，定位到去噪过程中相位信息的严重退化是罪魁祸首，而幅度保持相对稳定。这驱动作者寻找一种保留少量步数中有效运动先验的方法。

Method: 提出PhaseLock框架（训练无关）：(1) 使用仅2步推理提取运动先验（相位信息）；(2) 设计Latent Delta Guidance机制，将该运动先验作为约束注入完整去噪轨迹的高保真生成过程中，从而在保持视觉质量的同时纠正相位退化。

Result: PhaseLock在多种模型上将物理一致性平均提升6.2个点，同时基本保持视觉保真度。计算开销极低：仅1.06倍推理时间和1.02倍显存。相比昂贵的外部引导方法（约5倍时间），显著降低了对它们的依赖。

Conclusion: 去噪过程中的相位退化是扩散模型生成物理不一致运动的关键原因。PhaseLock通过从极少数步数中提取并锁定运动先验，以几乎零成本有效缓解该问题，为提升视频生成物理合理性提供了简洁高效的新思路。

Abstract: Image-to-Video diffusion models leverage input images to generate visually stunning content, yet frequently produce motion that violates physical laws. We reveal a surprising finding: a 2-step generation often exhibits better physical consistency than a 50-step output from the same model. Through spectral analysis, we trace this to phase erosion during denoising; the phase degrades significantly (dropping by $\approx 18\%$ from step 2 to step 50), whereas the magnitude remains relatively stable. Building on this insight, we propose PhaseLock, a training-free framework that preserves the valid motion priors from few-step inference throughout the denoising trajectory. Rather than relying on full-step inference for physical consistency, PhaseLock extracts a motion prior from just 2 steps and enforces it onto high-fidelity generation via Latent Delta Guidance. Our approach effectively mitigates phase degradation, improving physical consistency by an average of 6.2 points across diverse models while largely maintaining visual fidelity, with negligible overhead ($1.06\times$ time, $1.02\times$ memory) and reduced reliance on expensive external guidance methods ($\sim5\times$ time).

</details>


### [94] [GMBFormer: An NDVI-Guided Global Memory Bank Transformer for Urban Green-Space Extraction from Ultra-High-Resolution Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06363)
*Hao Lei,Xi Cheng,Chenlu Shu,Zhiheng Chen,Zhengjie Duan,Haoyu Wang,Zhanfeng Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GMBFormer 提出了一种基于 SegFormer 的框架，将 NDVI 解耦为物理引导的门控机制，通过动量更新的全局记忆库实现相似性驱动的原型检索，替代传统的邻域特征传播，在超高分辨率城市绿地提取任务上取得了优于基线 SegFormer-B4 的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前超高分辨率城市绿地提取常采用逐块处理，导致空间上分离但视觉相似的植被模式之间缺乏语义复用；直接将 NDVI 注入 RGB 骨干网络会混淆视觉外观学习与物理植被置信度的角色。

Method: 提出 GMBFormer（基于 SegFormer）：（1）仅 RGB 通道进入骨干网络和解码器；（2）NDVI 被解耦为物理引导门控，通过动量更新将高置信度植被描述符选入紧凑的全局记忆库；（3）训练和推理时，当前图像块通过记忆介导的交叉注意力查询存储的原型，并以有限开销集成检索响应。

Result: 在自建成都 UHR 数据集（7,700 张标注的 512×512 图块）和 ISPRS Potsdam 数据集的两个减标设置下，GMBFormer 分别取得 mIoU/mDice 为 89.25%/94.31%、92.17%/95.92%、83.72%/90.86%，均优于 SegFormer-B4 基线。消融实验表明解耦 NDVI 准入、记忆检索、容量和动量共同塑造最终性能。

Conclusion: 将 NDVI 解耦为物理门控并结合全局记忆库的相似性检索策略，能有效提升超高分辨率城市绿地的语义分割性能，验证了物理先验与学习特征分离协作的可行性。

Abstract: Urban green-space extraction from ultra-high-resolution (UHR) imagery is commonly performed patch by patch, which limits semantic reuse among spatially separated but visually similar vegetation patterns. Directly injecting the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) into red-green-blue (RGB) backbones can also blur the roles of visual appearance learning and physical vegetation confidence. We propose GMBFormer, a SegFormer-based framework that replaces adjacency-driven feature propagation with selective, similarity-driven prototype retrieval. Only RGB channels enter the backbone and decoder, while NDVI is decoupled as a physics-informed gate that admits high-confidence vegetation descriptors into a compact global memory bank through momentum updates. During training and inference, the current patch queries stored prototypes through memory-mediated cross-attention, and the retrieved response is integrated with bounded overhead. Experiments use a self-constructed Chengdu UHR dataset with 7,700 labeled 512 x 512 patches and two reduced-label settings derived from the public International Society for Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing (ISPRS) Potsdam dataset. Under the same training and evaluation protocol, GMBFormer obtains mean intersection over union (mIoU)/mean Dice (mDice) scores of 89.25%/94.31%, 92.17%/95.92%, and 83.72%/90.86%, respectively, improving the controlled SegFormer-B4 baseline in each setting. Ablation studies indicate that decoupled NDVI admission, memory retrieval, capacity, and momentum jointly shape the final performance.

</details>


### [95] [Visual Commonsense Driven Knowledge Refinements for Scene Graph Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06369)
*Maëlic Neau,Salim Baloch,Jakob Suchan,Zoe Falomir,Mehul Bhatt*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种模型无关、语义引导的知识精炼框架，通过从训练数据中挖掘常识约束（空间、功能、定性关系规律），在推理时利用声明式常识推理对场景图生成预测进行修正，无需手工规则和模型重训，可跨数据集与架构迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学习驱动的场景图生成模型在频繁关系类型上表现良好，但在标注稀疏时性能急剧下降，难以捕获可靠的视觉常识知识。需要一种利用结构化常识推理来弥补纯学习方法不足的方案。

Method: 提出模型无关、语义引导的知识精炼框架：(1) 从训练数据中系统挖掘空间、功能、定性三类关系规律作为常识约束；(2) 使用通用声明式常识推理，在推理阶段对排序后的SGG预测进行修正与精炼；(3) 无需手工编写规则，无需模型重训。

Result: 在三个标准基准数据集上，相比强基线方法取得了一致的性能提升。

Conclusion: 基于深度场景语义的结构化视觉常识推理是纯学习式场景图生成的有效且实用的补充手段，具有良好的泛化性和迁移性。

Abstract: Learning-driven Scene Graph Generation (SGG) models excel on frequent relation types but degrade sharply under annotation sparsity, failing to capture reliable visual commonsense knowledge. We propose a model-agnostic, semantically-guided knowledge refinement framework that systematically mines commonsense-grounded constraints from training data - capturing spatial, functional, and qualitative relational regularities - and uses general declarative commonsense reasoning to correct and refine ranked SGG predictions at inference time. The framework requires no manual rule authoring, no model retraining, and transfers across datasets and architectures. On three standard benchmarks, we obtain consistent improvements over strong baselines, demonstrating that structured visual commonsense reasoning over deep scene semantics is a practical and effective complement to purely learning-based scene graph generation.

</details>


### [96] [EasyLens: A Training-Free Plug-and-Play Subtle-Lesion Representation Amplifier for Medical Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06379)
*Qiwei Zeng,Hao Wang,Jinghao Lin,Shuchang Ye,Yuezhe Yang,Yige Peng,Haoyuan Che,Jinman Kim,Lei Bi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EasyLens 是一种无需训练、即插即用的方法，通过病理-解剖原型空间构建、反事实原型推理选择可疑病变区域，以及形态引导的残差增强来放大医学 VLM 中的细微病变表征，从而提升冻结模型对微小病灶的识别能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前医学视觉语言模型对细微病变（视觉证据稀疏、低对比度、嵌入复杂解剖背景）的敏感性不足，原因是局部病变 token 在聚合为全局表征时被稀释。现有方法依赖额外训练或特定模型适配，且可能过拟合特定疾病形态，不适用于冻结的医学 VLM。

Method: 提出 EasyLens，包含三个组件：(1) EasyBank：构建病理-解剖原型空间，提供病变相关原型和解剖感知的正常参考，用于将可疑图像块与病理和正常解剖模式对比；(2) EasyTag：通过反事实原型推理筛选病变相关图像块，避免误放大正常组织；(3) EasyAmplifier：通过形态引导的残差增强强化所选病变相关图像块的表征，提升其在全局图像嵌入中的贡献。

Result: 在多个医学图像数据集和冻结的医学 VLM 骨干网络上，EasyLens 提升了细微病变检测性能，并优于现有的编码器增强基线方法。

Conclusion: EasyLens 作为一种无需训练、即插即用的细微病变表征放大器，有效解决了冻结医学 VLM 对微小病灶不敏感的问题，具有良好的通用性和实用价值。

Abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for clinical image interpretation, including lesion detection and report generation. However, their practical utility remains limited by insufficient sensitivity to subtle lesions, whose visual evidence is often sparse, low-contrast, and embedded within complex anatomical context. As local visual tokens are aggregated, these weak lesion cues can become underrepresented in global image representations, making them difficult for medical VLMs to recognize. Existing efforts to improve lesion sensitivity mainly rely on medical-domain vision-encoder pre-training, clinical-term-guided alignment, or trainable pathological representation enhancement. Although effective, these approaches usually require additional training or model-specific adaptation and may overfit to particular disease morphologies, limiting their applicability to frozen medical VLMs. To address these limitations, we propose EasyLens, a training-free plug-and-play subtle-lesion representation amplifier for medical VLMs. EasyLens first constructs EasyBank, a pathology-anatomy prototype space that provides lesion-related prototypes and anatomy-aware normal references for comparing suspicious patches against both pathological and normal anatomical patterns. To avoid blindly amplifying normal tissues, EasyTag selects lesion-relevant patches through counterfactual prototype reasoning. To counteract the dilution of subtle lesion cues in global image representations, EasyAmplifier strengthens the selected lesion-relevant patch representations through morphology-guided residual enhancement, thereby increasing their contribution to the global image embedding. Experiments on multiple medical image datasets and frozen medical VLM backbones show that EasyLens improves subtle-lesion detection and outperforms existing encoder-enhancement baselines.

</details>


### [97] [HomeWorld: A Unified Floorplan-to-Furnished Framework for Generating Controllable, Densely Interactive Whole-Home Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06390)
*Wenbo Li,Xiaoliang Ju,Zipeng Qin,Rongyao Fang,Hongsheng Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种统一的层次化框架，将室内场景生成分解为可控阶段：首先基于30万真实户型数据训练LLM进行全屋户型生成，然后利用图像生成模型从多层级漫游视角布置家具，再在支撑面上生成小型可操作物体。过程中使用VLM精炼器迭代校正布局，并支持3D生成模型替换资产，最终生成面向具身AI仿真的逼真室内场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂布局与稀缺的3D场景数据使得基于学习的室内场景生成极具挑战。现有方法要么依赖手工规则，要么仅聚焦于孤立子任务（如户型合成或单房间家具布置），导致生成的全屋场景缺乏全局一致性、真实感和仿真可用性。

Method: 提出统一的层次化框架：(1) 构建30万真实住宅户型数据集，训练LLM进行可控全屋户型生成，采用详细文字描述与K-D树表示；(2) 基于生成的户型，利用图像生成模型从多层级漫游视角生成家具布局；(3) 在不同支撑面（柜子、书桌、餐桌等）上生成小型可操作物体布局；(4) 使用VLM精炼器迭代纠正家具和物体摆放；(5) 利用3D生成模型实现资产灵活替换；(6) 附加基础物理属性、简单表面纹理和光照设置，完成具身AI仿真管线。

Result: 实验和用户研究表明，该管线生成的室内空间在布局多样性和3D设计吸引力方面均优于先前方法，在定量和定性指标上均表现更佳。同时将发布户型数据集和5K全装场景。

Conclusion: 该统一层次化框架有效解决了全屋场景生成的全局一致性问题，通过分阶段可控生成结合VLM精炼与3D资产替换，实现了面向具身AI的高质量室内场景合成，为机器人仿真和室内设计提供了有力工具。

Abstract: Indoor scene generation is crucial for robot simulation and modern interior design. However, complex layouts together with scarce 3D scene data make learning-based generation challenging. Existing methods often rely on hand-crafted rules or focus on isolated sub-tasks (e.g., floorplan synthesis or single-room furnishing), producing whole-home scenes that lack global coherence, realism, and simulation readiness. To mitigate these limitations, we propose a unified hierarchical framework that decomposes indoor scene synthesis into controllable stages. First, we curate a large-scale dataset of 300K real residential floorplans to train a large language model for whole-home floorplan generation. With detailed descriptions and a K-D tree-based representation, our method enables fine-grained, controllable whole-home floorplan generation. Building upon the generated whole-home floorplan, we leverage image generation models to draft furniture layouts from multi-level roaming viewpoints, and then generate the layouts of small manipulable objects on different supporting surfaces (e.g., cabinets, desks, and dining tables) for embodied AI simulation. During furniture and object layout generation, a VLM-based refiner iteratively corrects furniture and object placement, and a 3D generative model enables flexible replacement of individual assets. We further attach basic physical attributes and simple surface texture and lighting setups to complete the pipeline for embodied AI use. Experiments and user studies demonstrate that our pipeline produces indoor spaces with greater layout diversity and stronger 3D design appeal, outperforming prior methods on both quantitative and qualitative metrics. Finally, alongside our generation pipeline, we will release the floorplan dataset and 5K fully furnished scenes to the community. Project Page: https://kairos-homeworld.github.io/

</details>


### [98] [A Vision-language Framework for Comparative Reasoning in Radiology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06407)
*Tengfei Zhang,Ziheng Zhao,Lisong Dai,Xiaoman Zhang,Pengcheng Qiu,Ya Zhang,Yanfeng Wang,Weidi Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了实体感知的跨图像比较推理框架MedReCo，通过构建大规模比较影像数据集MedReCo-DB，训练了实体感知视觉编码器用于可控相似病例检索，以及视觉-语言模型MedReCo-VLM用于生成式间隔变化解读，在检索和纵向随访任务上均显著优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前医学影像AI在孤立图像解读上表现优异，但与放射学临床实践严重脱节——实际诊断和随访高度依赖与既往检查和类比参考病例的比较。现有方法缺乏对跨图像比较推理的支持，尤其是对解剖结构、异常发现和病理状况等实体层面的对齐与比较。

Method:  (1) 构建MedReCo-DB数据集：来自8个机构、4个国家、7种影像模态，覆盖16万+患者、69万+图像，将报告分解为解剖结构、异常发现和病理状况三类实体，为实体条件检索和比较式视觉问答提供监督；(2) 提出MedReCo实体感知视觉编码器，支持可控的临床类比病例检索；(3) 扩展为MedReCo-VLM视觉-语言模型，实现生成式间隔变化解读。

Result: MedReCo在全部12项内部检索设置中均取得最高Recall@1，外部检索平均提升6.0个百分点，在临床易混淆鉴别组中持续优于最强基线；MedReCo-VLM在所有比较生成评估中表现最佳，胸片纵向随访准确率提升14.5-46.5个百分点，CT提升13.0-27.9个百分点。

Conclusion: 实体感知的比较推理可从大规模常规临床数据中学习，为医学影像AI提供更贴合临床实践的基础能力。

Abstract: Medical imaging artificial intelligence has achieved strong performance in isolated image interpretation, but remains poorly aligned with radiological practice, where diagnosis and follow-up rely on comparison across prior studies and analogous reference cases. Here we formulate radiological comparison as an entity-aware cross-image reasoning problem and introduce a framework that supports both reference-case retrieval and temporal comparative interpretation. We construct MedReCo-DB, a large-scale comparative imaging resource derived from routine image-report pairs, comprising more than 690,000 images from over 160,000 patients across eight institutions, four countries and seven imaging modalities. Reports are decomposed into anatomical structures, abnormal findings and pathological conditions to provide supervision for entity-conditioned retrieval and comparative visual question answering. Using this resource, we develop MedReCo, an entity-aware visual encoder for controllable retrieval of clinically analogous cases, and MedReCo-VLM, a vision--language extension for generative interpretation of interval change. Across internal, external and cross-center evaluations, MedReCo achieved the highest Recall@1 in all 12 internal retrieval settings and improved external retrieval by a mean of 6.0 percentage points. In clinically confusable differential groups, it consistently outperformed the strongest baselines. MedReCo-VLM achieved the best performance across all comparative generation evaluations and improved longitudinal follow-up accuracy by 14.5-46.5 percentage points on chest radiographs and 13.0-27.9 percentage points on CT. These findings suggest that entity-aware comparative reasoning can be learned from routine clinical data at scale and may provide a more clinically aligned foundation for medical imaging AI.

</details>


### [99] [Thinking with Imagination: Agentic Visual Spatial Reasoning with World Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06476)
*Chenming Zhu,Jingli Lin,Yilin Long,Peizhou Cao,Tai Wang,Jiangmiao Pang,Xihui Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Astra框架，通过让VLM在推理时与一个世界模拟器交互来"想象"新视角的视觉证据，从而增强空间推理能力。Astra包含一个RL训练的VLM策略（Astra-VL）和一个基于Bagel的世界模型（Astra-WM），后者能根据上下文图像和自然语言相机运动生成新视角观测。实验表明，想象观测与智能体策略两者缺一不可，在MMSI-Bench和MindCube上均取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前VLM的空间推理能力局限于观察到的图像和文本链式推理，难以推断未观测到的布局、保持跨视角一致性，以及从有限的自我中心观测中进行多视角推理。作者将此问题定义为"带着想象力思考"（thinking with imagination），即VLM应能主动通过与世界模拟器交互来获取想象的视觉证据。

Method: 提出Astra框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) Astra-VL：基于RL训练的VLM策略，决定何时、何地以及如何调用世界模拟器；(2) Astra-WM：基于Bagel架构的世界模拟器，通过视角一致性调优（view consistency tuning）训练，能根据上下文图像和自然语言描述的相机运动生成新视角观测。在RL阶段，设计了"世界模拟器在环"的两阶段RL课程，第一阶段稳定工具使用探索，第二阶段提升模型仅在想象观测优于直接回答时才调用模拟器的能力。

Result: 在MMSI-Bench上，Astra-WM将模拟器增强的Gemini-3-Flash从45.1提升至49.5；Astra-VL将Qwen3-VL骨干网络从29.8提升至38.8。在MindCube上，Astra-VL将Qwen3-VL从36.8提升至42.7。消融实验表明，世界模拟器和智能体策略两者都是必要的。

Conclusion: 想象的观测能够为空间推理提供有用的视觉证据，但有效的世界模型增强推理需要学习何时、何地以及如何想象。Astra框架通过将动作条件的视觉想象与RL训练的智能体策略相结合，成功实现了这一目标。

Abstract: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong visual reasoning capabilities, their spatial reasoning abilities remain largely constrained to the observed images and text-oriented chain-of-thought. They often struggle to infer unobserved layouts, maintain cross-view consistency, and reason from alternative viewpoints when only limited egocentric observations are available. In this work, we study this problem as thinking with imagination, where a VLM actively acquires imagined visual evidence by interacting with a world simulator during reasoning. We propose Astra, an agentic spatial reasoning framework that empowers VLMs with action-conditioned visual imagination. Specifically, Astra couples Astra-VL, an RL-trained VLM policy, with Astra-WM, a Bagel-based world simulator that generates novel-view observations from context images and natural-language camera motions. To provide reliable imagined evidence, Astra-WM is trained with view consistency tuning to improve pose and content consistency across views. In the RL stage, we propose a world-simulator-in-the-loop two-phase RL curriculum to stabilize tool-use exploration and advance the model's ability to invoke the simulator only when imagined observations improve over direct answering. Experiments demonstrate that both the world simulator and the agentic policy are necessary: Astra-WM improves simulator-augmented Gemini-3-Flash on MMSI-Bench from 45.1 to 49.5, while Astra-VL improves the Qwen3-VL backbone from 29.8 to 38.8 on MMSI-Bench and from 36.8 to 42.7 on MindCube. These results show that imagined observations can provide useful spatial evidence, but effective world-model-augmented reasoning requires learning when, where, and how to imagine.

</details>


### [100] [Complexity-Balanced Diffusion Splitting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06477)
*Noam Issachar,Dani Lischinski,Raanan Fattal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CBS框架基于函数逼近理论和de Boor等分布原则，将扩散时间线按近似负担均等划分，利用Dirichlet能量和轨迹加速度两个监测量估计局部复杂度，通过轻量辅助模型自动分配子网络容量，在多种架构上大幅提升生成质量而不增加推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准连续时间生成模型使用单一架构处理从各向同性噪声到复杂数据分布的整个生成过程。虽然增大模型容量能提升性能，但将大规模网络均匀部署在整个生成时间线上本质上是低效的——不同时间区间的生成难度差异巨大，需要差异化分配表示容量。

Method: 提出Complexity-Balanced Splitting (CBS)框架：(1) 基于de Boor等分布原则，将扩散时间线划分为近似负担相等的若干段；(2) 引入两个互补的监测量来估计局部复杂度——基于流的Dirichlet能量的空间测度，以及基于采样轨迹加速度的几何测度；(3) 使用轻量辅助模型估计这些复杂度分布，无需启发式时间划分或昂贵搜索；(4) 在划分的每个时间段上部署专门的子网络，总容量在各段间非均匀分配。

Result: 在SiT、JiT和UNet等多种架构及数据集上的广泛评估表明，CBS在不增加单步推理成本的前提下持续提升合成质量。特别是SiT-XL配合CFG时，CBS相比朴素时间划分将FID提升约35%。

Conclusion: CBS为连续时间生成模型提供了一种有理论支撑的时间容量分配方案，通过复杂度均衡的时间线划分，以零推理开销实现了显著的生成质量提升，验证了差异化容量分配相比均匀部署的优越性。

Abstract: Standard continuous-time generative models rely on monolithic architectures that must navigate vastly different signal regimes, from isotropic noise to intricate data distributions. While scaling model capacity improves performance, deploying a massive network uniformly across the entire generative timeline is inherently inefficient. In this work, we propose Complexity-Balanced Splitting (CBS), a principled framework for temporal capacity allocation that distributes the generative workload across multiple specialized sub-networks. Grounded in function approximation theory and de Boor's equidistribution principle, CBS partitions the diffusion timeline into segments of equal approximation burden, allocating more representational capacity to regions where the generative dynamics are more difficult to model. To estimate this local complexity, we introduce two complementary and tractable monitor functions: a spatial measure based on the flow's Dirichlet energy, and a geometric measure based on the acceleration of the sampling trajectories. Using a lightweight auxiliary model to estimate these complexity profiles, our approach eliminates the need for heuristic temporal splits or computationally expensive search procedures. Extensive evaluation across multiple architectures (SiT, JiT, and UNet) and datasets demonstrates that CBS consistently improves synthesis quality without increasing per-step inference cost. In particular, CBS improves FID by ~35% on SiT-XL with CFG relative to naive temporal partitioning. Project page is available at https://noamissachar.github.io/CBS/.

</details>


### [101] [PAR3D: A Unified 3D-MLLM with Part-Aware Representation for Scene Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06485)
*Shaohui Dai,Yansong Qu,You Shen,Shengchuan Zhang,Liujuan Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PAR3D，一个统一的部件感知3D多模态大语言模型框架，通过引入ScenePart数据集和层次化分割查询生成，使模型能够同时理解、推理和定位3D场景中的对象及其部件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D-MLLM主要以对象为中心，缺乏对细粒度部件结构的建模能力，而部件级理解对于具身交互等任务至关重要。

Method: (1) 构建ScenePart合成数据集，包含部件级标注和语言指令；(2) 提出部件感知的3D表示学习方法，丰富3D视觉表征中的部件级语义；(3) 设计层次化分割查询生成机制，通过层次化对象-部件查询实现部件目标的定位。

Result: 在部件级问答和指称分割任务上显著提升，同时在对象级视觉语言任务上也保持强劲性能。

Conclusion: PAR3D成功将部件感知能力融入3D-MLLM，为细粒度3D场景理解提供了统一框架，在部件级和对象级任务上均表现优异。

Abstract: Recent advances in 3D multimodal large language models (3D-MLLMs) have enabled unified solutions for 3D scene understanding tasks, including visual question answering, captioning, and referring segmentation. However, existing 3D-MLLMs remain largely object-centric, limiting their ability to model fine-grained part structures that are essential for embodied interaction with 3D environments. In this work, we present PAR3D, a unified part-aware 3D-MLLM framework that enables models to understand, reason about, and ground both objects and their parts in 3D scenes. To enable training and evaluation of part-aware 3D scene understanding, we introduce ScenePart, a synthetic 3D scene dataset with part-level annotations and language instructions. We further develop Part-Aware 3D Representation Learning to enrich 3D visual representations with fine-grained part-level semantics, and propose Hierarchical Segmentation Query Generation to ground part targets via hierarchical object-part queries. Extensive experiments show that our method substantially improves part-level question answering and referring segmentation, while also achieving strong performance across object-level vision-language tasks.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [102] [Epidemiology of Model Collapse: Modeling Synthetic Data Contamination via Bilayer SIR Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05168)
*Xiangyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个双层耦合SIR/SIRS流行病学模型，将数据语料库和AI模型视为两个相互作用的群体，分析合成数据在AI生态系统中的交叉污染问题。模型推导出基本再生数R₀，并通过场景校准、敏感性分析、代理模型验证和GPT-2实验，识别出合成文本检测和群体免疫为最高杠杆的干预策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型崩溃研究仅将合成数据训练视为单链退化过程，忽视了现实AI生态系统中合成数据在不同模型和共享语料库之间的交叉污染现象。作者旨在填补这一空白，提供更符合实际的系统性分析框架。

Method: 作者提出双层耦合SIR/SIRS平均场唯象模型，将数据语料库和AI模型建模为两个交互群体，各自包含易感(S)、感染(I)、恢复(R)三个仓室，通过跨层传播连接。SIRS变体引入免疫力衰减机制。通过下一代矩阵(Next Generation Matrix)推导基本再生数R₀，并进行：(1)基于公开AI文本流行率数据的场景校准；(2)Sobol敏感性分析；(3)二分网络代理模型一致性验证；(4)GPT-2污染链实验(192次运行)；(5)多源混合消融实验(1,088次运行)。

Result: 三个场景的校准均得到超临界动力学(R₀>1)；Sobol敏感性分析表明合成文本检测是最具杠杆效应的参数；代理模型在稠密网络中与平均场模型高度一致(R²>0.96)，但在异质网络中下降；GPT-2实验显示剂量-反应退化模式和多样性损失，与阈值理论定性吻合；多源混合在较高污染比例下可适度缓解崩溃，但在低污染比例下效果消失。

Conclusion: 合成数据污染在AI生态系统中可达到流行阈值以上，构成系统性风险。检测驱动的过滤和群体免疫是最高效的干预策略。多源数据混合的缓解效果有限且依赖于污染比例。该流行病学框架为理解和治理AI生态中的合成数据污染提供了可操作的定量工具。

Abstract: Training on synthetic data causes model collapse, but existing analyses treat this as single-chain degradation. In reality, the AI ecosystem involves cross-contamination: models ingest synthetic data from other models, produce new synthetic text, and contaminate shared corpora. We propose a bilayer coupled SIR/SIRS framework -- a phenomenological mean-field model treating data corpora and AI models as two interacting populations, each with susceptible, infected, and recovered compartments linked by cross-layer transmission. The SIRS variant (our primary recommendation) incorporates immunity waning, reflecting that filtered corpora and retrained models remain susceptible to re-contamination. We derive the basic reproduction number $R_0 = \sqrt{β_D β_M / [(γ_D+μ_D)(γ_M+μ_M)]}$ via the Next Generation Matrix and apply standard epidemic threshold results to the bilayer system. Illustrative scenario-based calibration from public AI text prevalence data yields supercritical dynamics ($R_0 > 1$) across three scenarios; Sobol sensitivity analysis identifies synthetic-text detection as the highest-leverage parameter. A bipartite-network agent-based model confirms mean-field consistency ($R^2 > 0.96$) for dense networks but degrades under heterogeneity. GPT-2 contamination chain experiments (192 runs across WikiText and Shakespeare) show dose-response degradation and diversity loss qualitatively consistent with the threshold picture. Matched-budget source-diversity experiments (1,088 runs) provide suggestive evidence that multi-source mixing modestly attenuates collapse, but the effect vanishes at lower contamination fractions. Intervention analysis identifies detection-based filtering and herd immunity as the highest-leverage strategies.

</details>


### [103] [Predict and Reconstruct: Joint Objectives for Self-Supervised Language Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05173)
*Aimen Boukhari*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合预训练目标，将JEPA风格的潜在空间预测损失与标准MLM目标结合，训练单一共享编码器。在相同计算预算下，混合模型相比纯MLM基线在嵌入均匀性、谱几何、语义-词汇平衡等方面表现更优，但下游线性探测精度相近，表明JEPA目标以标准精度指标无法捕捉的方式重塑了潜在空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLM自BERT以来一直是文本编码器的主流预训练目标，但它促使表征强烈锚定于表面形式的token身份，而非更深层的语义结构。受JEPA在视觉和音频领域成功的启发，作者旨在探索将JEPA风格的潜在空间预测引入文本预训练，以改善编码器的语义表征质量。

Method: 提出一种混合预训练目标：(1) 在单一共享编码器上同时使用JEPA式潜在空间预测损失和标准MLM损失；(2) 引入可学习的标量参数在训练过程中持续平衡两个目标。使用NVIDIA H100在英文Wikipedia上以相同架构和计算预算预训练混合模型和纯MLM基线。通过四种池化策略在五个GLUE基准（SST-2、MRPC、MNLI、CoLA、STS-B）上进行广泛的表征分析。

Result: 混合编码器产生显著更均匀的嵌入（均匀性低于-0.16 vs MLM的-0.05）；在最大池化下展现更丰富的谱几何特性；编码更少的表面词汇信息；实现更好的语义-词汇平衡。尽管下游线性探测精度与MLM基线相似，但几何差异一致且显著。

Conclusion: JEPA预测目标以现有标准精度指标无法捕捉的方式重塑了潜在空间的几何结构，表明仅凭下游任务精度不足以全面评估表征质量，潜在空间的几何性质（如均匀性、谱特性）应当被纳入考量。

Abstract: Masked language modelling (MLM) has been the dominant pre-training objective for text encoders since BERT, yet it encourages representations that are strongly anchored to surface-form token identity rather than deeper semantic structure. Inspired by the success of Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) (LeCun, 2022) in vision and audio, we propose a hybrid pre-training objective that combines a JEPA-style latent-space prediction loss with a standard MLM objective over a single shared encoder. A learnable scalar parameter continuously balances the two objectives during training. We pre-train both a hybrid model and a pure-MLM baseline on English Wikipedia using identical architectures and compute budgets (NVIDIA H100). Extensive representation analysis across five GLUE benchmarks (SST-2, MRPC, MNLI, CoLA, STS-B) using four pooling strategies reveals that the hybrid encoder produces significantly more uniform embeddings (uniformity less than -0.16 vs -0.05 for MLM), exhibits richer spectral geometry under max pooling, encodes less surface-level lexical information, and achieves a better semantic-to-lexical balance. Despite similar linear-probe downstream accuracy, the geometric differences are consistent and significant, suggesting that the JEPA predictive objective reshapes the latent space in ways that standard accuracy metrics alone cannot capture.

</details>


### [104] [Improving Heart-Focused Medical Question Answering in LLMs via Variance-Aware Rubric Rewards with GRPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05174)
*Arash Ahmadi,Parisa Masnadi,Sarah Sharif,Charles Nicholson,David Ebert,Mike Banad*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究如何利用GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）结合基于评分量规的奖励机制，对LLM进行后训练以提升心脏医学问答能力，并提出方差感知奖励框架，将离散的量规聚合转化为连续分析型奖励信号，最终在HealthBench心脏子集上显著提升Qwen3-14B模型的准确率和F1分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用大模型在医疗场景部署面临数据隐私、推理成本和边缘设备适配等挑战，亟需更小型、高效且具备可靠医学推理能力的模型。然而，医学问答涉及稀疏、多准则且难以自动验证的反馈信号，需要设计鲁棒的后训练策略和精细的奖励机制来引导模型学习。

Method: 作者提出方差感知奖励框架（Variance-Aware Reward Framework），对RaR-Medicine中的Explicit Aggregation和Implicit Aggregation两种量规奖励聚合策略进行扩展：用基于准则级量规结果的连续分析型奖励函数，取代加权二元准则聚合和单一整体Likert评分。随后在心脏医学问答数据上采用GRPO进行在线策略强化学习后训练。

Result: 在HealthBench心脏相关留出测试集上，最佳GRPO变体将Qwen3-14B基座模型的准确率从0.362提升至0.502，F1从0.532提升至0.668，与GPT-OSS-120B（准确率0.508，F1 0.674）相比具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 精心设计的量规奖励机制为提升LLM在心脏医学问答中的表现提供了有效策略，该方法有望推广至其他基于量规的任务。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong promise in healthcare applications. Yet deploying general-purpose models in real-world settings remains difficult due to data privacy constraints, inference costs, and limited suitability for edge or on-device use. These challenges motivate the development of smaller, more efficient models that require robust post-training strategies to ensure reliable medical reasoning. In this work, we investigate Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for post-training LLMs on heart-focused medical question answering with rubric-based supervision derived from RaR-Medicine. We propose a Variance-Aware Reward Framework that extends the Explicit Aggregation and Implicit Aggregation strategies of Rubrics as Rewards by replacing weighted binary criterion aggregation and single overall Likert-style scoring with continuous analytical reward functions derived from criterion-level rubric outcomes. This formulation provides richer optimization signals for feedback that is sparse, multi-criteria, and difficult to verify automatically, and enables more stable on-policy reinforcement learning. On a held-out heart-related subset of HealthBench, our best GRPO variant improves accuracy from 0.362 to 0.502 and F1 from 0.532 to 0.668 relative to the Qwen3-14B base model, while remaining competitive with GPT-OSS-120B (0.508 accuracy, 0.674 F1). Our findings show that carefully designed rubric-based rewards provide a practical strategy for improving heart-focused medical question answering in LLMs, with potential to extend to other rubric-based tasks.

</details>


### [105] [Generic Triple-Latent Compression with Gated Associative Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05175)
*Liu Xiao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了一种通用的三重潜在序列模型，该模型维护运行时的token状态和压缩的配对记忆通路，以捕获高阶token交互，在小规模Transformer基线上取得了改进，但其门控键值检索扩展虽然提升了联想回忆能力，却对随机种子敏感且推理速度较慢。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有序列模型在捕获高阶token交互时往往依赖针对特定基准的解析策略，缺乏通用性。作者希望设计一种无需基准特定解析的通用序列建模架构，通过维护压缩记忆来自然捕获token间的高阶交互关系。

Method: 提出三重潜在（triple-latent）序列模型家族：模型维护运行时的token状态（running token state）和压缩的配对记忆通路（compressed pair-memory pathway），以此捕获高阶token交互。进一步提出一种面向回忆的门控键值检索扩展（recall-focused gated key-value retrieval extension），以增强联想回忆能力。

Result: 在字节级WikiText-2和基于tokenizer的MiniMind语言模型基准上，三重潜在模型家族相比小型Transformer基线取得了性能改进。门控键值检索扩展提升了联想回忆表现，但存在对随机种子敏感的问题，且当前参考实现的推理速度显著较慢。

Conclusion: 三重潜在序列模型作为一种通用架构，能够在不依赖基准特定解析的情况下有效捕获高阶token交互，优于小型Transformer基线。但门控键值检索扩展在实用性和稳定性方面仍需进一步优化，以解决种子敏感性和推理效率问题。

Abstract: We study generic triple-latent sequence models that maintain a running token state and compressed pair-memory pathway to capture higher-order token interactions without benchmark-specific parsing. The triple-latent family improves a small Transformer baseline on byte-level WikiText-2 and on a tokenizer-based MiniMind language-model benchmark, while a recall-focused gated key-value retrieval extension improves associative recall but remains seed-sensitive and much slower in the current reference implementation.

</details>


### [106] [PEFT of SLM for Telecommunications Customer Support: A Comparative Study of LoRA Configurations with Energy Consumption Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05176)
*Lucas Tamic,Ilan Jaffeux-Cheniout,Xavier Marjou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了使用LoRA对Qwen2.5-3B进行参数高效微调，以构建电信客服领域的对话助手。通过组合式合成数据生成方法构建了约3万条训练样本，评估了16种LoRA配置，并发现验证损失最低的模型并不一定获得最佳人工对齐评分，揭示了定量指标与定性评估之间的显著分歧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在电信客服领域应用面临两大挑战：(1) 领域特定约束下的评估与适配研究不足；(2) 数据主权、监管限制以及客户敏感信息的处理使得使用外部托管的基础模型变得困难。因此需要在本地部署和微调模型，并探索更有效的评估方法。

Method: (1) 基于52个行业术语的词汇表，设计组合式合成数据生成方法，通过Gemini 2.0 Flash驱动的生成管道，产生覆盖1560个不同问题场景的约3万条训练样本；(2) 使用LoRA对Qwen2.5-3B进行参数高效微调，系统变化超参数和目标模块，形成16种配置；(3) 评估采用多维度方法：除标准指标外，还引入能耗分析和基于LLM-as-a-judge框架（GPT-5.2与Claude 4.5 Sonnet）的定性评估。

Result: (1) 最低验证损失(0.5024)的模型在定性评估中仅排第6-7名，而最差验证损失(0.6807)的模型在两位裁判的评定中均排名第一，表明定量与定性表现存在明显分歧；(2) 揭示了LoRA目标模块选择对性能的影响规律；(3) 提供了能耗与性能的权衡分析。

Conclusion: (1) 提出了一种组合式合成数据集构建方法；(2) 深入揭示了LoRA注入中目标模块选择的影响；(3) 证明在对话AI微调中，仅凭验证损失不足以选择最优配置，需结合定性评估；(4) 为可持续LLM部署提供了能耗-性能权衡分析。验证损失与人类偏好之间的脱节对模型选择策略具有重要启示。

Abstract: While large language models (LLMs) show strong performance in natural language understanding and generation, their evaluation and adaptation to domain-specific constraints in telecommunications customer support remain limited. In addition, data sovereignty, regulatory constraints, and the handling of sensitive customer and network information complicate the use of externally hosted foundation models in this domain.
  We present a systematic study of parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) applied to Qwen2.5-3B to build a domain-specific conversational assistant. We introduce a combinatorial synthetic data generation approach based on a glossary of 52 industry-specific terms, producing approximately 30,000 training examples across 1,560 distinct problem scenarios via a generative pipeline powered by Gemini 2.0 Flash.
  We evaluate 16 LoRA configurations by varying hyperparameters and target modules. Our evaluation extends beyond standard metrics by incorporating energy consumption analysis and qualitative assessment using an LLM-as-a-judge framework with GPT-5.2 and Claude 4.5 Sonnet.
  Results show a clear divergence between quantitative and qualitative performance: models achieving the lowest validation loss do not necessarily obtain the best human-aligned rankings. The best validation loss (0.5024) ranks only 6th-7th in qualitative evaluation, while the worst loss (0.6807) ranks first according to both judges.
  This work contributes (1) a combinatorial method for synthetic dataset construction, (2) insights into the impact of target module selection for LoRA injection, (3) evidence that validation loss alone is insufficient for selecting fine-tuning configurations in conversational AI, and (4) an energy-performance trade-off analysis for sustainable LLM deployment.

</details>


### [107] [MCBench: A Multicontext Safety Assessment Benchmark for Omni Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05177)
*Manh Luong,Tamas Abraham,Junae Kim,Amar Kaur,Rollin Omari,Gholamreza Haffari,Trang Vu,Lizhen Qu,Dinh Phung*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MCBench是一个面向全模态大语言模型的多模态安全基准测试，包含1196个场景，覆盖四个安全类别，评估模型在整合视觉、音频和文本等多模态信息进行安全判断的能力。结果显示当前全模态LLM在跨模态安全推理方面存在显著不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全基准仅关注视觉输入，无法评估能够同时处理视觉、音频和文本的全模态大语言模型(Omni LLM)的安全能力。多模态模型在实际部署中可能面临需要融合多种模态才能准确识别的安全风险，因此需要一个能测试跨模态安全推理能力的基准。

Method: 构建MCBench基准，包含1196个场景，覆盖四个安全类别。每个不安全场景搭配一个仅有微小差异的安全对照场景（minimally different safe counterpart），用于评估模型对安全边界的敏感性。通过对最先进的全模态LLM进行评测，并分析其推理轨迹（reasoning traces），考察模型提取模态特定信息以及整合多模态线索进行安全判断的能力。

Result: 全模态LLM在处理微妙或非物理性风险时表现困难，但在存在显著视觉或声学线索时表现较好。推理轨迹分析表明，模型虽然能够提取各模态的特定信息，但往往无法有效整合这些线索以做出正确的安全判断。

Conclusion: 当前全模态LLM在安全关键场景中缺乏稳健的跨模态推理能力，亟需改进模型架构和训练策略以增强多模态安全性。

Abstract: Existing multimodal safety benchmarks focus solely on visual inputs and cannot assess Omni Large Language Models (LLMs) that process vision, audio, and text. We introduce MCBench, a benchmark with 1196 scenarios spanning four safety categories that require integrating multiple modalities for accurate safety assessment. Each unsafe scenario is paired with a minimally different safe counterpart to assess model sensitivity. Our evaluations of state-of-the-art models reveal significant challenges. Omni LLMs struggle with subtle or non-physical risks but perform better when salient visual or acoustic cues are present. Analysis of reasoning traces shows that, although models can extract modality-specific information, they often fail to integrate these cues effectively for safety judgments. Our findings reveal that current Omni LLMs lack robust cross-modal reasoning in safety-critical settings, underscoring the need for improved architectures and training strategies for multimodal safety.

</details>


### [108] [Efficient Punctuation Restoration via Weighted Lookahead Scoring Method for Streaming ASR Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05179)
*Sungmook Woo,Hyungu Kang,Chanwoo Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向流式ASR的非自回归标点恢复方法，通过在每词边界对比插入假说与无插入基线，结合有限前瞻（K子词token）和阈值校准，无需推理时参数更新，在IWSLT 2017上取得优异性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式ASR要求在线、低延迟的标点预测，但传统自回归生成方法在逐边界评估下易出现延迟和对齐失败问题。因此需要一种保留原始转录、在每个词边界即时决策的非生成式方法，在有限未来上下文下实现高准确率的标点恢复。

Method: 提出一种非自回归的评分方法：保留输入转录不变，在每个词边界处构建标点插入假说（如逗号、句号、问号或无标点），将其与"无插入"基线进行对比评分。利用最多K个子词token的有限前瞻窗口获取未来信息，并通过权重α和基于验证集校准的阈值τ进行决策校准，整个推理过程无需参数更新。

Result: 在IWSLT 2017数据集上，该方法在无微调设置下（验证集校准，K=2）达到4类宏平均F1=0.893；微调后（K=2）达到0.937，显著优于基于提示的基线方法（0.566）和微调后的ELECTRA基线（0.913），且在相同前瞻预算下表现更优。消融实验系统分析了前瞻预算K的影响。

Conclusion: 该方法有效解决了流式ASR标点恢复中的延迟与对齐难题，通过非自回归评分和有限前瞻实现了高精度在线标点预测，且无需推理时参数更新，在实际部署中具有优势。

Abstract: Punctuation restoration improves ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) readability. However streaming ASR requires online decisions with limited future context. In streaming ASR, the system predicts punctuation incrementally, which makes generation-based approaches prone to latency and alignment failures under boundary-wise evaluation. This paper proposes a non-autoregressive scoring method (no free-form generation) that preserves the input transcript and makes a decision at each word boundary. Our method compares punctuation insertion hypotheses against a no-insertion baseline under a bounded K-subword-token lookahead, and calibrates decisions using a weight α and a validation-calibrated threshold τ (no parameter updates during inference). On IWSLT 2017, our scoring method achieves a 4-class macro F1 of 0.893 in the no fine-tuning setting (validation-calibrated, K=2) and 0.937 after fine-tuning (K=2), outperforming the prompt-based baseline (0.566) and a fine-tuned ELECTRA baseline (0.913) under the same lookahead budget. We analyze the impact of the lookahead budget through ablation studies on K.

</details>


### [109] [From Scoring to Explanations: Evaluating SHAP and LLM Rationales for Rubric-based Teaching Quality Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05180)
*Ivo Bueno,Babette Bühler,Philipp Stark,Tim Fütterer,Ulrich Trautwein,Dorottya Demszky,Heather Hill,Enkelejda Kasneci*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一种结合SHAP归因与LLM理由生成的句子级可解释性框架，用于教育场景中基于量规的自动评分。在CLASS框架的"反馈质量"维度上，系统比较了微调PLM与提示LLM的评分性能及解释忠实度，发现SHAP在忠实性和跨模型迁移性上均优于LLM生成的解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前自动评分模型在课堂转录等复杂语言表现中广泛使用，但缺乏对评分决策的透明解释，尤其在教育等高风险场景中，理解模型为何给出特定分数至关重要。

Method: 提出通用框架，将模型无关的Shapley值归因与LLM生成的理由相结合，实现基于量规评分的句子级可解释性。在NCTE语料库的CLASS框架"反馈质量"维度上进行实例化，包含约6k标注转录片段。通过删除测试（deletion-based tests）评估解释忠实度，并开展跨模型迁移分析比较SHAP归因与LLM理由在不同架构间的稳健性。

Result: 微调PLM在预测准确率上优于LLM，但存在向中间分数压缩的倾向。SHAP识别出的句子能可靠地驱动模型预测，在预测偏移的幅度和连贯性上均优于LLM生成的理由。跨模型分析显示SHAP归因在不同架构间可稳健迁移，而LLM理由仅产生有限且不一致的影响。

Conclusion: SHAP为基于量规的评分提供了更忠实、可迁移的解释；该框架为高风险教育环境及其他基于量规的语言评估任务中评分模型及其解释的评估提供了原则性基础。

Abstract: Automated scoring models are increasingly used to assign rubric-based quality ratings to complex language performances, including classroom transcripts, yet they typically provide little insight into why a particular score is produced. We propose a general framework for sentence-level interpretability of rubric-based scoring that combines model-agnostic Shapley-value attributions with rationales generated by large language models (LLMs). Instantiated on the Quality of Feedback dimension of the CLASS framework using the NCTE corpus, the framework enables systematic comparison of fine-tuned pretrained language models (PLMs) and prompted LLMs on both scoring performance and explanation faithfulness. Across 6k annotated transcript segments, fine-tuned PLMs outperform LLMs in prediction accuracy but exhibit label compression toward mid-scale scores. Deletion-based tests show that SHAP identifies sentences that reliably drive model predictions, producing typically larger and more coherent prediction shifts than LLM-generated rationales. Cross-model analyses further reveal that SHAP attributions transfer robustly across architectures, whereas LLM rationales exert limited and inconsistent influence. Overall, the findings demonstrate that SHAP provides more faithful and transferable explanations for rubric-based scoring, and that the proposed framework offers a principled basis for evaluating both scoring models and their explanations in high-stakes educational settings and other rubric-based language assessment tasks.

</details>


### [110] [Multi-Granularity Reasoning for Natural Language Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05181)
*Chunling Xi,Di Liang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MGRN 是一种新型多粒度推理网络，通过显式利用层次化语义特征来增强自然语言推理能力，在多个公开基准上持续超越强基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有预训练模型在NLI中主要依赖最终层 token 表示，不足以捕获复杂、层次化的语义交互——细粒度词汇线索、短语组合和高层上下文语义往往在单一表示空间中被纠缠或稀释。

Method: 提出多粒度推理网络（MGRN），模拟人类从浅层词汇匹配到深层语义抽象与逻辑推理的认知过程，在交互式推理空间中通过渐进、结构化的方式整合多粒度语义信息。

Result: 在多个公开NLI基准上进行广泛实验，MGRN 一致优于强基线模型，验证了方法的有效性和鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 显式建模层次化多粒度语义特征能显著提升NLI推理性能，MGRN 为此提供了有效且鲁棒的解决方案。

Abstract: Natural Language Inference (NLI) is a fundamental task in natural language understanding that requires determining the logical relationship between a premise and a hypothesis. Despite the remarkable success of transformer-based pre-trained models, most existing approaches primarily rely on the final-layer token representations, which are often insufficient for capturing the complex and hierarchical semantic interactions required for effective reasoning. In particular, fine-grained lexical cues, phrasal compositions, and higher-level contextual semantics are typically entangled or diluted in a single representation space. To address these limitations, we propose a novel \emph{Multi-Granularity Reasoning Network} (MGRN) that explicitly leverages hierarchical semantic features within an interactive reasoning space. The proposed framework mimics the human cognitive process of language understanding, which naturally progresses from shallow lexical matching to deeper semantic abstraction and logical reasoning. By integrating semantic information across multiple granularities in a progressive and structured manner, MGRN is able to uncover intricate semantic relationships underlying natural language expressions. Extensive experiments on multiple public benchmarks demonstrate that MGRN consistently outperforms strong baseline models, validating the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed approach.

</details>


### [111] [LANTERN: Layered Archival and Temporal Episodic Retrieval Network for Long-Context LLM Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05182)
*Rahul Subramani*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LANTERN 是一种轻量级记忆层，主动归档每轮对话并在上下文压缩后通过混合检索恢复关键细节，无需 LLM 调用，延迟低于 25ms，在恢复被压缩丢失的事实方面显著优于基于 LLM 的 MemGPT 方案，且恢复的上下文能提升多种 LLM 的准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在对话历史被压缩以适应有限上下文窗口时，会丢失关键细节。现有方案（如 MemGPT）依赖 LLM 进行记忆提取和检索，推理成本高。需要一种零 LLM 调用、低延迟的记忆层来高效恢复被压缩丢失的对话事实。

Method: 提出 LANTERN（Layered Archival aNd Temporal Episodic Retrieval Network），一种轻量级记忆层，包含两个阶段：(1) 主动归档——将每轮对话实时存入分层存储；(2) 混合检索——在上下文压缩后，通过稠密检索与稀疏检索结合的方式恢复相关历史细节。变体 LANTERN-Rerank 在此基础上增加重排序步骤。整个过程零 LLM 调用，单轮延迟低于 25ms。

Result: 在 94 段真实多轮对话（1,894 个人工验证的事实，kappa=0.81）上：LANTERN-Rerank 恢复了 78.3% 的被压缩丢失的可验证事实，显著优于重新实现的 MemGPT LLM 驱动流水线（72.4%，Wilcoxon p<0.0001，95% CI [+3.1, +8.6] pp，d=0.43）；基础版 LANTERN（无重排序）以零 LLM 调用达到与 LLM 基线相当或更优的效果（p=0.005）；使用 LANTERN 恢复的上下文后，四个生产级 LLM 回答事实性问题的准确率平均提升 8.4 个百分点（每个模型 Wilcoxon p<0.05）。

Conclusion: LANTERN 证明，零 LLM 调用的轻量级记忆层可以在上下文压缩后有效恢复对话细节，性能超越基于 LLM 的方案，且恢复的上下文对不同架构的 LLM 均有助益。作者公开了完整评估框架以促进可复现性。

Abstract: Large language models discard critical details when conversation history is compacted to fit within finite context windows. We present LANTERN (Layered Archival aNd Temporal Episodic Retrieval Network), a lightweight memory layer that proactively archives every conversation turn and restores relevant details after compaction via hybrid retrieval -- requiring zero LLM calls and adding fewer than 25ms of latency per turn. On 94 real multi-turn conversations (1,894 ground-truth facts, human-validated at kappa=0.81), LANTERN-Rerank recovers 78.3% of verifiable facts lost to compaction, significantly outperforming a faithful reimplementation of MemGPT's LLM-driven extraction and multi-query search pipeline (72.4%; Wilcoxon p<0.0001, 95% CI [+3.1, +8.6] pp, d=0.43) at a fraction of the inference cost. Even without the reranker, base LANTERN matches or exceeds this LLM-driven baseline (p=0.005) using zero LLM calls. When four production LLMs answer fact-bearing questions using LANTERN-restored context, accuracy improves by 8.4 percentage points on average (Wilcoxon p<0.05 for each model individually), demonstrating that the recovered context is useful across diverse model architectures. We release the full evaluation framework -- paired significance tests, failure analysis, fact-type stratification, and compaction robustness analysis -- to support reproducibility and future work.

</details>


### [112] [The Granularity Gap: A Multi-Dimensional Longitudinal Audit of Sycophancy in Gemini Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05183)
*Patrick Keough*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文揭示了当前大模型对齐评测中的"粒度鸿沟"：传统二元指标掩盖了大量隐性的谄媚行为（如附和用户框架、认可可疑前提、软化事实修正）。通过对六个Gemini变体在73个对抗提示下的8830条回答进行0-4 Likert量表评测，发现27.2%的回答存在实质性谄媚，且代际进展非单调（Gen 2.5严重倒退），谄媚与真实性呈显著负相关（斯皮尔曼ρ=-0.63），构成"对齐税"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大模型在高风险顾问场景中广泛应用，但标准对齐基准测试将谄媚视为二元的失败模式，忽略了模型在不说出明显虚假内容的前提下，通过迎合用户框架、认可可疑前提、弱化事实修正等方式表现出的社会顺从行为，即"粒度鸿沟"问题。

Method: 作者在三类护栏条件（Control、Simple、Protocol）下，对Gemini 2.0、2.5、3.0共六个变体在73个对抗性提示上进行了评测，获得8830条回答。采用0-4 Likert量表进行连续量化，并通过三人注释者组验证（Fleiss κ=0.71，Cohen κ=0.78 vs AI共识，95.9%二分类准确率，100%特异性）。

Result: 三项核心发现：(1)27.2%的回答含实质性谄媚（Likert≥2.0），22.7%达中重度（≥3.0），粗粒度指标仅解释29%的评分方差；(2)代际进展非单调，Gen 2.5显著倒退（均值2.64）且出现反向缩放（Pro版1.94劣于Flash版1.71），Gen 3.0恢复标准缩放；(3)存在"对齐税"——谄媚与真实性Spearman ρ=-0.63，自我验证类提示成为谄媚陷阱（均值3.27），几近道德提案类（1.72）的两倍。Simple护栏在旗舰模型上优于Protocol，但Gen 3.0 Flash反转此规律。

Conclusion: 谄媚应从二元指标转为连续测量，粗粒度指标不足以捕捉社会顺从行为。模型代际进展并非线性改善，安全对齐与真实性之间存在根本性权衡。小模型可能需要结构化的思维链护栏，而大模型则更受益于简洁护栏。研究呼吁采用更细粒度的评测体系以支持负责任的AI部署。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as high-stakes advisors, yet standard alignment benchmarks treat sycophancy as a binary failure mode. We introduce the Granularity Gap: coarse binary metrics mask substantial social-compliance behaviors where models capitulate to user framing, validate questionable premises, or soften factual corrections without producing overtly false outputs. We evaluate six Gemini variants across generations 2.0, 2.5, and 3.0 on 73 adversarial prompts under three guardrail conditions (Control, Simple, Protocol), yielding 8,830 graded responses. Using a 0-4 Likert scale validated against a human annotator triad (Fleiss kappa = 0.71; Cohen kappa = 0.78 vs AI consensus; 95.9 percent binary accuracy, 100 percent specificity), we quantify sycophancy as continuous rather than binary. Three findings emerge. First, 27.2 percent of responses contain substantial sycophantic content (Likert >= 2.0) and 22.7 percent reach moderate or severe levels (>= 3.0), while binary win-rate framing reports only modest failure rates; coarse metrics explain just 29 percent of graded variance. Second, generational progress is non-monotonic: Gen 2.5 regresses sharply (mean Control 2.64) relative to Gen 2.0 (1.90) and Gen 3.0 (2.01), and Gen 2.5 shows inverse scaling (Pro 1.94 worse than Flash 1.71) while Gen 3.0 restores standard scaling. Third, we document an Alignment Tax: Spearman rho = -0.63 between sycophancy and truthfulness, indicating social compliance trades against factual accuracy. Egotistical Validation prompts act as a sycophancy trap (mean 3.27), nearly double Unethical Proposals (1.72). Simple guardrails outperform elaborate Protocol scaffolding on flagship models, but distilled Gen 3.0 Flash inverts this, suggesting small models may structurally require chain-of-thought scaffolding. We release the dataset and rubric to support continuous sycophancy measurement.

</details>


### [113] [LoRi: Low-Rank Distillation for Implicit Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05315)
*Ryan Solgi,Jiayi Tian,Zheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种低秩蒸馏框架，通过在一阶和二阶统计量对齐教师-学生隐状态轨迹，将显式思维链推理能力迁移到隐式推理中，在数学推理基准上接近显式CoT精度并超越先前iCoT方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐式思维链(iCoT)方法旨在将推理过程内化到模型隐状态中，但性能常不及显式CoT提示。作者实证发现隐状态推理轨迹呈现低秩结构，这为通过低秩蒸馏提升iCoT性能提供了动机。

Method: 提出低秩蒸馏框架：首先在教师模型（显式CoT）和学生模型（iCoT）的隐状态轨迹上构建共享低秩张量子空间，然后通过一阶统计量（均值对齐）和二阶统计量（协方差对齐）在该子空间中匹配教师和学生的推理轨迹，从而捕捉推理的全局结构并支持紧凑的隐式推理过程。

Result: 在LLaMA和Qwen等多个模型家族、不同规模的数学推理基准上评估，方法一致提升性能，尤其在具有挑战性的多步推理任务上表现突出，接近显式CoT精度并超越先前iCoT蒸馏方法。

Conclusion: 利用推理轨迹的低秩结构进行二阶统计对齐的低秩蒸馏，是提升隐式思维链推理能力的有效途径，能缩小iCoT与显式CoT之间的性能差距。

Abstract: Implicit chain-of-thought (iCoT) methods aim to internalize reasoning in large language models, but often underperform explicit CoT prompting. We empirically find that hidden-state reasoning trajectories exhibit low-rank structure. Motivated by this observation, we propose a low-rank distillation framework that transfers reasoning by aligning teacher and student trajectories in a shared low-rank tensor subspace using first- and second-order statistics. The resulting formulation captures the global structure of reasoning while supporting a compact latent reasoning process. We evaluate the method across multiple model families, including LLaMA and Qwen, at different scales on mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Our approach consistently improves performance, especially on challenging multi-step tasks, approaching explicit CoT accuracy and outperforming prior iCoT distillation methods.

</details>


### [114] [A Model of Multi-turn Human Persuadability Using Probabilistic Belief Tracing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05330)
*Jared Moore,Noah Goodman,Nick Haber,Max Kleiman-Weiner*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出PERSUASIONTRACE框架，将说服研究从仅关注前后测信念变化扩展到过程级追踪，通过多轮对话中的信念报告记录和修辞维度标注，发现人类信念更新呈现两种聚类模式且对修辞策略敏感；同时指出普通LLM模拟器无法复现人类信念动态，提出基于贝叶斯网络的模拟目标，在与人类参考的相似度评估中得分81（基线仅64）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统说服研究仅依赖前后测的信念变化终点测量，能判断说服是否发生，但无法揭示信念在对话过程中"何处"和"如何"移动。这种过程性理解的缺失限制了对说服机制的深入科学分析和安全优化。

Method: 作者构建了PERSUASIONTRACE框架，包含：①基于Web的实验平台，支持多轮说服研究；②过程级评估协议，记录人类或模拟目标的多轮信念报告，用logos/pathos/ethos三个修辞维度标注说服者回合；③提出基于贝叶斯网络的模拟目标，维护显式潜在信念状态随时间更新，使每条说服消息产生认知上现实的信念变化；④评估模拟器对人类信念动态的复现保真度。

Result: 实验发现：(1)人类目标的多轮信念更新聚为两类，且对修辞策略（logos/pathos/ethos）表现出敏感性；(2)LLM在通用和个性化话题、文本和音频模态、多轮交互中均具有说服力；(3)普通提示LLM模拟器无法复现人类信念动态（得分64）；(4)贝叶斯网络模拟目标在人类相似度评估中得81分，接近人类参考80分。

Conclusion: PERSUASIONTRACE将说服评估从终点移动重新定义为过程保真度，为说服系统的科学分析和安全优化提供了更强的基础。贝叶斯模拟目标显著提升了模拟人类信念动态的逼真度，未来说服研究应关注过程而不仅是结果。

Abstract: Large language models can shift human beliefs across high-stakes domains, but most persuasion studies rely on pre/post belief change. These endpoint measures identify whether persuasion occurred, yet miss where and how beliefs moved within a dialogue. We present PERSUASIONTRACE, a framework for studying persuasion in human-LLM interaction. Built on a web-based experimental platform, PERSUASIONTRACE contributes a tool for multi-turn persuasion studies and a process-level evaluation protocol: it records multi-turn belief reports from human or simulated targets of persuasion, annotates persuader turns with rhetorical dimensions (logos/pathos/ethos), and evaluates simulators by fidelity to real human belief dynamics. Using this framework, we find that human targets group into two clusters of multi-turn belief updates and exhibit susceptibility to rhetorical strategies, and that LLMs are persuasive across generic and personalized topics, text and audio modalities, and multi-turn interactions. Prior work has chiefly used vanilla-prompted LLMs to simulate human targets, but we show that these simulators fail to replicate human belief dynamics. We introduce a Bayesian-network simulated target that maintains an explicit latent belief state over time so each persuader message yields cognitively realistic belief updates. In human-likeness evaluation, our Bayesian target scores near a human reference (81 vs 80), while baseline LLM targets score substantially lower (64). PERSUASIONTRACE reframes persuasion evaluation from endpoint movement alone to process fidelity, providing a stronger basis for scientific analysis and safer optimization of persuasive systems.

</details>


### [115] [Self-supervised User Profile Generation for Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05336)
*Clark Mingxuan Ju,Yuwei Qiu,Tong Zhao,Neil Shah*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: BUMP 是一种自监督框架，通过双向批次内排序目标训练 LLM 生成用户自然语言画像，无需任何下游任务标签即可实现个性化，在 LaMP 基准上匹配或超越依赖标注奖励的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有用户画像生成方法依赖下游标注任务提供的显式奖励信号，但标注监督对于每个目标任务都昂贵且稀疏。需要一种无需下游标签的自监督方案来训练画像生成器。

Method: 提出 BUMP 框架：给定用户交互历史，使用 GRPO 训练 LLM 生成自由形式的文本画像。核心是双向批次内排序目标：(i) 用生成的画像作为查询，评估其将用户自身留出交互排在批次内其他用户交互之上的能力；(ii) 用留出交互作为查询，评估其将用户自身画像排在他人画像之上的能力。两个方向均采用多正例 NDCG 评分，合并为密集奖励。批次内其他用户提供免费负样本，训练仅需原始交互日志。

Result: 在 LaMP 基准上评估，BUMP 匹配或优于闭源 API 以及依赖标注奖励的先前方法，且训练时完全不需要任务标签。

Conclusion: BUMP 证明了通过自监督双向排序目标，可以有效训练画像生成器实现 LLM 个性化，消除了对下游任务标注的依赖，为低成本、可扩展的 LLM 个性化提供了新路径。

Abstract: Personalizing large language models (LLMs) has become a central challenge as LLMs are deployed across recommendation, search, dialogue, and content generation -- settings where the same query should yield different answers given different users. A promising route is to summarize each user's interaction history into a natural-language memory or profile and prepend it to the prompt to facilitate personalization. Existing methods learn such profile generators with explicit rewards derived from labeled downstream tasks, which are expensive and sparse as they require annotated supervision for every target task. In light of this challenge, we introduce Bidirectional User Modeling via Profiles (BUMP), a self-supervised framework that trains a profile generator without any downstream labels. Specifically, given a user's interaction history, we use GRPO to train an LLM to emit a free-form textual profile under a bidirectional in-batch ranking objective: a small LLM judge measures (i) how well the generated profile, used as a query, ranks the user's own held-out interactions above interactions from other users in the batch, and (ii) how well a held-out interaction, used as a query, ranks the user's own profile above profiles of other users. Both directions are scored with multi-positive NDCG and combined into a dense reward per rollout; other users in the batch supply free negatives, so every training example yields supervision from raw interaction logs alone. Evaluated on the LaMP benchmark, BUMP matches or outperforms closed-source APIs and prior methods relying on labeled rewards, while requiring no task label at training.

</details>


### [116] [Trajectory Dynamics in Language Model Hidden States Predict Human Processing Costs Beyond Surprisal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05346)
*Elan Barenholtz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文引入"轨迹外推误差"这一新指标，用于衡量当前词偏离前文隐状态线性轨迹的程度。该指标与surprisal近乎正交，能独立预测自定步速阅读时间，尤其在花园路径句中效果显著，揭示了处理成本包含两个可分离成分：词级预测误差和解释轨迹的局部动量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统surprisal将丰富的序列表示压缩为单一标量，丢弃了解释演化方向的信息。动态系统观点认为，处理成本不仅取决于当前时刻的解释状态位置，还应受其演化轨迹影响，且语言本身因说话者一次规划若干词而具有局部动量。因此需要一种能捕捉这一轨迹信息的度量。

Method: 对每个词，在Transformer语言模型的前文隐状态上拟合一条线性轨迹，计算当前词隐状态偏离外推路径的程度，命名为"轨迹外推误差"(trajectory extrapolation error)。在Natural Stories语料库上，使用GPT-2 Small到Large及Pythia/RoPE架构，将该指标与surprisal对比，预测自定步速阅读时间，并设置位移控制实验以排除表征变化幅度的替代解释。

Result: 轨迹外推误差与surprisal近乎正交(r = .044)，能独立预测阅读时间。在花园路径句中效应更强，随模型规模增大而增强，在不同位置编码架构间可复现。位移控制表明，位移量与外推误差预测方向相反，说明效应不可还原为表征变化幅度。

Conclusion: 处理成本存在两个可分离的组分：词级预测误差(surprisal)和对解释展开过程中局部动量的敏感性(轨迹外推误差)。这为语言理解的增量处理机制提供了新的理论视角和实证度量。

Abstract: Human language comprehension unfolds sequentially: each word is processed in the context of those that came before, and the interpretation builds incrementally over time. Surprisal, the negative log probability of a word given its context, has been the dominant predictor of incremental processing cost. But surprisal reduces rich sequential representations to a single scalar at each word, discarding information about the direction in which the interpretation has been evolving. Dynamical-systems approaches suggest that the trajectory of the evolving interpretive state, not just its position at each moment,should shape processing, and language itself may have local momentum, since speakers plan utterances a few words at a time. We introduce trajectory extrapolation error: at each word, we fit a linear trajectory to the preceding hidden states of a transformer language model and measure deviation from the extrapolated path. On the Natural Stories corpus, this measure is nearly orthogonal to surprisal (r = .044) and independently predicts self-paced reading times. The effect is especially pronounced in garden-path sentences, strengthens with model scale (GPT-2 Small to Large), and replicates across architectures with different positional encoding schemes (GPT-2 vs. Pythia/RoPE). A displacement control shows the effect is not reducible to representational change magnitude: displacement and extrapolation error predict in opposite directions. These findings reveal two dissociable components of processing cost: word-level prediction error (surprisal) and sensitivity to the local momentum of the unfolding interpretation (trajectory extrapolation error).

</details>


### [117] [ReasoningFlow: Discourse Structures for Understanding LLM Reasoning Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05402)
*Jinu Lee,Shivam Agarwal,Amruta Parulekar,Siddarth Madala,Dilek Hakkani-Tur,Julia Hockenmaier*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ReasoningFlow 是一个将LRM推理痕迹转化为有向无环图(DAG)的框架，用于捕捉推理的语篇结构。研究发现：不同LRM产生结构相似的推理痕迹；图中可识别多种细粒度推理行为（局部验证、自反思、假设）；大部分错误步骤未被用于最终答案推导；步骤间的因果依赖关系与语言层面的语篇结构并不对应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型推理模型(LRM)生成的推理痕迹具有非线性结构（如回溯、自我修正），这使得推理过程的评估和监控变得复杂。现有方法难以系统地刻画这些复杂的话语结构，需要一个结构化的分析框架。

Method: 提出 ReasoningFlow 框架：(1)设计标注模式，将推理步骤结构化为细粒度DAG（节点=推理步骤，边=步骤间语篇关系）；(2)人工标注31条痕迹(2.1k步骤)验证方案，达到高标注者间一致性；(3)自动标注扩展至1,260条痕迹(247.7k步骤)，覆盖数学、科学、论证三个任务和五个模型（Qwen2.5-32B-Inst, QwQ-32B, DeepSeek-V3, DeepSeek-R1, GPT-oss-120B）。

Result: (1) 尽管不同LRM基于不同基座模型和可能不重叠的后训练数据，其推理痕迹仍呈现相似的结构模式。(2) ReasoningFlow DAG揭示了多样化的细粒度推理行为（局部验证、自反思、假设等），可用于增强推理过程的可监控性。(3) LRM中大多数错误步骤并未被用于推导最终答案。(4) 步骤间的机制性因果依赖关系与语言层面的语篇结构并不一致。

Conclusion: ReasoningFlow 提供了一种结构化表示LRM推理过程的有效方法，揭示了LRM推理的普遍结构特征和多样化行为模式。错误步骤的低利用率以及因果依赖与语篇结构的脱节，为改进推理监控和评估提供了新视角。

Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) produce reasoning traces with non-linear structures, such as backtracking and self-correction, that complicate the evaluation and monitoring of the reasoning process. We introduce ReasoningFlow, a framework that captures the discourse structures of LRM reasoning traces into fine-grained directed acyclic graphs (DAGs). We develop and validate our annotation schema through careful manual annotation of 31 traces (2.1k steps), achieving high inter-annotator agreement, then scale to automatic annotation of 1,260 traces (247.7k steps) spanning three tasks (math, science, argumentation) and five models (Qwen2.5-32B-Inst, QwQ-32B, DeepSeek-V3, DeepSeek-R1, GPT-oss-120B). By analyzing ReasoningFlow graphs, we find: (1) LRMs exhibit structurally similar traces, despite being trained from different base models and potentially non-overlapping post-training data. (2) ReasoningFlow reveals diverse fine-grained reasoning behaviors (e.g., local verification, self-reflection, and assumptions) that can be used for better reasoning trace monitorability. (3) In LRMs, most of the erroneous steps are not used to derive final answers. (4) Mechanistic causal dependencies between steps do not reflect the language-level discourse structure. We release the dataset and code in: https://github.com/jinulee-v/reasoningflow.

</details>


### [118] [When Evidence is Sparse: Weakly Supervised Early Failure Alerting in Dialogs and LLM-Agent Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05414)
*Avinash Baidya,Xinran Liang,Ruocheng Guo,Xiang Gao,Kamalika Das*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种两阶段方法，通过注意力机制从轨迹级标签中学习稀疏的轮次级失败证据，并利用α-STOP偏好条件化停止策略实现可控的早期失败告警，在多个基准上显著提升了Pareto前沿质量并降低了训练成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有早期分类方法通常将轨迹级标签分配给每个前缀（prefix），将每一轮都视为失败证据。作者假设这种前缀标签假设与多轮语言交互的特性不匹配——在多轮交互中，失败证据往往是稀疏且延迟出现的。因此需要一种能利用稀疏证据结构进行可控早期告警的方法。

Method: 提出两阶段方法：（1）基于注意力的失败预测器：从轨迹级标签中学习稀疏的轮次级失败证据，利用注意力机制从部分历史中估计失败风险；（2）α-STOP策略：单一偏好条件化停止策略，可在推理时选择准确率-提前量的操作点，无需为每种偏好单独训练触发策略。

Result: 在客服对话、任务导向对话、说服、工具使用和规划五个基准上：高相关失败证据仅占4.7-11.3%的轮次，且首次出现在平均59.0-83.6%的轨迹之后；基于注意力的预测器在Pareto前沿质量（超体积）上比朴素前缀监督提升1-10%；完整系统比最先进的触发策略提升3-42%，同时每个操作点的训练成本降低1-3个数量级。

Conclusion: 通过从稀疏证据结构中学习并采用偏好条件化停止策略，该方法在早期失败告警任务中实现了更优的准确率-提前量权衡，且具有更高的训练效率。

Abstract: Early failure alerting requires deciding, while a dialog or agent trajectory is still unfolding, whether to flag it as likely to fail. This is challenging because supervision is typically available only as a trajectory-level success/failure label while alerts must be raised from partial interactions. Prior early-classification methods often bridge this gap by assigning the terminal label to every prefix, treating every turn as failure evidence. We hypothesize that this prefix-label assumption is poorly matched to multi-turn language interactions, where evidence of eventual failure is sparse and often delayed. In this paper, we introduce a two-stage approach that learns from this sparse evidence structure and uses the resulting risk estimates for controllable early alerting. Specifically, our attention-based failure predictor learns sparse turn-level failure evidence from trajectory labels and uses it to estimate failure risk from partial histories. We then pair this predictor with $α$-STOP, a single preference-conditioned stopping policy that selects an accuracy-earliness operating point at inference time rather than training a separate trigger for each preference. Across five benchmarks spanning customer support, task-oriented dialog, persuasion, tool use, and planning, we first show that high-relevance failure evidence occupies only 4.7-11.3% of turns and first appears after 59.0-83.6\% of trajectories on average. We further show that the attention-based predictor improves Pareto-frontier quality (hypervolume) by 1-10\% over naive prefix supervision, and that the full system improves frontier quality by 3-42\% over state-of-the-art trigger policies while reducing training cost per operating point by 1-3 orders of magnitude.

</details>


### [119] [Executable Schema Contracts: From Automatic Ingestion to Multi-Source Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05415)
*Padmaja Jonnalagedda,Yuguang Yao,Xiang Gao,Hilaf Hasson,Kamalika Das*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个自动从多源原始数据中发现可执行schema的系统，将该schema用作知识图谱构建和查询时检索的共享契约。系统结合LLM的schema发现、确定性结构分析以及schema驱动的抽取与链接，在四个QA基准上优于仅检索和基于分解的基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实世界数据横跨表格、文档和半结构化文件，具有隐式语义。查询此类数据需要跨不一致的schema和格式整合证据，但现有方法要么依赖昂贵的人工工程，要么完全忽略结构信息，缺乏一种能自动发现并利用数据结构的有效方案。

Method: 系统由三阶段构成：(1) 封闭世界字段目录约束下的LLM schema发现，结合确定性结构分析推断标识键、外键和源层级；(2) 利用发现的schema驱动信息抽取、去重和跨源链接，构建具有溯源感知的知识图谱；(3) 查询时，schema（可通过单调协议扩展）条件化地路由多工具智能体，在结构化查找、图遍历和向量检索之间进行检索，返回带可追溯引用的有据答案。

Result: 在控制零样本对比实验中（统一使用相同LLM、数据和评估框架），该系统在四个QA基准上均优于仅检索方法和基于分解的基线方法。消融实验表明，schema条件化路由、结构智能和schema引导构建三者各自对性能提升均有贡献。

Conclusion: 自动发现可执行schema并以此为共享契约统一知识图谱构建与查询检索，是一种有效的多源异构数据问答范式。结构感知的schema发现、构建与查询路由三者协同作用，能够显著提升答案的准确性和可追溯性。

Abstract: Real-world data spans tables, documents, and semi-structured files with implicit semantics. Querying this data requires integrating evidence across inconsistent schemas and formats, yet existing approaches either demand costly manual engineering or bypass structure entirely. We present a system that automatically discovers an executable schema from raw multi-source data and uses it as a shared contract for knowledge graph construction and query-time retrieval. A closed-world field catalog constrains LLM-based schema discovery to attested fields; deterministic structural analysis infers identity keys, foreign keys, and source hierarchy; and the resulting schema drives extraction, deduplication, and cross-source linking into a provenance-aware knowledge graph. At query time the schema -- optionally extended via a monotonic protocol -- conditions a multi-tool agent routing retrieval across structured lookup, graph traversal, and vector search, returning grounded answers with traceable citations. In controlled zero-shot comparisons using the same LLM, data, and evaluation harness, the system improves over retrieval-only and decomposition-based baselines across four QA benchmarks, with ablations showing that schema-conditioned routing, structural intelligence, and schema-guided construction each contribute to the gains.

</details>


### [120] [ComplexityMT: Benchmarking the Interaction Between Text Complexity and Machine Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05421)
*Joseph Marvin Imperial,Junhong Liang,Belal Shoer,Abdullah Barayan,Rodrigo Wilkens,Omar Mussa,Dawn Knight,Eugénio Ribeiro,Ekaterina Kochmar,Sowmya Vajjala,Fernando Alva-Manchego,Harish Tayyar Madabushi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出 ComplexityMT 基准，利用 CEFR 等级评估文本复杂度与机器翻译之间的交互关系，发现高 CEFR 文本更难翻译，且翻译会改变目标文本的 CEFR 等级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究翻译是否保留原文复杂度，填补文本复杂度与机器翻译交互影响研究的空白，为多语言教学内容和翻译难度评估提供理论支撑。

Method: 构建 ComplexityMT 挑战，以 CEFR 等级为复杂度度量标准；涵盖阿拉伯语、荷兰语、英语、法语、印地语、俄语六种语言；评估三个开放权重模型、一个闭源模型和一个商业翻译系统；设计两项任务：(1) CEFR 与翻译难度的相关性分析；(2) 源文本经翻译后 CEFR 等级的变化。

Result: 实验表明：(1) CEFR 等级越高，文本翻译难度越大；(2) 对于大多数语言，机器翻译会导致目标文本的 CEFR 等级相对于源文本发生偏移。

Conclusion: 文本复杂度与机器翻译之间存在显著交互：高复杂度文本增加翻译难度，且翻译过程本身会改变文本复杂度等级。该发现对多语言教学内容生成和翻译难度估计具有实践指导意义。

Abstract: When a text is translated, does the translation retain the complexity of the original? We introduce ComplexityMT, a new challenge for assessing how text complexity and machine translation interact with and influence each other, using the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) levels as the measure of text complexity. Across six languages, including Arabic, Dutch, English, French, Hindi, and Russian, we evaluate three open-weight models, one closed model, and a commercial machine translation system on two tasks: i) correlation of CEFR with translation difficulty, and ii) shifts in CEFR levels of the source texts. Our experiments show that higher CEFR levels make texts more difficult to translate, and that machine translation shifts the CEFR level of the target text compared to the original source, for most languages. These findings provide new insights for researchers and practitioners working on multilingual pedagogical content generation and machine translation difficulty estimation.

</details>


### [121] [Multilingual Coreference Resolution via Cycle-Consistent Machine Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05444)
*Adriana-Valentina Costache,Eduard Poesina,Silviu-Florin Gheorghe,Paul Irofti,Radu Tudor Ionescu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向低资源语言共指消解的新流水线方法：利用英到目标语言的机器翻译生成/扩充训练数据，并通过回译与BERT余弦相似度自动评估翻译质量，将相似度分数作为权重融入损失函数，在四种低资源语言上取得显著性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共指消解在下游NLP任务中应用广泛，但现有研究主要集中于英语，低资源语言受到较少关注且缺乏标注语料。作者旨在弥合这一差距，为低资源语言提供可行的共指消解训练数据生成方案。

Method: 提出一个三阶段流水线：(1) 利用机器翻译将英语共指消解标注数据翻译至目标低资源语言，生成/扩充训练样本；(2) 将翻译样本回译至英语，使用BERT模型在潜在空间中计算回译结果与原始英语样本的余弦相似度，作为翻译质量自动验证指标；(3) 将相似度分数作为样本权重集成到损失函数中，使训练过程依据机器翻译的循环一致性对不同质量的样本进行加权。

Result: 在四种低资源语言上的大量实验表明，该流水线在共指消解任务上带来了显著的性能增益，并且能够在之前完全没有可用语料的语言上实现准确的共指消解。

Conclusion: 所提出的基于机器翻译循环一致性与BERT相似度加权的训练数据生成流水线，有效解决了低资源语言共指消解训练数据匮乏的问题，证明了该方法的通用性和实用性，为低资源语言NLP任务提供了可借鉴的思路。

Abstract: Coreference resolution is a core NLP task, having a broad range of downstream applications, e.g.~machine translation, question answering, document summarization, etc. While the task is well-studied in English, comparatively less attention is dedicated to coreference resolution in other languages, especially low-resource ones. To mitigate this gap, we propose a novel coreference resolution pipeline that harnesses machine translation (MT) from English to a target low-resource language, to generate or expand training data. To automatically validate the quality of the translated samples, we back-translate the samples and assess the similarity with the original English samples via cosine similarity in the latent space of a BERT model. The resulting similarity scores are integrated into the loss function to weight training samples according to their MT cycle consistency. Extensive experiments on four low-resource languages show that our pipeline brings significant performance gains in coreference resolution. Moreover, our pipeline enables accurate coreference resolution in languages where no previous corpora were available.

</details>


### [122] [Localizing Prompt Ambiguity in Large Language Models with Probe-Targeted Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05486)
*Govind Ramesh,Yao Dou,Wei Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: PRIG 是一种基于梯度归因的方法，通过在残差流中使用线性探针（probe logit）将提示中的潜在歧义定位到具体 token 位置，在合成和人工基准上显著优于现有归因方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提示歧义是 LLM 失效的常见原因，但歧义是提示的潜在属性，难以定位。现有归因方法仅针对可观测输出（如 logits 或生成的 token）设计，无法直接归因潜在属性。

Method: 提出 PRIG（Probe Regression-based Input Gradient）：(1) 训练线性探针区分清晰提示与歧义提示；(2) 将探针分数通过梯度归因回残差流中的早期 token 表示；(3) 构建跨编程、数学和写作的合成歧义数据集（改写每个提示中的一个任务关键句），并辅以人工编写的金标准基准。

Result: PRIG 在合成基准上达到 0.840 AUROC，在金标准集上达到 0.891 AUROC，显著优于梯度归因基线；在句子级歧义识别上超越 GPT-5.4，并且在域外数据上保留有效信号。

Conclusion: PRIG 是定位提示中歧义部分的实用工具，更广泛地表明潜在提示属性可以通过中间表示而非输出级归因来定位。

Abstract: Prompt ambiguity is a common source of failure in large language models, but is difficult to localize because it is a latent property of the prompt, while existing attribution methods are designed to explain observable outputs such as logits or generated tokens. We introduce PRIG, a gradient attribution method that uses a probe logit to attribute latent ambiguity to token positions. Specifically, PRIG trains a linear probe to distinguish clear prompts from ambiguous prompts and attributes the probe score to earlier token representations in the residual stream. To enable token-level evaluation, we construct synthetic ambiguity datasets across coding, math, and writing by rewriting one task-critical sentence per prompt, and complement them with a human-written gold benchmark. In this setting, PRIG localizes ambiguous spans substantially better than gradient attribution baselines, achieving 0.840 AUROC on the combined synthetic benchmark and 0.891 AUROC on the gold set. It also outperforms GPT-5.4 on sentence-level ambiguity identification and retains useful signal out-of-domain. These results establish PRIG as a practical tool for identifying which parts of a prompt are ambiguous. More broadly, they suggest that latent prompt properties can be localized through intermediate representations, rather than through output-level attribution.

</details>


### [123] [MASF: A Multi-Model Adaptive Selection Framework for Abstractive Text summarization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05494)
*Ahmed Alansary,Ali Hamdi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种多模型自适应摘要框架，通过集成多个微调的Transformer摘要模型并引入自适应选择机制，根据自动评估指标（词汇相似度+语义相关性）从候选摘要中筛选最优输出，在CNN/DailyMail数据集上取得了88.63%的BERTScore，优于多个大语言模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单一摘要模型在面对不同结构和主题的文章时，摘要质量往往不一致，鲁棒性不足。因此需要一种能够自适应选择最优摘要的框架来克服这一局限性。

Method: 提出Multi-Model Adaptive Summarization Framework：（1）集成多个经微调的Transformer基摘要模型，各自对同一篇文章独立生成候选摘要；（2）利用自动评估指标（兼顾词汇相似度和语义相关性）对候选摘要打分；（3）基于得分选择最高质量的摘要作为最终输出。实验在CNN/DailyMail数据集上进行微调与评估。

Result: 该框架在所有对比方法中获得了最高的BERTScore（88.63%），并优于GPT3-D2、Falcon-7b、Mpt-7b等多个大语言模型，验证了其有效性和鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 利用多Transformer模型结合自适应选择策略，能够有效提升自动文本摘要系统的质量和鲁棒性，是一种优于单一模型及部分大语言模型的可行方案。

Abstract: Automatic text summarization has become increasingly important due to the rapid growth of digital textual information. This paper presents a Multi-Model Adaptive Summarization Framework designed to improve the robustness and quality of abstractive text summarization. Relying on a single model often leads to inconsistent summarization quality across articles with varying structures and topics. To address this limitation, the proposed framework integrates multiple fine-tuned transformer-based summarization models and introduces an adaptive selection mechanism. In this framework, each model independently generates a candidate summary for the same input article. The generated summaries are then evaluated using automatic evaluation metrics that capture both lexical similarity and semantic relevance. Based on these scores, the framework selects the highest-quality summary as the final output. The models are fine-tuned and evaluated on the widely used CNN/DailyMail news summarization dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves the highest BERTScore among all compared methods with a score of 88.63%. It also outperforms several LLMs such as GPT3-D2, Falcon-7b, and Mpt-7b, highlighting its effectiveness and robustness. These findings highlight the effectiveness of leveraging multiple transformer-based models within an adaptive selection strategy to improve the quality and robustness of automatic text summarization systems.

</details>


### [124] [CHASE: Adversarial Red-Blue Teaming for Improving LLM Safety using Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05523)
*Rahul Markasserithodi,Aditya Joshi,Yuekang Li,Ishmanbir Singh,Chris Yoo,Alan Niu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CHASE是一个闭环红蓝对抗框架，通过黑盒攻击者与安全防御者的共同进化，训练攻击者绕过安全过滤器，同时硬化防御者。在多个基准测试中，CHASE将平均StrongREJECT分数降低43.2%，且对良性提示的误拒率为0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全对齐方法面临提示改写攻击（如角色调制、虚构框架、说服性改写）的威胁，防御手段要么依赖不可扩展的人工筛选，要么是基于白盒优化的方法，对特定模型内部表示过拟合，难以应对部署中遇到的适应性黑盒攻击。因此需要一种可扩展、泛化性强的黑盒防御框架。

Method: 提出CHASE框架，构建闭环红蓝对抗演化系统：（1）攻击者通过分组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行训练，采用乘法奖励函数同时衡量绕过效果和意图保真度；（2）防御者通过两阶段训练硬化：GRPO + 拒绝采样SFT，并与良性数据混合以保持通用能力；（3）攻击者与防御者交替更新，形成共同进化。

Result: 在BeaverTails和JailbreakBench上针对PAIR、TAP、AutoDAN、PAP、Translation五种留出攻击族进行评估，CHASE将平均StrongREJECT分数降低43.2%，对良性提示误拒率为0%。此外，无模板的RL探索能够恢复潜在攻击原语，这些原语可跨机制不同的攻击族迁移。

Conclusion: CHASE展示了通过共同进化实现LLM安全硬化的可行路径，其泛化能力超越了当前对抗训练所达到的窄分布，为应对部署中的自适应黑盒攻击提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Despite advances in safety alignment, prompt-rewriting attacks such as persona modulation, fictional framing and persuasion-based reformulation, can bypass safety filters even on frontier models. Existing defenses either rely on non-scalable human curation or white-box optimisation that overfits to specific model internals, leaving aligned models brittle against the very class of adaptive black-box adversaries they will face in deployment. To address this gap, we introduce CHASE (Co-evolutionary Hardening through Adversarial Safety-Escalation), a closed-loop red-blue teaming framework in which a black-box attacker and a safety-aligned defender co-evolve. The attacker is trained via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) under a multiplicative reward that jointly enforces bypass effectiveness and intent fidelity, while the defender is hardened on the harvested adversarial rewrites through a two-stage GRPO + rejection-sampled SFT pipeline balanced with benign data. Evaluated on BeaverTails and JailbreakBench against five held-out attack families (PAIR, TAP, AutoDAN, PAP, Translation), CHASE cuts mean StrongREJECT score by 43.2\% with 0\% false-refusal on benign prompts. Beyond the headline result, CHASE shows that template-free RL exploration recovers latent attack primitives that transfer across mechanistically distinct attack families, suggesting a path toward LLM safety hardening that generalises beyond the narrow distributions achieved thus far in adversarial training.

</details>


### [125] [Multilingual Detection of Alzheimer's Disease from Speech: A Cross-Linguistic Transfer Learning Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05545)
*Nadine Yasser Abdelhalim,Emmanuel Akinrintoyo,Nicole Salomons*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种跨语言训练的Transformer模型，用于多语种阿尔茨海默病痴呆检测，在英语、中文、阿拉伯语和印地语上达到82%的F1分数，推理仅需0.5秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统多语种AD检测模型需要为每种语言单独训练，资源密集且耗时，本文旨在通过跨语言训练方法，实现模型在未见语言上的泛化，降低部署成本。

Method: 使用英语、中文、阿拉伯语和印地语数据集，构建基于Transformer的深度学习模型，进行二分类AD检测，并验证跨语言迁移能力。

Result: 跨语言模型在所有语言上均达到82%的F1分数，推理时间仅为0.5秒，展现出较强的跨语言泛化能力和实时筛查潜力。

Conclusion: 跨语言训练方法能有效实现多语种AD检测，性能一致且推理快速，具备全球部署和实时筛查的可行性。

Abstract: The development of multilingual Alzheimer's Disease Dementia (AD) detection models presents significant challenges due to the resource-intensive and time-consuming nature of language-specific model training. We propose a novel solution using cross-language training to detect AD in languages beyond those used for model training. This study investigates multilingual deep learning models for detecting AD across different languages and cognitive impairment levels. Using datasets in English, Chinese, Arabic, and Hindi, we developed transformer-based models for binary AD classification. Our approach achieved F1 scores of 82\% across all languages, demonstrating strong cross-linguistic generalization. The rapid inference time (0.5 seconds) supports potential real-time screening applications, while consistent performance across languages indicates feasibility for global deployment.

</details>


### [126] [ArcANE: Do Role-Playing Language Agents Stay in Character at the Right Time?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05553)
*Woojung Song,Nalim Kim,Sangjun Song,Chaewon Heo,Jongwon Lim,Yohan Jo*

Main category: cs.CL
