Empirically, despite the lightweight reward, our RL-trained models effectively extract and apply relevant linguistic information from the provided context, leading to better translations on completely unseen languages than in-context learning or supervised fine-tuning. Our analyses suggest that outcome-based RL can extend beyond conventional reasoning tasks like math and coding to serve as a recipe for language learning from context.

</details>


### [199] [Revising Context, Shifting Simulated Stance: Auditing LLM-Based Stance Simulation in Online Discussions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06443)
*Xinnong Zhang,Wanting Shan,Hanjia Lyu,Zhongyu Wei,Jiebo Luo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于反事实上下文修订的审计框架，用于评估大语言模型在模拟社交媒体用户立场时对上下文变化的敏感性，发现文本和多模态修订策略均能有效且稳健地改变模拟立场。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大语言模型越来越多地被用于模拟社交媒体用户并推断其对在线讨论的反应，但这些模拟是否真正反映用户特定信念，还是对语义无关的上下文变化高度敏感，这一问题尚不明确。因此需要建立评估框架来审计LLM立场模拟的上下文敏感性。

Method: 提出反事实上下文修订框架：首先从原始在线对话中推断目标用户对特定话题的立场，然后对对话上下文施加受控修订策略（包括纯文本修订和融入迷因的多模态修订），再次模拟用户立场。通过平均方向性立场偏移量和立场转变率两个指标评估修订效果，并考察不同极化偏好机制下的表现。

Result: 在文本和多模态两种修订策略下，均观察到有效且稳健的立场转变，这一效果在不同极化偏好机制下保持一致。

Conclusion: 该研究为理解LLM立场模拟的上下文敏感性提供了评估框架，同时揭示了使用LLM模拟在线舆论动态的前景与风险。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate social media users and infer how individuals may respond to online discussions. However, it remains unclear whether these simulations reflect precise user-specific beliefs or whether they are highly sensitive to semantically independent changes in conversational contexts. In this work, we study counterfactual context revision as a framework for auditing LLM-based stance simulation. Given an original online conversation, we first infer a target user's stance toward a specific topic. We then apply controlled revision strategies to the conversational context and simulate the user's stance again under the revised context. We compare text-only revision strategies with a multimodal one that incorporates meme-based context and evaluate two main effectiveness metrics, i.e., average directional stance shift and stance transition rate. The results reveal effective and robust stance transitions in both text-only and multimodal strategies across different polarization-preference mechanisms. Our study contributes an evaluation framework for understanding the context sensitivity of LLM-based stance simulation. More broadly, it highlights both the promise and risk of using LLMs to simulate online opinion dynamics.

</details>


### [200] [Latent Reasoning with Normalizing Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06447)
*Guancheng Tu,Xiangjun Fu,Suhao Yu,Yao Tang,Haoqiang Kang,Lianhui Qin,Yizhe Zhang,Jiatao Gu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出NF-CoT，一种利用归一化流（normalizing flows）在连续潜空间中进行中间推理的框架，既保留了链式思维（CoT）的关键优势（左到右生成、概率采样、KV缓存兼容、可处理似然估计），又在代码生成基准上以更低推理成本超越了显式CoT和先前潜推理方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 显式链式思维（CoT）虽然有效，但将中间推理强制为离散、串行的文本token流，即使底层更新是语义性的、不确定的或未完全成形的也必须逐字表达，造成带宽瓶颈。现有潜推理方法虽然用连续状态进行中间计算，但牺牲了自回归语言模型中CoT的核心优势。因此需要一种既能利用连续潜空间高带宽推理，又能保留这些关键优势的框架。

Method: 提出NF-CoT框架：(1) 在LLM骨干网络中嵌入TARFlow式归一化流，对从显式CoT蒸馏而来的紧凑连续思维（continuous thoughts）建模，提供可处理的概率模型；(2) 在同一个因果流中，用NF头生成连续思维位置，用标准LM头生成文本位置；(3) 该设计提供潜思维的精确似然，支持保留原始KV缓存进行概率性左到右解码，并支持在潜推理空间中进行直接策略梯度优化。

Result: 在代码生成基准上，NF-CoT相比显式CoT和先前潜推理基线方法提升了通过率（pass rates），同时显著降低了中间推理的计算成本。

Conclusion: NF-CoT成功地在连续潜空间中建模中间推理，弥补了显式CoT的带宽限制与现有潜推理方法的局限性之间的鸿沟，为高效、可扩展的潜推理提供了新方向。

Abstract: Large language models often improve reasoning by generating explicit chain-of-thought (CoT), demonstrating the importance of intermediate computation. However, textual CoT forces this computation through a discrete, serial, and communication-oriented token stream: each reasoning step must be verbalized before the model can proceed, even when the underlying update is semantic, uncertain, or only partially formed. Latent reasoning offers a higher-bandwidth alternative by performing intermediate computation in compact continuous states before committing to text. Yet existing latent-reasoning methods often sacrifice key advantages that make CoT effective in autoregressive language models, including native left-to-right generation, probabilistic sampling, compatibility with KV-cache decoding, and tractable likelihood estimation. We propose NF-CoT, a latent reasoning framework that preserves these advantages by modeling continuous thoughts with normalizing flows. NF-CoT instantiates a TARFlow-style normalizing flow inside the LLM backbone, defining a tractable probability model over compact continuous thoughts distilled from explicit CoT. Continuous-thought positions are generated by an NF head, while text positions are generated by the standard LM head within the same causal stream. This design provides exact likelihoods for latent thoughts, enables probabilistic left-to-right decoding with the original KV cache, and supports direct policy-gradient optimization in the latent reasoning space. On code-generation benchmarks, NF-CoT improves pass rates over explicit-CoT and prior latent-reasoning baselines while substantially reducing intermediate-reasoning cost.

</details>


### [201] [Human Adults and LLMs as Scientists: Who Benefits from Active Exploration?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06464)
*Mandana Samiei,Eunice Yiu,Anthony GX-Chen,Dongyan Lin,Jocelyn Shen,Blake A. Richards,Alison Gopnik,Doina Precup*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过主动探索范式重新检验成人的合取因果推理偏差，发现主动介入能显著提升表现，但合取规则仍难于析取规则；大语言模型也呈现类似模式，探索效率更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期以来，因果学习文献发现成人在识别合取因果规则（需要多个原因同时存在才产生效应）时表现较差，而在析取规则下表现更好，即所谓的“合取障碍”。然而，大多数相关证据来自被动观察范式，学习者无法主动控制证据的生成。本文旨在探究当成人通过主动探索获得能动性时，这种合取偏差是否依然存在。

Method: 采用改良版“blicket detector”任务，让成人参与者自由介入实验，主动探索以识别在合取或析取规则结构下的因果对象。同时，将人类表现与多种大型语言模型在同一设置下的表现进行比较。

Result: 主动探索显著改善了成人的合取因果推理能力，但合取规则仍比析取规则需要更多的测试才能推断。部分最先进的大型语言模型在假设推断准确率上接近人类水平，但它们通常表现出效率更低的探索策略，并且存在类似的合取-析取表现差距。

Conclusion: 能动性的主动探索能够部分缓解但不完全消除合取因果推理的困难，这种偏差在人类和最先进的大语言模型中均有体现，提示合取规则推理的固有限制可能跨越智能体类型。

Abstract: A long-standing finding in the causal learning literature is that adults struggle to identify conjunctive causal rules, where an effect requires the simultaneous presence of multiple causes, while performing better in disjunctive settings. However, most demonstrations of this ``conjunctive handicap'' rely on passive observation paradigms with limited evidence, where learners have no control over evidence generation. This paper asks whether this bias persists when adults are granted agency through active exploration. Using a modified ``blicket detector'' task, adult participants freely intervened to identify causal objects under conjunctive or disjunctive rule structures. We show that active exploration substantially improves adults' conjunctive causal reasoning, although conjunctive rules still require more tests to infer than disjunctive rules. We further compare human performance to a range of large language models in the same setting. While some state-of-the-art models approach human-level performance on hypothesis inference accuracy, they often exhibit less efficient exploration strategies and similar conjunctive-disjunctive performance gaps.

</details>


### [202] [You Only Index Once: Cross-Layer Sparse Attention with Shared Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06467)
*Yutao Sun,Yanqi Zhang,Li Dong,Jianyong Wang,Furu Wei*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出跨层稀疏注意力（CLSA），基于YOCO等KV共享架构，核心思想是将token级稀疏注意力的路由索引跨解码器层复用，从而在保持细粒度选择性的同时摊薄路由开销，实现最高7.6倍解码加速和17.1倍整体吞吐量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文LLM推理尤其在推理密集型场景下受解码效率制约。现有方法存在效率-质量权衡困境：结构化块稀疏方法加速明显但质量损失大，token级稀疏方法更准确但top-k全缓存路由开销高导致端到端加速有限。需要一种能兼顾细粒度选择性与低路由开销的架构方案。

Method: 提出CLSA（Cross-Layer Sparse Attention），构建于YOCO等KV共享架构之上。核心创新是不仅跨解码器层共享KV缓存，还共享路由索引：单个索引器仅执行一次token级top-k选择，生成的索引在所有层复用，从而将路由开销均摊。该架构同时改善了预填充、KV缓存存储和长上下文解码三大推理瓶颈。

Result: 在短上下文和长上下文基准测试中，CLSA兼具准确性与效率：在128K上下文长度下，实现高达7.6倍解码加速和17.1倍整体吞吐量提升。

Conclusion: CLSA为长上下文LLM提供了一种更完整的架构解决方案，能够同时提升模型质量与推理效率，打破了现有稀疏注意力方法在效率与质量之间的权衡困局。

Abstract: Long-context inference in modern LLMs is increasingly constrained by decoding efficiency, especially in reasoning-heavy settings where models generate long intermediate chains of thought. Existing sparse attention methods often face a practical efficiency-quality trade-off. Structured block sparse methods typically provide stronger acceleration but incur noticeable quality loss, while token sparse methods are usually more accurate yet deliver limited end-to-end speedup because top-k routing over the full cache remains expensive. In this work, we propose cross-layer sparse attention (CLSA), which is built on top of KV-sharing architectures such as YOCO. The core idea is to share not only the KV cache across cross-decoder layers, but also the routing index. A single indexer computes token-level top-k selection once and reuses the resulting index across layers, thereby preserving the fine-grained selectivity of token sparse attention while amortizing the routing overhead. The resulting architecture improves all major inference bottlenecks jointly, including pre-filling, KV-cache storage, and long-context decoding. Experiments across short-context and long-context benchmarks show that CLSA is both accurate and efficient, achieving up to 7.6x decoding speedup and 17.1x overall throughput improvement at 128K context. These results suggest a more complete architectural solution for long-context LLMs that jointly advances model quality and inference efficiency.

</details>


### [203] [Self-Augmenting Retrieval for Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06474)
*Paul Jünger,Justin Lovelace,Linxi Zhao,Dongyoung Go,Kilian Q. Weinberger*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SARDI利用离散扩散语言模型去噪过程中被丢弃的低置信度token作为前瞻信号，在生成完成前动态检索相关证据，从而提升多跳问答性能，且无需额外训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散语言模型每步会丢弃大量低置信度的预测token，但这些token实际上包含了有价值的实体信息。作者希望利用这些被浪费的前瞻信号，在生成最终答案前提前检索更强有力的证据，从而改善检索增强生成（RAG）的效果。

Method: 提出SARDI（Self-Augmenting Retrieval for Diffusion Language Models），一个训练无关、检索器无关的动态RAG框架。在扩散去噪的每一步，利用模型预测但未提交的低置信度token作为前瞻信号，触发检索并获取外部知识，从而在后续去噪步骤中引入检索到的证据来引导生成。

Result: 在五个多跳问答基准测试上，SARDI优于现有的训练无关扩散方法和自回归检索基线，同时实现了高达8倍的吞吐量提升。

Conclusion: 扩散语言模型去噪过程中被丢弃的token是宝贵的检索信号，SARDI框架能够有效利用这些信号实现动态RAG，在多跳推理任务上兼具高性能与高效率。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion language models generate text by iteratively denoising an entire response in parallel. At each step, they predict tentative tokens for every masked position, committing the confident predictions to the output and discarding the unconfident ones. We show that the discarded tokens are in fact a useful lookahead signal for retrieval-augmented generation: even low-confidence tokens often surface salient entities early in the denoising trajectory, enabling retrieval of stronger evidence before the output is finalized. We exploit this through Self-Augmenting Retrieval for Diffusion Language Models (SARDI), a dynamic RAG framework that uses these lookahead tokens to guide retrieval during denoising. SARDI is training-free, retriever-agnostic, and applicable to any reasoning-capable discrete diffusion language model. Across five multi-hop QA benchmarks, SARDI outperforms current training-free diffusion and autoregressive retrieval baselines at up to $8\times$ higher throughput.

</details>


### [204] [Operation-Guided Progressive Human-to-AI Text Transformation Benchmark for Multi-Granularity AI-Text Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06481)
*Sondos Mahmoud Bsharat,Jiacheng Liu,Xiaohan Zhao,Tianjun Yao,Xinyi Shang,Yi Tang,Jiacheng Cui,Ahmed Elhagry,Salwa K. Al Khatib,Hao Li,Salman Khan,Zhiqiang Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: OpAI-Bench是一个操作引导的基准测试，用于研究从人类撰写到AI辅助编辑过程中文本作者身份信号的渐进式变化，揭示了AI文本可检测性不仅取决于AI编辑比例，还受编辑操作类型、领域和累积修订历史影响，并发现混合作者身份的中间版本往往比两端更难检测的非单调模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI文本检测基准主要关注最终输出，忽略了人类与AI逐步协同编辑过程中AI作者身份信号如何产生、积累或消失的动态过程，缺乏对渐进式人机协同写作场景下的细粒度理解。

Method: 提出OpAI-Bench，从人类撰写的文档出发，在预定义的AI覆盖水平和五种代表性AI编辑操作下，为每个样本构建九个顺序修订版本，覆盖四个领域，并在文档、句子、令牌和片段四个粒度级别保留完整的作者身份溯源。基准支持8个文档级检测器、7个句子级检测器和2个细粒度令牌/片段级检测器的综合评估。

Result: 实验表明，AI文本可检测性并非仅由AI编辑内容的比例决定，还受编辑操作类型、领域和累积修订历史的共同影响。混合作者身份的中间版本往往比完全人类撰写和高度AI编辑的两个端点更难检测，暴露出非单调的检测模式。

Conclusion: OpAI-Bench为分析AI辅助写作在真实渐进式编辑场景下是否、何时以及如何变得可检测提供了一个受控测试平台，填补了现有基准在渐进式人机协同编辑评估方面的空白。

Abstract: As AI writing assistants become increasingly integrated into real-world drafting and revision workflows, many documents are no longer purely human-written or AI-generated, but instead result from progressive human-AI co-editing. However, existing AI-text detection benchmarks largely focus on final outputs and provide limited understanding of how AI authorship signals emerge, accumulate, or disappear throughout the revision process. We introduce OpAI-Bench, an operation-guided benchmark for studying progressive human-to-AI text transformation across document, sentence, token, and span granularities. Starting from human-written documents, OpAI-Bench constructs nine sequentially revised versions for each sample under predefined AI coverage levels and five representative AI edit operations, covering four domains while preserving complete authorship provenance at multiple granularities. The benchmark supports comprehensive evaluation with 8 document-level detectors, 7 sentence-level detectors, and 2 fine-grained token/span-level detectors. Experiments reveal that AI-text detectability is governed not only by the proportion of AI-edited content, but also by edit operation, domain, and cumulative revision history. Interestingly, we notice that mixed-authorship intermediate versions are often harder to detect than both fully human and heavily AI-edited endpoints, exposing non-monotonic detection patterns missed by existing benchmarks. OpAI-Bench provides a controlled testbed for analyzing whether, when, and how AI-assisted writing becomes detectable under realistic progressive editing scenarios. Our code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/OpAI-Bench.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [205] [The Evaluation Blind Spot: A Stereological Theory of Benchmark Coverage for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05169)
*Jason Z Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了LLM基准测试覆盖度的立体学理论，揭示了评测套件的有效维度d_eff在2.86-4.80之间，结构盲区远超报告分数差距，并证明了排名高度不稳定（top-1模型92%试验中发生交换）。作者还独立解决了Gardner 1995年提出的开问题1.5，建立了C²支撑函数在一般维度上的极小极大速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM评测普遍依赖固定的基准测试排行榜，但基准测试套件隐含的低维结构可能导致对模型能力的高估与排名的不稳定——即使分数相同，真实能力差异可能被结构性盲区掩盖。作者旨在量化基准测试覆盖度的几何极限，揭示排行榜在多大程度上可信。

Method: （1）将LLM能力建模为凸能力轮廓，用有效维度d_eff刻画评测套件的覆盖度，推导可见Hausdorff距离的上界及匹配的Lipschitz下界；（2）在三个独立排行榜上实证估计d_eff，量化结构盲区与统计噪声的相对大小；（3）卡方投影模型下模拟多种隐藏能力先验，计算半拆分交换率；（4）用子模贪婪算法（含Nemhauser (1-1/e)保证）寻找最小基准核心集；（5）反事实验证：在12个内部基准和27个Chatbot Arena类别上检验特征结构对评测可替代性的预测力；（6）独立理论贡献：用S^(D-1)上的最优恢复理论解决Gardner问题1.5。

Result: 三个排行榜的竞争前沿上d_eff ∈ [2.86, 4.80]；结构盲区超过亚军分数差距两个数量级，主导统计噪声52-127倍。六种先验和四个环境维度下，top-2模型的半拆分交换率在[0.38, 0.49]；500次试验中92%交换top-1，平均5个top-5模型中有2.83个变化。子模选择找到4个基准的稳定核心，7/12即可达90%覆盖，跨季度迁移保持率93-97%。反事实验证：特征结构预测移除破坏性ρ=-0.69(p=0.013)，预测外部评测新信息ρ=+0.38。理论上给出Gardner问题1.5的极小极大速率Θ(R/(κ m^(2/(D-1))))。

Conclusion: LLM基准测试排行榜因评测套件的内在低维性而系统性不可靠：有效维度极低（≈3-5），排名在可见/不可见任务拆分下高度不稳定。可通过子模选择识别高信息量基准核心，实现高效覆盖。这一立体学框架为理解和改进LLM评测提供了严格的几何基础。

Abstract: We give a stereological theory of LLM benchmark coverage. For any suite with effective dimensionality d_eff, the visible Hausdorff distance between two convex capability profiles consistent with the same scores is bounded by epsilon + C R m^(-1/(d_eff-1)), with matching Lipschitz lower bound. Empirically, three independent leaderboards (Open LLM v2, an extended 12-benchmark suite, LiveBench) all have d_eff in [2.86, 4.80] on their competitive frontier; the structural blind spot exceeds the observed runner-up score gap by two orders of magnitude and dominates statistical noise by 52-127x. Under a chi-squared projection model, the isotropic prior is the optimistic case; across six hidden-capability priors and four ambient dimensions the simulated half-split swap rate of the top two models stays in [0.38, 0.49], and a 500-trial random visible/held-out split shows that 92% of trials swap the top-1 ranking with on average 2.83 of 5 top-5 models changing. A submodular greedy algorithm with the Nemhauser (1 - 1/e) guarantee finds a stable core of 4 benchmarks; 7 of 12 suffice for 90% coverage, and the trained subset transfers across temporal quarters with 93-97% retention. A counterfactual validation across 12 internal benchmarks and 27 Chatbot Arena categories confirms that the eigenstructure predicts which evaluations are irreplaceable (rho = -0.69, p = 0.013 for removal disruption) and which external evaluations bring new information (rho = +0.38). As a second, independent theoretical contribution, we resolve Gardner's Problem 1.5 (1995) for C^2 support functions, establishing the minimax rate Theta(R/(kappa m^(2/(D-1)))) in general dimension via optimal recovery theory on S^(D-1).

</details>


### [206] [ERRORQUAKE: Heavy-Tailed Error Severity Distributions in Open-Weight Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05170)
*Jason Z Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出，在精度匹配的情况下，开源大语言模型在错误严重性分布上存在显著差异，而这种差异无法被单一的标量错误率捕捉。作者构建了 Errorquake-10k 基准（万条查询，0-4连续严重度评分），为21个模型拟合严重性分布指数 b，发现210个模型对中有85对在匹配精度下 b 的95%置信区间不重叠。同时给出了不可约性定理，证明严重性剖面与错误率在信息上非冗余，并揭示了错误类型的严重性机制分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前幻觉基准测试仅报告单一错误计数，将所有错误视为等价，但"错误日期"与"虚构的法院裁决"严重性相差数个量级。由此产生的核心动机是：标量错误率无法揭示模型间在错误严重性分布上的结构性差异，需要一个新的评估维度来捕捉这种被掩盖的模型行为差异。

Method: 1. 构建 Errorquake-10k 基准：10,000条查询，覆盖8个领域和5个难度层级，每条回答在0-4连续严重度量表上评分；2. 对21个开源模型拟合严重性分布指数 b（借鉴Gutenberg-Richter上尾斜率），并计算95% Bootstrap置信区间；3. 进行519条三人评分的人类验证研究，计算ICC(2,k=3)和排名相关性；4. 证明不可约性定理：条件互信息 I(b; model | ε) = 1.56 bits，64.5%的跨模型 b 方差无法由 ε 解释；5. 进行严重性机制分类（κ=0.83），分析不同严重性层级下的错误类型构成及其与模型规模的关系。

Result: 1. 210个模型对中，85对在匹配精度（|Δε| < 0.05）下 b 的95%置信区间不相交（如 deepseek-v3.2 vs. ministral-14b，ε=0.586，Δb=0.47）；2. 人类验证：ICC(2,k=3)=0.85，LLM评判与人类排名相关性 ρ=0.89，在人类数据上密集模型规模与严重性的 Spearman 相关性 ρ_s=-0.86；3. 不可约性定理：严重性剖面与错误率信息非冗余，条件互信息1.56 bits；4. 错误类型随严重性发生类别转换：低严重性错误以检索失败为主（71%），高严重性错误以虚构为主（39%），且该构成比受模型规模显著影响（p<0.0001）。

Conclusion: 严重性分布应与准确率并列报告。它携带了错误率无法提供的判别信息，揭示模型在错误严重性上的系统性差异以及错误类型随严重性等级的类别转换。论文建议以严重性分布指数 b 作为模型评估的补充维度，扩展当前仅依赖标量错误率的评估范式。

Abstract: At matched accuracy, open-weight LLMs differ substantially in the shape of their error severity distribution -- a difference invisible to the scalar error rate. Hallucination benchmarks report a single error count and treat all errors as equivalent, yet a wrong date and a fabricated court ruling differ by orders of magnitude. We introduce Errorquake-10k, a 10,000-query benchmark scoring each response on a continuous 0-4 severity scale across 8 domains and 5 difficulty tiers, and we fit per-model severity distributions for 21 open-weight models. For each model we estimate a severity distribution index (b, the Gutenberg-Richter upper-tail slope) with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. Headline: across the 210 model pairs, 85 have disjoint 95% b confidence intervals at matched accuracy (|Delta epsilon| < 0.05) on human-consensus scoring, e.g. deepseek-v3.2 vs. ministral-14b at epsilon = 0.586 and Delta b = 0.47. A 519-item three-rater human validation study confirms measurement reliability (ICC(2,k=3) = 0.85), validates the LLM-judge ranking (rho = 0.89), and confirms the dense-model scaling correlation on human data (rho_s = -0.86). We prove a Non-Reducibility Theorem showing that severity profile and error rate are informationally non-redundant (I(b; model | epsilon) = 1.56 bits; 64.5% of cross-model b variance is unexplained by epsilon). A severity mechanism taxonomy (kappa = 0.83) reveals that error type shifts categorically with severity: low-severity errors are retrievals (71%); high-severity errors are fabrications (39%) -- and this composition differs by model size (p < 0.0001). Severity distribution should be reported alongside accuracy; it carries discriminative information that the error rate cannot.

</details>


### [207] [Staged Factorial Screening for Budget-Constrained Micro-Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05186)
*Felipe Chavarro Polania*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在预算受限的微型预训练场景下，本文验证了分阶段分数阶乘实验设计能否在共享加速器上稳定恢复早期效应结构。通过613次实验（涵盖2、5、10分钟筛选、种子重跑、锚点检查、60分钟桥接及24小时延续），发现总批次、深度和宽度在短预算时惩罚最大，随预算增加而松弛。桥接锚点在60分钟及24小时延续中均具最低均值，但非桥接排序受主机影响。结论建议：使用短时设计筛选识别高惩罚方向，通过重复运行确认锚点，并在缩减空间内局部优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预算受限的微型预训练需要在投入更大搜索预算前，在共享加速器上快速筛选众多候选方案。然而，短时训练下的效应结构是否稳定、能否通过分阶段分数阶乘设计可靠恢复，尚不明确。

Method: 在固定的单GPU训练循环上，运行613次实验：包括2、5、10分钟的试点和后续筛选；5和10分钟的完整16条件种子重跑；目标化种子锚点检查；同主机贪婪基线和匹配成本随机基线；60分钟桥接包；以及在Windows A100和Linux L40S上的有界24小时锚点延续。使用Benjamini-Hochberg校正评估因子效应显著性。

Result: 总批次、深度和宽度的惩罚在短预算时最大，随预算增加而松弛。在预声明的种子全筛选家族中，D、A、B、C在5和10分钟经校正后仍保留非零估计，E则未保留。随机搜索可找到强候选但缺乏因子归因。60分钟桥接锚点均值最低，但无法分离工作流改进与模型容量优势。24小时延续中，桥接均值最低，非桥接排序与主机相关。

Conclusion: 提出一个有界方法结果：使用短设计筛选识别高惩罚方向，通过重复运行确认有前景的锚点，并在缩减空间内局部优化。证据支持桥接中心化推荐至24小时，但不支持硬件不变的排序或通用的超参数优化优越性。

Abstract: Budget-constrained micro-pretraining often requires triaging many candidate recipes on a shared accelerator before larger search budgets are spent. We study whether a staged fractional-factorial workflow can recover stable early effect structure in this setting. On a fixed autoresearch-derived single-GPU training loop, we run 613 experiments across pilot and follow-up screens at 2, 5, and 10 minutes; full 16-condition seeded reruns at 5 and 10 minutes; targeted seeded anchor checks; same-host greedy and matched-cost random baselines; a 60-minute bridge package; and bounded Windows A100 and Linux L40S anchor continuations through 24 hours. Main penalties from total batch, depth, and width are largest at short budgets and relax as budget increases. Within the predeclared seeded full-screen families, D, A, B, and C retain non-zero estimates at 5 and 10 minutes after within-budget Benjamini-Hochberg correction, while E does not. Random search can reach strong incumbents in this 32-condition space, but repeatedly in the same low-penalty region and without factor attribution. The 60-minute bridge anchor has the lowest mean, although that package does not separate workflow refinement from the larger bridge model's capacity advantage. In bounded 12-hour and 24-hour three-anchor continuations on both hosts, the bridge has the lowest sample mean while the non-bridge ordering stays host-sensitive. We therefore present a bounded methods result: use short designed screens to identify high-penalty directions, confirm promising anchors under repeated runs, and refine locally inside the reduced space. The evidence supports a bridge-centered recommendation through 24 hours on two hosts, not hardware-invariant ranking or general hyperparameter-optimization superiority.

</details>


### [208] [PyCC.id: A package for hypothesis-driven equation discovery with structural identifiability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05191)
*Federico J. Gonzalez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PyCC 是一个 Python 库，它将基于特征曲线（CC）骨架的假设驱动方程发现方法工程化，通过预定义骨架结合领域先验，在结构可辨识性保障下从时序数据中推断常微分方程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驱动方程发现作为逆问题存在病态性，常产生多个拟合良好的候选模型。现有方法虽通过先验约束缩小搜索空间，但仍需依赖专家后验手动筛选。亟需一种系统化、可迭代、具有结构可辨识性保障的假设驱动框架。

Method: 基于特征曲线启发的结构"骨架"方法论：从业者定义与一族 ODE 关联的骨架，利用领域知识迭代添加假设与先验来精化模型。骨架具有可证明的结构可辨识性，可用于检验骨架正确性。框架具有模块化特性，支持神经网络、符号回归、稀疏回归等多种方程发现范式。本文将该方法论凝结为 PyCC Python 库。

Result: PyCC 库为研究人员和工程师提供了一个灵活的工具，可无缝定义骨架和假设，从时间依赖数据中发现 ODE。

Conclusion: PyCC 将假设驱动的方程发现方法论工具化，通过骨架定义、结构可辨识性检验与模块化求解器集成，显著降低了从时序数据中发现微分方程的门槛，推进了可解释、可验证的科学机器学习实践。

Abstract: Data-driven equation discovery is fundamentally an inverse problem that seeks to infer the governing differential equations of a system directly from time-series measurements. A known issue is the ill-conditioned nature of the inverse problem, which frequently produces multiple mathematical models that fit the data similarly well. One path to address this issue is by incorporating known hypotheses and constraints into the training phase beforehand. While this approach effectively reduces the search space, it still results in multiple candidate models, forcing practitioners to rely on post-hoc manual filtering based on their own domain expertise. A recent approach incorporates structural `skeletons' inspired by characteristic curves (CCs), defining a hypothesis-driven methodology. In this methodology, practitioners define a skeleton, which is associated with a family of ordinary differential equations (ODEs), and then add their hypotheses and priors based on their domain knowledge to refine the obtained model iteratively. An important advantage of this approach is that some skeletons have demonstrable structural identifiability properties, which are useful for checking whether the skeleton is correct or should be discarded. Furthermore, this formalism enables the use of multiple equation discovery paradigms due to its modularity (such as neural networks, symbolic regression, and sparse regression). In this work, we present the Python library PyCC, which condenses these efforts into a flexible tool that allows researchers and engineers to seamlessly define their skeletons and hypotheses to discover ODEs from time-dependent data.

</details>


### [209] [Temporal Preference Concepts and their Functions in a Large Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05194)
*Ian Rios-Sialer,Shantanu Darveshi,Shuai Jiang,Avigya Paudel,Anastasiia Pronina,Ipshita Bandyopadhyay,Justin Shenk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过对蒸馏LLM（Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507）的机制可解释性分析，作者因果定位了编码时间偏好的子图，发现模型对未来折扣远低于人类但跨情境不稳定，并探索了通过引导向量操纵时间偏好的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越多地用于需要权衡短期收益与长期后果的决策场景，但对其内部如何表征和解决这类时间权衡几乎一无所知。理解这一机制有助于实现对模型规划和推理的可靠控制。

Method: 以Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507为目标模型，综合使用梯度归因和激活修补两种方法收敛定位中层到上层的关键节点，因果定位时间偏好子图；通过残差流分析揭示时间范围的几何编码方式；进行行为分析比较模型与人类的时间折扣差异及跨情境稳定性；最后探索引导向量对时间偏好的调控效果。

Result: 时间偏好的底层子图被定位在中到上层；时间范围的几何信息编码在预期层的残差流中；未经干预的LLM对未来折扣程度比人类低数倍，但偏好跨情境不稳定；引导向量可初步实现时间偏好的偏移。

Conclusion: 机制可解释性方法能够揭示并操控LLM中的时间偏好表征，这为实现对模型长期规划与推理的可靠控制迈出了重要一步。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being deployed to make decisions that require trading off near-term gains against long-term consequences, yet little is known about how they internally represent or resolve these tradeoffs. In this work, we causally localize an underlying subgraph for temporal preference in a distilled LLM (Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507), identifying mid-to-upper-layer nodes through converging evidence from gradient-based attribution and activation patching. We find that the geometry of time horizon is encoded in the residual stream at the expected localized layers. A behavioral analysis reveals that unintervened LLMs discount the future several times less steeply than humans, yet this preference is unstable across contexts, motivating explicit control rather than implicit reliance on training. Finally, we find suggestive evidence that steering vectors can shift temporal preference. Our work demonstrates how mechanistic interpretability can bring us closer to reliable control over how LLMs plan and reason

</details>


### [210] [State commitment learning: training language models to distinguish computation from memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05201)
*Fei Ding,Yongkang Zhang,Runhao Liu,Yuhao Liao,Zijian Zeng,Huiming Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对推理语言模型中的“隐藏思维依赖”问题，提出状态承诺学习目标及反事实擦除强化学习（CERL）方法，使得模型在擦除中间推理过程后仍能保持答案正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前推理语言模型将计算用 token 与持久状态 token 混为一谈，所有隐藏思维一经生成便保留在上下文中，导致下游推理可能依赖失败尝试、死胡同或不应被后续依赖的草稿内容，造成推理脆弱性和不可靠性。

Method: 首先定义“持久状态充分性”这一反事实准则，用于衡量擦除隐藏思维后答案是否依然可用；进而提出反事实擦除强化学习（CERL），在同一前缀下分别评估保留隐藏思维和擦除隐藏思维两条路径，仅当擦除路径答案仍正确时给予奖励；同时引入擦除依赖协议（Erasure Dependence Protocol）进行系统性评测。

Result: 在数学推理、长链逻辑、科学问答及多轮工具使用等多个评测场景中，CERL 在保持准确率不降的前提下，显著降低了答案对隐藏思维的依赖，且效果一致性地优于仅使用正确性奖励的强化学习和长答案 SFT 基线。

Conclusion: 通过状态承诺学习和 CERL，可以使推理模型学会将临时计算与持久状态解耦，擦除中间草稿后答案依然鲁棒可用，这为解决推理模型中的隐藏状态依赖问题提供了有效的训练范式。

Abstract: Reasoning language models do not distinguish tokens used for computation from tokens that constitute persistent state: once generated, all hidden thoughts remain in context and influence future predictions. As a result, downstream reasoning may depend on failed attempts, dead ends, and private scratch work that should not be safely relied on later. We recast this phenomenon as a new training objective, state commitment learning: training models to explicitly distinguish information that should be committed as persistent state from temporary computation that can be discarded. We define a counterfactual criterion, persistent-state sufficiency, which makes it trainable and measurable whether an answer remains usable after hidden thoughts are erased. We then propose Counterfactual Erasure RL (CERL), which evaluates, under the same prefix, both a path that keeps hidden thoughts and a path that erases them, and gives reward only when the erasure path remains correct. We also introduce the Erasure Dependence Protocol and show across mathematics, long-chain logic, scientific QA, and multi-turn tool-use evaluation that CERL substantially reduces answer dependence on hidden thoughts without sacrificing accuracy, consistently outperforming correctness-only RL and long-answer SFT baselines.

</details>


### [211] [Gradient Descent with Large Step Size Restores Symmetry in Deep Linear Networks with Multi-Pathway](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05219)
*Hee-Sung Kim,Sungyoon Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了深度线性网络多路径竞争中，大步长梯度下降与梯度流的不同行为：梯度流预测"赢者通吃"的单一通路特化，而大步长GD在稳定边缘的振荡会覆盖这一趋势，驱使网络进入信号在多通路间重新分布的再平衡阶段，最终倾向于共享表示而非持续的单通路主导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前对多通路深度线性网络的分析基于梯度流，预测路径对称性会打破，形成"赢者通吃"的特化现象——每个特征集中在单一通路。然而，实际训练使用的是离散梯度下降，尤其是大步长条件下，其动力学行为可能与梯度流存在本质差异。本文旨在揭示这种差异并阐明深度如何塑造通路竞争。

Method: 作者对比分析了梯度流（GF）与离散梯度下降（GD）在多通路深度线性网络中的动力学。理论上证明了单路径解是尖锐极小值，而跨通路分布信号可降低尖锐度，降低幅度随通路数和深度增加而增大。进一步分析了稳定边缘（Edge of Stability）处的振荡如何覆盖早期训练中深度驱动的对称性打破，导致信号重新分布。

Result: （1）单路径解是尖锐极小值，信号跨通路分布可降低尖锐度，降低因子随通路数和深度递减；（2）早期训练确实重现了梯度流预测的深度驱动对称性打破；（3）但稳定边缘处的振荡随后覆盖了这一趋势，驱动网络进入再平衡阶段，信号重新在多通路间分布；（4）大学习率GD最终倾向于共享表示而非单一通路主导。

Conclusion: 深度通过影响损失景观的尖锐度来塑造通路竞争，但大步长GD在稳定边缘的振荡动力学从根本上改变了最终收敛结果，使网络偏好共享表示。这解释了为什么实际训练中大步长GD不会导致持续的"赢者通吃"现象。

Abstract: Recent analyses of multi-pathway Deep Linear Networks use Gradient Flow to predict a "winner-takes-all" specialization in which path symmetry breaks and each feature concentrates in a single pathway. In this work, we show that discrete Gradient Descent (GD) with a large step size tells a different story. We prove that single-path solutions are sharp minima, whereas distributing signals across pathways reduces sharpness by a factor that decreases with both the number of pathways and depth. Consequently, while early training reproduces the depth-driven symmetry breaking predicted by GF, oscillations at the Edge of Stability subsequently override this tendency and drive the network into a re-balancing phase, where signals redistribute across pathways. Together, these results clarify how depth shapes pathway competition and explain why large-step GD favors shared representations rather than persistent single-pathway dominance.

</details>


### [212] [Differentiable Efficient Operator Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05232)
*Xiaohuan Pei,Jiyuan Zhang,Yuanfan Guo,Weiguo Feng,Tao Huang,Cho-Jui Hsieh,Chang Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种可微分的"高效算子搜索"框架，将手工设计的token缩减算子（剪枝、合并、池化、自适应加权）统一到共享算子空间中，通过联合搜索token缩减位置、保留数量和融合方式，自动发现超越人工设计的混合算子，在激进视觉token缩减下取得有竞争力的精度-效率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态基础模型的高效推理依赖人工设计的token缩减算子（如剪枝、合并、池化等），这些算子看似不同但存在内在联系。人工设计不仅耗时，且无法穷举组合空间，难以在激进压缩下找到最优方案。因此需要一种自动化搜索框架来系统探索算子设计空间。

Method: 提出Efficient Operator Search——一个可微分框架：1）将token缩减操作统一到共享算子空间，通过参数化层激活状态、保留预算和算子行为来描述设计空间；2）在该空间上构建可微分搜索策略，联合优化"在哪里缩减""保留多少token""如何处理被缩减token的信息"三个维度；3）在单边预算和成本约束下优化任务性能；4）通过松弛离散选择实现端到端可微分搜索，手工设计的代表性baseline均可作为特例被该搜索空间覆盖。

Result: 在多模态基准上，搜索到的算子取得了有竞争力的精度-效率权衡，尤其在激进视觉token缩减场景下表现突出；搜索发现的混合算子超越了孤立的手工设计。

Conclusion: 高效多模态推理可以从手工算子设计转变为可微分算子搜索的新范式，Efficient Operator Search框架验证了该范式的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: Efficient multimodal foundation models often rely on manually designed token-reduction operators, such as pruning, merging, pooling, and adaptive reweighting. Although these operators appear different, we show that they can be interpreted as distinct regimes of a shared operator space. Based on this view, we introduce Efficient Operator Search, a differentiable framework that jointly searches where to reduce tokens, how many tokens to retain, and how reduced token information should be processed. The proposed search space parameterizes layer activation, retention budget, and operator behavior, while the search policy optimizes task performance under one-sided budget and cost constraints. This formulation recovers representative hand-designed baselines as special cases and further discovers hybrid operators beyond isolated manual designs. Experiments on multimodal benchmarks show that the searched operators achieve competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-offs, especially under aggressive visual-token reduction. These results suggest that efficient multimodal inference can be reframed from manual operator design to differentiable operator search.

</details>


### [213] [DiffSlack: Learning under Nonlinear Inequality Constraints via Learnable Slack Variables](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05247)
*Ziqian Wang,Chenxi Fang,Zhen Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DiffSlack 是一种可微分投影层，通过引入可学习的松弛变量将非线性不等式约束转化为等式，并利用阻尼高斯-牛顿投影将神经网络输出映射到可行流形上，实现端到端的硬约束嵌入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经网络硬约束方法在处理大规模耦合非线性不等式约束时，要么对约束集施加结构性限制，要么引入高额计算开销，难以兼顾效率与通用性。

Method: 提出 DiffSlack 层：(1) 将不等式约束重构为带可学习松弛变量的等式约束，松弛变量由网络预测，作为投影的 data-driven 热启动；(2) 采用阻尼高斯-牛顿法将原始预测投影到增广可行流形，保持端到端可微；(3) 设计两阶段课程学习策略以稳定训练并提升约束满足率。

Result: 在包含 200 个非线性不等式约束（碰撞避免、曲率限制、航点间距）的车辆路径规划任务上，DiffSlack 在相当推理预算下，规划成功率和几何约束满足率均优于现有基线方法。消融实验表明硬投影层降低了对监督质量的敏感性。CARLA 闭环跟踪和实车实验验证了生成轨迹的可执行性。

Conclusion: DiffSlack 为将硬不等式约束嵌入神经网络提供了一种实用且可扩展的方案，适用于大规模非线性约束的工程应用场景。

Abstract: Enforcing nonlinear inequality constraints in neural networks remains challenging, especially when the output is subject to many coupled constraints. Existing hard constraint methods often impose structural restrictions on the constraint set or introduce substantial computational overhead for large-scale nonlinear problems. Here, we propose DiffSlack, a differentiable projection layer for nonlinear inequality-constrained neural prediction. DiffSlack reformulates inequalities as equalities with learnable slack variables, which are predicted as part of the augmented network output and provide a data-driven warm start for damped Gauss-Newton projection. The projection layer maps raw predictions onto the augmented feasible manifold while preserving end-to-end differentiability. A two-stage curriculum further stabilizes training and improves constraint satisfaction. We evaluate DiffSlack on vehicle path planning with 200 nonlinear inequality constraints from collision avoidance, curvature limits, and waypoint spacing. Compared with existing learning-based baselines, DiffSlack achieves a higher planning success rate and stronger geometric constraint satisfaction under a comparable inference budget. Ablation studies further show that the hard projection layer reduces sensitivity to supervision quality. Closed-loop tracking in CARLA and real-world vehicle experiments confirms the executability of the generated trajectories. These results demonstrate that DiffSlack provides a practical and scalable approach to embedding hard inequality constraints into neural networks for engineering applications.

</details>


### [214] [Mitigating the Curse of Dimensionality in Uniform Convergence of Deep Neural Networks via Smooth Activations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05599)
*Yizhe Ding,Runze Li,Jia Liu,Lingzhou Xue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文为平滑激活的深度神经网络估计量建立了一致收敛的理论框架。作者证明了标准ReLU网络在最小二乘估计下的一致收敛会遭遇维度灾难，而平滑深度网络（如使用光滑激活函数的前馈和残差网络）能够通过自适应利用目标函数的低维层次结构来缓解这一问题，并在Huber、最小二乘、分位数和逻辑回归等多种统计背景下推导出非渐近一致收敛速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准ReLU网络虽在L²范数下达到 minimax 最优速率，但在需要最坏情况可靠性保证的下游任务中，其一致收敛行为缺乏理论保障。作者通过理论下界揭示了ReLU网络在一致收敛意义下会遭遇维度灾难，从而引出对平滑激活深度网络一致收敛性质进行系统理论分析的需求。

Method: 作者首先建立理论下界证明ReLU最小二乘估计量在一致收敛中的维度灾难；随后针对平滑深度网络（包含前馈和残差结构）建立新的伪维度界、非渐近逼近保证以及逼近算子的Hölder范数界；最后利用这些结果，在Huber回归、最小二乘回归、分位数回归和逻辑回归等多种统计框架下统一推导出非渐近一致收敛速率。

Result: 平滑深度网络能够通过自适应利用目标函数的低维层次组合结构来缓解一致收敛中的维度灾难，在多种统计学习任务中均获得了非渐近一致收敛速率保证。仿真实验和实际应用进一步验证了理论结果的有效性。

Conclusion: 平滑深度网络在需要一致收敛保证的统计学习任务中，是ReLU网络在理论和实践上均具优势的可行替代方案。该工作为平滑DNN在需要最坏情况可靠性保证的场景中的应用奠定了理论基础。

Abstract: This paper establishes a theoretical framework for the uniform convergence of smoothly activated deep neural network (DNN) estimators. While standard ReLU networks achieve minimax-optimal rates in the $L^2(P)$ norm for various nonparametric regression tasks, we establish a theoretical lower bound demonstrating that least-squares ReLU estimators can suffer from the curse of dimensionality in their uniform convergence behavior. Motivated by the need for reliable uniform guarantees in downstream tasks requiring worst-case reliability, we address this limitation by analyzing smoothly activated DNNs (smooth DNNs), encompassing both feedforward and residual structures. We establish novel pseudo-dimension bounds, non-asymptotic approximation guarantees, and Hölder-norm bounds for the approximators of these models. Leveraging these results, we derive non-asymptotic uniform convergence rates for smooth DNN estimators across multiple statistical contexts, including Huber, least-squares, quantile, and logistic regression. We prove that smooth DNNs can mitigate the {curse of dimensionality} in uniform convergence by adaptively exploiting the low-dimensional hierarchical composition structure of the target function. Supported by both simulation studies and a real-world application, our results position smooth DNNs as a theoretically grounded and practically viable alternative to ReLU networks for statistical learning tasks requiring uniform guarantees.

</details>


### [215] [Alpha-RTL: Test-Time Training for RTL Hardware Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05253)
*Peilong Zhou,Zhirong Chen,Cangyuan Li,Haoyu Gao,Kaiyan Chang,Ziming Qu,Ying Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TTT-RTL 提出首个按设计进行测试时训练的框架，将 LLM 策略与 EDA 流水线闭环，通过 PUCT 设计状态池重用高奖励变体，并引入自适应 KL-budget 控制器稳定训练，在 RTL 优化上将几何平均 PPA 降低 65.1%，显著优于冻结策略基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 基 RTL 生成方法要么在部署前训练通用生成器，要么在测试时用冻结策略搜索，缺乏针对具体设计问题的在线策略适应能力。本文旨在利用测试时可执行 EDA 反馈，使 LLM 策略针对当前特定 RTL 问题进行自适应优化，从功能正确性迈向物理优化。

Method: 提出 TTT-RTL 框架：1）采样候选 RTL 实现，通过语法检查和仿真验证；2）用综合产生的 PPA 乘积对有效设计打分；3）通过 PUCT 索引的设计状态池重用高奖励变体；4）用熵策略梯度目标更新策略；5）引入自适应 KL-budget 控制器，利用参考 KL、有效样本量和奖励饱和信号调整熵约束，以稳定稀疏或平台期奖励下的策略更新。

Result: 在 RTLLM v2.0（Nangate 45nm）上，TTT-RTL 将几何平均 PPA 乘积降低 65.1%，远超最强冻结策略基线的 26.1%。在 XuanTie C910 FPU 前导零预测单元（Sky130）上，实现 59.4% 的 ADP 降低。消融实验证实策略适应、状态重用和 KL-budget 控制各自均有贡献。

Conclusion: 测试时训练结合可执行 EDA 反馈，能够推动 LLM 基 RTL 生成超越功能正确性，实现物理优化。TTT-RTL 作为首个按设计测试时训练框架，验证了该范式的有效性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown increasing promise in generating
  functionally correct register-transfer-level (RTL) hardware designs.
  Recent systems improve further through EDA-integrated reinforcement
  learning with syntax, simulation, and PPA rewards, but train a general
  RTL generator before deployment while test-time approaches search with
  a frozen policy. We instead perform reinforcement learning at test time,
  allowing the LLM policy to adapt to executable EDA feedback for the
  specific RTL problem at hand. We propose TTT-RTL, to our knowledge the
  first per-design test-time training framework that closes the loop
  between an LLM policy and an EDA pipeline for RTL optimization. TTT-RTL
  samples candidate implementations, verifies them through syntax checking
  and simulation, scores valid designs using synthesis-derived PPA product,
  reuses high-reward variants through a PUCT-indexed design-state pool,
  and updates the policy with an entropic policy-gradient objective. To
  stabilize policy updates under sparse or plateaued rewards, we introduce
  an adaptive KL-budget controller that adjusts the entropy constraint
  using reference KL, effective sample size, and reward saturation signals.
  On RTLLM v2.0 under Nangate 45nm, TTT-RTL reduces the geometric-mean
  PPA product by 65.1% over the reference, outperforming the strongest
  published frozen-policy agent baseline at 26.1%. On an industrial
  XuanTie C910 FPU leading-zero-anticipation unit under Sky130, TTT-RTL
  achieves a 59.4% ADP reduction, and ablations confirm that policy
  adaptation, state reuse, and KL-budget control each contribute. These
  results suggest that test-time training with executable EDA feedback can
  move LLM-based RTL generation beyond functional correctness toward
  physically optimized hardware.

</details>


### [216] [Flash-WAM: Modality-Aware Distillation for World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05254)
*Arman Akbari,Ci Zhang,Arash Akbari,Lin Zhao,Yixiao Chen,Weiwei Chen,Xuan Zhang,Geng Yuan,Yanzhi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Flash-WAM 提出一种模态感知的步蒸馏框架，通过为视频和动作流分别匹配其噪声机制的一致性函数（视频用方差保持参数化，动作用线性梯度缩放参数化），将世界-动作模型的推理从数十步压缩至单步，实现23倍加速和实时控制，同时保持高任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界-动作模型（WAMs）虽然性能强大，但需要数十步去噪，无法满足实时控制需求。步蒸馏是自然解决方案，但现有单模态蒸馏方法在联合视频-动作场景中失效，因为视频和动作流使用不同的SNR偏移噪声调度，导致训练时边缘噪声分布严重不对称，单一模态蒸馏无法适应这种差异。

Method: 提出Flash-WAM，一种模态感知的步蒸馏框架：1）对动作流的低噪声机制采用线性梯度缩放（linear-gradient-scaling）参数化；2）对视频流的高噪声机制采用方差保持（variance-preserving）参数化。该方法基于一致性函数族的结构分析，刻画了一致性边界条件下可实现的梯度缩放特性。在LingBot-VA上实例化，将每个模态的推理压缩至单步。

Result: 在RoboTwin 2.0上，每块延迟从8.1秒降至348毫秒（NVIDIA L40S），实现23倍加速，支持实时推理。仿真基准上保持任务成功率：RoboTwin 2.0达85.5%，LIBERO达95.7%。在Unitree G1人形机器人上恢复真实世界性能达60%平均水平，而朴素一致性蒸馏在相同步预算下仅达24%。

Conclusion: Flash-WAM通过模态感知蒸馏策略，首次成功将联合视频-动作扩散模型蒸馏至单步推理，为实时机器人操控中的世界-动作模型部署提供了可行路径，揭示了处理多模态扩散模型中异质噪声分布的重要性。

Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) jointly generate future video and robot actions through iterative diffusion, achieving strong performance on manipulation benchmarks but requiring tens of denoising steps, a cost that precludes real-time control. Step distillation has emerged as the natural remedy, but off-the-shelf methods break down in the joint video-action setting because video and action streams use different SNR-shifted noise schedules and reach training with substantially different marginal noise distributions, an asymmetry that single-modality distillation methods cannot accommodate. We introduce \textbf{Flash-WAM}, a modality-aware step-distillation framework inspired by consistency distillation that selects the consistency function for each modality to match its noise regime: a linear-gradient-scaling parametrization for the action stream's low-noise regime, paired with a variance-preserving parametrization for the video stream's high-noise regime, grounded in a structural analysis of the consistency-function family that characterizes the achievable gradient scaling under the consistency boundary condition. Instantiated on LingBot-VA, Flash-WAM compresses inference to a single step in each modality. On RoboTwin 2.0, this reduces per-chunk latency from $8.1$ seconds to $348$ ms on NVIDIA L40S, a $23{\times}$ speedup that enables real-time inference. Flash-WAM preserves task success on simulation benchmarks ($85.5\%$ RoboTwin 2.0, $95.7\%$ LIBERO) and substantially recovers real-world performance ($60\%$ average on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot), while naive consistency distillation drops to $24\%$ at the same step budget.

</details>


### [217] [Scaling Laws for Behavioral Foundation Models over User Event Sequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05257)
*Rickard Brüel Gabrielsson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了行为基础模型的缩放法则，发现计算最优配置与语言模型不同：小型嵌入器（约2%参数量）始终最优，计算最优的D/N比随算力增加趋向Chinchilla启发式，且评估指标本身成为缩放法则的一部分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前行为基础模型（用于推荐、支付、欺诈检测等）缺乏类似语言模型的缩放法则来指导计算资源校准。本文旨在填补这一空白，系统研究行为建模中的计算最优配置。

Method: 在真实交互数据上进行了约600轮实验（覆盖10^15至10^19 FLOPs），联合变化四个部署相关轴：嵌入器与上下文编码器的参数分配比例、临界批量大小、模型/数据分配策略、以及嵌入器冻结后负采样数量。采用双组件架构：基于特征的嵌入器将多模态事件映射为向量，decoder-only Transformer预测下一事件。

Result: 1）小型嵌入器（约2%参数）在所有算力预算下均为计算最优；2）计算最优训练在低算力时相对文本更偏重数据，但D/N比随算力增加趋近Chinchilla启发式；3）临界批量大小、冻结后最优负采样数、损失与排序质量的一致性均随算力和评估指标变化；4）在10^19 FLOPs时，负采样瓶颈变为候选轴内存而非FLOPs。

Conclusion: 行为基础模型中，评估指标是缩放法则的组成部分：改变评估指标会改变计算最优配方。这与语言模型有本质区别，需要在部署时根据具体指标重新校准。

Abstract: Foundation models are increasingly trained on sequences of user actions in recommendation, payments, fraud, and commerce, but these models still lack the kind of compute calibration that scaling laws provide for language models. We study a common two-part behavioral-model architecture: a feature-based event embedder maps each multi-modal item to a vector, and a decoder-only transformer predicts the next event from the resulting sequence. Across roughly 600 runs on real interaction data, spanning $10^{15}$-$10^{19}$ training FLOPs, we jointly vary four deployment-relevant axes: the two-part parameter split, critical batch size, model/data allocation, and the number of sampled negatives used after freezing the embedder. A small embedder ($s^{\star}\!\approx\!2\%$ of parameters) is compute-optimal at every budget we test because embedder parameters are both more expensive per step and exposed to far more repeated items than contextualizer parameters. Compute-optimal training is data-heavy relative to text at low compute, but its $D/N$ ratio moves toward the Chinchilla heuristic as compute increases. The sampled training objective and deployed ranking metrics disagree in ways that themselves scale: critical batch size, optimal negative count after freezing, and the agreement between loss and ranking quality all shift with compute and with the chosen evaluation metric. For negative sampling, larger budgets increasingly prefer more negatives; by $10^{19}$ FLOPs the active constraint is candidate-axis memory rather than FLOPs. In behavioral foundation models, the evaluation metric is therefore part of the scaling law: changing it can change the compute-optimal recipe.

</details>


### [218] [Policy-Conditioned Counterfactual Credit for Verifiable Reinforcement Learning of Long-Horizon Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05263)
*Renwei Meng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CVT-RL 提出一种带密集可验证奖励的约束策略梯度算法，通过删除、语义替换、证据替换和工具输出扰动等受控干预，结合策略条件反事实贡献(PCCC)估计量及选择调整的双重鲁棒优势函数，对长程语言智能体的无据推理、信念漂移和捷径行为进行约束优化，在多项基准上将任务成功率从71.8%提升至78.9%，并将攻击行为从7.2%降至3.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长程语言智能体仍存在无证据推理、信念漂移和满足终端检查的捷径行为等问题；而现有过程奖励多为相关性奖励（奖励检索、反思、验证等步骤的形式），无法估计在特定干预下该步骤是否真正对最终验证成功有因果贡献。

Method: 提出CVT-RL框架：(1)设计四种受控干预——删除、语义替换、证据替换、工具输出扰动；(2)从冻结参考策略采样延续，构建策略条件反事实贡献(PCCC)估计量；(3)引入选择调整的双重鲁棒估计量增强优势函数；(4)使用仅需前缀可观测标签的信念控制；(5)通过增广拉格朗日方法约束无据声明、跳过验证、工具篡改和不安全调用等行为。

Result: 在长上下文QA、ALFWorld、ScienceWorld及网页/工具任务上：任务成功率从计算匹配非因果RL的71.8%和信息匹配反事实基线的75.4%提升至78.9%；证据F1从78.9提升至82.8；测量攻击率从7.2%降至3.9%；独立人工审计估计CVT-RL攻击率4.6% vs 基线8.1%；自适应检测器规避攻击下攻击率仅升至7.1%；分层Bootstrap和混合效应检验在Holm校正后p<0.01。

Conclusion: 精心限定的反事实信用分配，配合有效性门控、诊断和可验证约束，为构建更可靠的长程RL语言智能体提供了一条可复现的路径。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves reasoning and tool use, yet long-horizon language agents still learn unsupported evidence chains, belief drift, and shortcut actions that satisfy terminal checks. Existing process rewards are mostly correlational: they reward retrieval-, reflection-, or verification-like steps without estimating whether the step contributes to final verified success under a specified intervention. We propose CVT-RL, a constrained policy-gradient algorithm with dense verifiable rewards, intervention-validity gating, and a policy-conditioned counterfactual contribution (PCCC) estimator. Deletion, semantic substitution, evidence substitution, and tool-output perturbation define separate controlled interventions; continuations are sampled from a frozen reference policy, and a selection-adjusted doubly robust estimator augments the advantage. Belief control uses only prefix-observable labels, while an augmented Lagrangian constrains unsupported claims, skipped verification, tool tampering, and unsafe calls. On long-context QA, ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and web/tool tasks, CVT-RL improves average task success from 71.8% for compute-matched non-causal RL and 75.4% for an information-matched counterfactual-process baseline to 78.9%, improves evidence F1 from 78.9 to 82.8 over the information-matched baseline, and reduces measured hacking from 7.2% to 3.9%. Independent human audit estimates 4.6% hacking for CVT-RL versus 8.1% for the information-matched baseline, and adaptive detector-evasion attacks raise hacking only to 7.1%. Stratified bootstrap and mixed-effects tests give p<0.01 after Holm correction for all primary metrics. Carefully scoped counterfactual credit, paired with validity gating, diagnostics, and verifiable constraints, provides a reproducible route toward more reliable long-horizon RL for language agents.

</details>


### [219] [REGEN: Reference-Guided Synthetic Multivariate Time Series Generation for Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05264)
*Moulik Gupta,Dhruv Kumar,Murari Mandal,Saurabh Deshpande*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ReGeN 是一种参考引导的生成管线，将观测序列分解为相位对齐的周期骨架、深度核高斯过程建模的随机残差、以及结构因果模型驱动的跨变量依赖，通过可控温度采样实现保结构的数据增强。在交通等强周期领域，其生成数据甚至优于真实数据，且在其上预训练的基础模型表现超越其他合成数据方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多元时序预测需要大规模多样化数据，但许多实际领域仅提供极少观测序列。现有方法中，基于先验的生成器产生领域无关样本，基于数据驱动的方法则将参考序列视为黑箱监督，丧失对周期结构、局部变异性以及跨变量动态的显式控制。因而需要一种能够在保持领域结构的前提下实现可控合成的方法。

Method: ReGeN 将每个参考序列分解为三个可解释组件：(1) 相位对齐的周期骨架，捕捉主导领域形态；(2) 使用深度核高斯过程（deep-kernel GP）建模的逐变量随机残差；(3) 通过带拟合耦合系数的结构因果模型（SCM）注入的滞后感知跨变量依赖。以可控温度对各组件采样，在保留领域结构的同时拓宽分布覆盖范围。

Result: ReGeN 生成的数据可一致替代真实兄弟数据，且预测性能退化极小；在交通等强周期领域，生成数据表现甚至优于真实源数据。在 ReGeN 语料上预训练的基础模型，优于在基于先验或数据驱动的合成替代方案上预训练的模型。

Conclusion: 在低数据场景下，如何结构化地利用参考数据（而非仅关注数据量）是决定合成质量的关键。ReGeN 通过结构分解与可控采样，为数据稀缺领域的时序预测提供了有效的数据增强新范式。

Abstract: Training robust multivariate time series forecasting models requires large, diverse corpora, yet many real-world domains provide only a handful of observed sequences. Existing generators fail to resolve this mismatch: prior-based approaches (e.g., CauKer, TimePFN) produce domain-agnostic samples, while data-driven methods (e.g., TimeGAN) treat references as black-box supervision, forfeiting explicit control over periodic structure, local variability, and cross-variable dynamics.
  We propose ReGeN, a reference-guided generative pipeline that treats observed sequences not as examples to imitate, but as structural scaffolds for controllable synthesis. ReGeN decomposes each reference into three interpretable components: a phase-aligned periodic backbone capturing dominant domain morphology; per-variable stochastic residuals modeled with a deep-kernel Gaussian process; and lag-aware cross-variable dependencies injected through a structural causal model with fitted coupling coefficients. Sampling these components at controllable temperature broadens distributional coverage while preserving domain-grounded structure.
  We show that ReGeN-generated data consistently substitutes for real sibling data with minimal forecasting degradation, and in strongly periodic domains such as traffic, can outperform the real source itself. We further show that a foundation model pretrained on ReGeN corpora outperforms those pretrained on prior-based and data-driven synthetic alternatives. This suggests that in low-data regimes, how reference data is structurally exploited can matter as much as how much data is available.

</details>


### [220] [Data-efficient flood depth prediction through domain-aware coreset selection and tabular foundation models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05265)
*Lipai Huang,Adithi Srinath,Manas Singh,Junwei Ma,Ali Mostafavi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种领域感知的核心集构建方法，使表格基础模型能够在推理时通过少量样本（0.7%训练池）实现跨流域的洪水深度快速预测，准确率接近全量监督基线，并具备无需重训练的迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有洪水深度预测的监督代理模型虽精度高，但每个流域需数百万训练行且无法跨网格外推。需要一种数据高效、可跨流域迁移的替代方案。

Method: 提出领域感知核心集构建流水线：(1)按重现期和最受影响流域对风暴进行分层；(2)使用目标感知空间选择器采样六边形网格；(3)在推理时用该核心集条件化表格基础模型（tabular foundation model），无需按流域单独训练。

Result: 仅用每流域训练池0.7%的样本，在休斯顿地区九个流域上平均R²达0.663，达到监督基线（R²=0.673）的98.5%。模型可迁移至未见过流域且无需任务特定重训练，优于核心集训练的监督基线。在真实风暴测试中，远分布外案例超越监督基线，近分布内案例略低于基线。

Conclusion: 领域感知核心集构建使表格基础模型能以数据高效、流域可迁移的方式实现洪水预测，消除了对逐流域大规模训练数据的依赖。

Abstract: Near-real-time flood depth prediction demands surrogate models that are accurate, fast, and transferable across watersheds. Supervised surrogates can match physics-based simulators in accuracy but need millions of training rows per watershed and cannot extrapolate beyond their original mesh. We propose a domain-aware coreset construction pipeline that conditions a tabular foundation model at inference time. The pipeline stratifies storms by return period and most-affected watershed, then samples hexagons with a target-aware spatial selector. With 0.7% of the per-watershed training pool, the model attains a mean $R^2$ of 0.663 across nine Houston-area watersheds, within 98.5% of the supervised reference ($R^2$ = 0.673). It transfers to held-out watersheds without task-specific retraining, staying ahead of a coreset-trained supervised baseline. On real storms it exceeds the supervised reference on a far out-of-distribution case and trails it on a mostly in-distribution one. Domain-aware coreset construction lets tabular foundation models deliver data-efficient, watershed-transferable flood predictions without per-watershed training.

</details>


### [221] [Sharp Low-Degree Thresholds for Planted-vs-Planted Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05266)
*Anda Skeja,Daniel Gutiérrez Espinoza,Fiona Skerman,Alexander S. Wein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在 planted-vs-planted 设定下，首次建立了低次多项式检验的尖锐阈值（sharp threshold），证明了 planted submatrix 和 planted dense subgraph 模型中计数社区的匹配上下界，并发现该检验阈值与已知的低次恢复阈值在尖锐常数上一致；同时识别了弱检验任务的平滑过渡现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在 planted 模型中，区分两种结构化 planted 机制（planted-vs-planted testing）是一个基本问题，但此前缺乏对低次多项式检验尖锐阈值的研究。作者旨在填补这一空白，揭示检验阈值与恢复阈值之间的精确关系。

Method: 作者开发了一个基于隐变量展开（latent-variable expansion）的 planted-vs-planted 检验框架，该展开源于低次恢复分析；同时引入新方法识别并剪枝非信号贡献项，从而得到匹配的低次上下界。

Result: 证明了 planted submatrix 和 planted dense subgraph 模型中计数社区的低次检验上下界匹配，且检验阈值与已知低次恢复阈值在尖锐常数上一致。弱检验（优于随机猜测）则不具有尖锐阈值，而是呈现平滑过渡。

Conclusion: planted-vs-planted 设定下的低次多项式检验具有尖锐阈值，且该阈值与恢复阈值精确重合；弱检验则呈现平滑过渡。所开发的隐变量展开与剪枝框架为后续研究提供了新工具。

Abstract: We establish the first sharp thresholds for low-degree polynomial tests in planted-vs-planted settings, where the goal is to determine with vanishing error which of two structured planted mechanisms generated the observed data. We prove matching low-degree upper and lower bounds for counting communities in the planted submatrix and planted dense subgraph models. The resulting testing threshold coincides, down to the sharp constant, with the known low-degree recovery threshold. In contrast, the task of weak testing, where the goal is to outperform random guessing, does not have a sharp threshold but rather a smooth transition, which we identify. To prove our results, we develop a framework for planted-vs-planted testing that builds on a latent-variable expansion originating in low-degree recovery and employs new methods to identify and prune non-signal contributions.

</details>


### [222] [Learning Manifold and Itô Dynamics with Branched Neural Rough Differential Equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05272)
*Luke Thompson,Dai Shi,Lequan Lin,Junbin Gao,Andi Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出分支神经粗糙微分方程（B-NRDEs），通过Hopf代数框架将NRDE的log-ODE步重构为状态空间流形上的几何数值积分，使驱动代数与对应微积分匹配：Itô情形用Grossman-Larson有根树，流形上有序协变导数用Munthe-Kaas-Wright平面有根树，Stratonovich情形用shuffle代数。该方法保持流形约束，并引入分支签名核目标实现Itô一致的分布匹配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有NRDE依赖shuffle代数，对应Stratonovich微积分，无法暴露Itô动力学所需的二次变差项，也无法处理配备联络的流形上有序协变导数。这限制了NRDE在随机与流形值动力学中的应用。

Method: 1) 将NRDE的log-ODE步重新解释为流形上的几何数值积分；2) 引入Hopf代数框架，根据微积分类型匹配不同代数结构：Itô情形用Grossman-Larson有根树，流形上用Munthe-Kaas-Wright平面有根树，Stratonovich情形用shuffle代数；3) 提出分支签名核目标函数，使训练时二次变差项可见，实现Itô一致的分布匹配。

Result: 在rough Bergomi波动率模型、sim-to-real SO(3)动力学预测、SPD协方差动力学三个任务上，B-NRDEs展现了统一且有效的表现，超越了传统Euclidean-Stratonovich设定下的方法。

Conclusion: B-NRDEs提供了一个统一框架，将神经粗糙微分方程推广到Itô和流形值动力学设定，通过合适的代数结构匹配和几何数值积分，实现流形约束的精确保持和Itô一致的训练。

Abstract: Neural rough differential equations (NRDEs) stay accurate under irregular sampling while taking far fewer integration steps than standard neural differential equations, summarising a finely sampled driver by its log-signature and advancing the hidden state over coarse intervals using the log-ODE method. This efficiency rests on the shuffle algebra, the algebraic counterpart of Stratonovich calculus. This reliance means NRDEs cannot expose the quadratic-variation terms Itô dynamics require, nor the ordered covariant derivatives that govern Itô flows on connection-equipped manifolds. Ameliorating this, we introduce Branched Neural Rough Differential Equations (B-NRDEs), a Hopf-algebraic framework that recasts the NRDE log-ODE step as geometric numerical integration on the state-space manifold, matching the driving algebra to the governing calculus: Grossman--Larson rooted trees for Euclidean Itô dynamics, Munthe-Kaas--Wright planar rooted trees for ordered covariant derivatives on manifolds, and the shuffle algebra in the classical Stratonovich case. This yields intrinsic coarse-step dynamics that exactly preserve manifold constraints. Finally, we introduce a branched signature-kernel objective to enable Itô-consistent law matching by making quadratic-variation terms visible during training. On rough Bergomi volatility, sim-to-real $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ dynamics forecasting, and SPD covariance dynamics, B-NRDEs offer a unified, effective approach to stochastic and manifold-valued dynamics beyond the Euclidean--Stratonovich setting.

</details>


### [223] [Multimarginal flow matching with optimal transport potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05327)
*Raghav Kansal,David Crair,Nghia Nguyen,Scott Pope,Bradley Parry*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出OT-potential FM (OTP-FM)，通过在动态最优传输作用量中引入势能项，将Flow Matching扩展至多边际（multimarginal）设定，实现对中间观测分布的软约束，并在单细胞RNA测序、海洋和气象数据上取得领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Flow Matching主要处理两个端点分布之间的映射，但许多科学领域（如动态系统建模）中存在可观测的中间边际分布，这些中间分布能够约束端点间的流动，而该"多边际"设定尚未被充分探索。

Method: 利用Flow Matching与动态最优传输的联系，在动态OT作用量（action）中引入势能项（potential terms），将条件FM的学习目标扩展以纳入这些势能，从而软性地将流动引导向中间边际分布。该方法是无模拟的（simulation-free），且对学习的时空动力学具有高度灵活性。

Result: OTP-FM在单细胞RNA测序、海洋学和气象学等多样化数据集上展示了最先进的性能和训练效率。

Conclusion: OTP-FM成功将Flow Matching推广至多边际场景，通过OT势能项实现灵活、高效的中间分布约束，为科学领域中的时间演化建模提供了有力工具。

Abstract: Flow matching (FM) has emerged as a powerful framework for learning dynamic transport maps between two empirical distributions. However, less explored is the setting with intermediate observed marginals that can help constrain the flows between the endpoints. This "multimarginal" regime is central to modeling temporal evolution in dynamical systems in many scientific domains that can sample sequential distributions. We tackle this problem with a novel approach that leverages the connection between FM and dynamic optimal transport (OT), softly steering the flow towards the intermediate marginals through potential terms in the dynamic OT action. By extending the conditional FM learning target to incorporate these potentials, we derive an efficient, simulation-free algorithm for multimarginal FM that offers considerable flexibility in the spatiotemporal dynamics of the learned flows. We demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and training efficiency of OT-potential FM (OTP-FM) on diverse single-cell RNA sequencing, oceanographic, and meteorological datasets. Our code is available at https://github.com/Bexorg-Inc/OTP-FM.

</details>


### [224] [Anomaly Detection for Electro-Hydrostatic Actuators using LSTM Autoencoder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05274)
*Nehal Afifi,Abdelmonem Elhendawi,Felix Leitenberger,Nadine Piat,Sven Matthiesen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于LSTM自编码器的重构式离线异常检测框架，用于EHA系统传感器信号（温度与压力），平均准确率达99.0%，F1分数最高99.8%，显著优于传统方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EHA传感器数据量大、采样频率高，传统统计方法和经典机器学习方法（Z-score、IQR、Isolation Forest等）难以捕捉信号的时序依赖性，导致检测精度有限、误报率高。此外，针对EHA系统在不同工况下的数据驱动异常检测系统性评估较为稀缺。

Method: 采用重构式LSTM自编码器对单变量传感器信号进行建模，利用验证集重构误差分布进行校准与阈值设定。在受控试验台采集的温度和压力数据上，通过多种故障注入场景评估性能，并辅以不同工况下的灵敏度分析。

Result: LSTM自编码器取得平均准确率99.0%，精确率最高100%，召回率90.2%~99.6%，F1分数93.1%~99.8%，在所有评估传感器上均表现出高检测灵敏度和极低误报率。

Conclusion: 数据驱动的离线异常检测方法对EHA系统具有可行性，未来工作将聚焦于将该框架适配至在线（实时）环境。

Abstract: Electro-Hydrostatic Actuators (EHAs) are widely used in aerospace and industrial systems, where timely detection of sensor anomalies is essential to ensure safe and reliable operation. However, the large volume and high sampling frequency of EHA sensor data pose challenges for accurate and efficient anomaly detection. Conventional statistical and classical machine-learning methods such as Z-score, Interquartile Range (IQR), Median Absolute Deviation (MAD), Isolation Forest, Gaussian Mixture, and k-means often fail to capture the temporal dependencies inherent in EHA signals, resulting in limited detection accuracy and elevated false-alarm rates. Furthermore, systematic evaluations of data-driven anomaly detection approaches for EHA systems remain scarce, particularly under varying operational conditions. This study presents an offline anomaly-detection framework for univariate EHA sensor signals, focusing on temperature and pressure data collected from a controlled test bench. The method employs a reconstruction-based Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) autoencoder, calibrated and evaluated using validation-set reconstruction-error distributions. Performance is assessed across multiple fault-injection scenarios using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, complemented by sensitivity analyses under varying operating conditions. The LSTM autoencoder achieved an average accuracy of 99.0\%, precision up to 100\%, recall between 90.2\% and 99.6\%, and F1-scores from 93.1\% to 99.8\%, demonstrating high detection sensitivity and a very low false-alarm rate across all evaluated sensors. These results highlight the feasibility of data-driven offline anomaly detection for EHAs. Future work will focus on adapting the developed framework for an online (real-time) environment.

</details>


### [225] [A prism hierarchy of learning regimes in large linear autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05335)
*Eugene Golikov,Yaroslav Gusev,Dmitry Yarotsky*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为大型权重绑定线性自编码器提出了一个系统性的极限学习机制分类框架，将其与三角棱柱的几何面相关联，识别出五种基本极限机制，并推导了其中四种机制下梯度流训练的损失演化解析表达式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器学习理论研究通常孤立地考虑不同的极限机制（如大样本、均值场等），缺乏一个系统性的框架来统一描述某一类模型所有定性不同的极限学习行为。作者希望填补这一空白。

Method: 作者以大型权重绑定线性自编码器为研究对象（该模型对权重是非线性的，梯度流无一般解析解），在形式化损失展开层级（loss-expansion hierarchy）层面，将极端机制与三角棱柱的几何面相对应：5个2-面（2-faces）对应五种基本极端机制，9个1-面对应混合机制，6个0-面对应进一步混合。对其中四种基本机制（大数据、小数据、均值场、窄隐层），推导了梯度流下训练损失和总体损失演化的显式表达式，并与实验结果进行对比验证。

Result: 五种基本极端机制为：(1)大数据机制、(2)小数据机制、(3)均值场机制、(4)窄隐层机制、(5)自由机制。对于前四种，推导出的训练损失和总体损失演化公式与实验结果吻合非常好。

Conclusion: 通过损失展开层级与三角棱柱几何的对应关系，可以系统性理解权重绑定线性自编码器在极限下的梯度流动力学全貌，为统一分析不同极限学习机制提供了新视角。

Abstract: Theoretical studies of machine learning models commonly consider different limiting regimes in which the learning dynamics of gradient descent becomes theoretically tractable. It is, however, desirable to have a systematically obtained picture of all qualitatively different extreme learning regimes for a particular type of models. In this paper we propose such a picture for large weight-tied linear autoencoders characterized by input and latent dimensions, initialization magnitude, and training set size. This model is nonlinear in the weights and its gradient flow does not have a general theoretical solution. We show that at the level of the formal loss-expansion hierarchy, its extreme regimes are naturally associated with faces of a triangular prism. In particular, there are five basic extreme regimes associated with the 2-faces of the prism: (1) large-data, (2) small-data, (3) mean-field, (4) narrow-latent, and (5) free. For regimes (1,2,3,4), we derive explicit expressions for both train and population limiting loss evolutions under gradient flow, obtaining very good agreement with experimental results.

</details>


### [226] [Agentic Monte Carlo: Simulating Reinforcement Learning for Black-Box Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05296)
*Dae Yon Hwang,Raunaq Suri,Valentin Villecroze,Anthony L. Caterini,Jesse C. Cresswell,Noël Vouitsis,Brendan Leigh Ross*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Agentic Monte Carlo (AMC)，利用RL与贝叶斯推断的等价性，通过Sequential Monte Carlo从黑盒LLM智能体的最优策略中直接采样，无需参数级优化即可实现RL式优化，在AgentGym基准上显著优于提示基线并超越GRPO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM智能体分为可RL优化的开源权重智能体和仅能测试时控制的黑盒智能体两类。黑盒智能体虽有最先进的闭源LLM支持，但仅API访问使得参数级优化不可行，大多数RL方法无法应用。需要一种无需修改模型参数即可实现RL式策略优化的方法。

Method: 核心思路基于RL与贝叶斯推断的等价性：最优策略等价于以固定黑盒LLM智能体为先验的轨迹后验分布。提出Agentic Monte Carlo (AMC)，采用Sequential Monte Carlo方法，通过学习一个价值函数来引导智能体的采样过程，从该后验分布中直接采样，而底层黑盒模型保持不变。

Result: 在AgentGym基准的三个不同环境上验证，AMC相比提示基线取得显著提升，并且随着测试时计算的扩展，性能甚至超过了Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)。

Conclusion: AMC证明了在不修改黑盒LLM参数的前提下，实现有原则的RL式优化是可行的，为黑盒LLM智能体的策略优化开辟了新路径。

Abstract: LLM agents operate in two distinct regimes: open-weight agents amenable to reinforcement learning (RL) and black-box agents whose behaviour must be controlled purely at test time. Although black-box agents are often backed by state-of-the-art proprietary LLMs, API-only access precludes parameter-level optimization, rendering most RL methods inapplicable. To address this limitation, we turn to a known equivalence between RL and Bayesian inference. We propose Agentic Monte Carlo (AMC) to directly sample from the optimal policy of a black-box agent rather than training it through RL. The optimal policy is a posterior over trajectories whose prior we define as the fixed black-box LLM agent. We employ Sequential Monte Carlo to sample from this posterior by learning a value function to steer the agent while leaving the underlying black-box model unchanged. We validate AMC on three diverse environments from the AgentGym benchmark, demonstrating significant improvements over prompting baselines and even outperforming Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) as we scale the test-time compute of our method. AMC demonstrates the feasibility of performing principled RL-style optimization of black-box LLM agents. Code is available at https://github.com/layer6ai-labs/Agentic-Monte-Carlo

</details>


### [227] [Mamba-Assisted Non-Markovian Closure for Reduced-Order Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05371)
*Zhi-Feng Wei,Saad Qadeer,Panos Stinis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 受Mori-Zwanzig形式理论启发，本文将高维动力系统的降阶建模重构为序列建模问题，提出MAC框架——基于Mamba序列模型预测闭包项，并与降阶控制方程耦合进行时间推进，利用状态空间模型的双重表示实现高效训练与推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维动力系统的降阶建模长期受困于非马尔可夫闭包项——该闭包项表征未解析变量对已解析动力学的影响，具有记忆泛函形式，传统方法难以精确建模。作者旨在利用现代序列模型的表达能力，以数据驱动方式直接学习该记忆闭包。

Method: 提出Mamba-Assisted Closure (MAC)框架：将闭包建模转化为序列建模问题，采用Mamba（一种结构化状态空间序列模型）从已解析轨迹预测闭包项，并通过数值积分器与降阶控制方程耦合，实现时间推进。核心创新在于利用状态空间模型的双重表示——训练时以卷积形式进行序列到序列学习（支持长轨迹高效训练），推理时切换为循环形式进行逐步自回归推演（每步推理成本恒定）。

Result: 在粘性Burgers方程和混沌双尺度Lorenz '96系统上，MAC模型在预测精度和长时间推演稳定性方面均显著优于马尔可夫降阶模型、基于GRU的序列模型以及Wilks方法。

Conclusion: MAC框架通过Mamba序列模型成功实现了非马尔可夫闭包的高效建模，双重表示策略兼顾了训练效率与推理成本，为高维动力系统的降阶建模提供了一种有效的新范式。

Abstract: Reduced-order modeling of high-dimensional dynamical systems is often hindered by the non-Markovian closure term that represents the effect of unresolved variables on the resolved dynamics. Inspired by the Mori--Zwanzig formalism, in which the closure takes the form of a memory functional of the resolved trajectory, we recast closure modeling as a sequence modeling problem and propose the Mamba-Assisted Closure (MAC) framework: a Mamba-based sequence model, trained to predict the closure from the resolved trajectory, is coupled with the reduced-order governing equations through a numerical integrator to advance the resolved variables in time. A key feature of the framework is its exploitation of the dual representation of state-space models -- the model is trained in a sequence-to-sequence fashion via the convolutional form, and deployed for step-by-step autoregressive rollout via the recurrent form, yielding both efficient long-trajectory training and constant per-step inference cost. On the viscous Burgers' equation and the chaotic two-scale Lorenz '96 system, the MAC model substantially outperforms the Markovian reduced-order model, the GRU-based sequence model, and the Wilks method in predictive accuracy and long-time rollout stability.

</details>


### [228] [Statistically Reliable LLM-Based Ranking Evaluation via Prediction-Powered Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05308)
*Abhishek Divekar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PRECISE 将 Prediction-Powered Inference 扩展到排序评估指标，通过结合少量人工标注和大量 LLM 判断，产生偏差校正的估计，并将输出空间计算复杂度从 O(2^|C|) 降至 O(2^K)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 排序评估指标（如 Precision@K）的人工标注成本高昂，而 LLM 判断虽廉价但存在误差。需要一个既能利用 LLM 规模优势、又能保证统计无偏性的框架来估计这些层次化指标。

Method: 基于 Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI) 框架，利用少量人工标注与大量 LLM 判断构建偏差校正估计量；针对 Precision@K 等层次化指标（标注在文档级、指标在查询级），将输出空间计算从 O(2^|C|) 降至 O(2^K)，使 PPI 可实际应用于此类指标。

Result: 在 ESCI 基准上，用 Claude 3 Sonnet 增强 30 个人工标注，将 Precision@4 的标准误从 4.45 降至 3.50（降低 21%）。在生产系统中，仅用 100 个人工标签和 2 小时领域专家标注，即正确识别三个系统变体中的最优者，A/B 测试证实该排名，带来每日销售额 +407 bps 的提升。

Conclusion: PRECISE 有效结合人工与 LLM 判断，在保持统计无偏性的同时显著降低排序指标估计的方差，并在真实生产环境中验证了其实用性，能以极少人工成本做出正确的系统选优决策。

Abstract: With PRECISE, we extended Prediction-Powered Inference to produce bias-corrected estimates of ranking evaluation metrics by combining a small human-labeled set with a large LLM-judged set. PPI is provably unbiased regardless of the LLM judge's error profile. We make it applicable to hierarchical metrics like Precision@K, where annotations are per-document but the metric is per-query, by reducing the output-space computation from O(2^|C|) to O(2^K). On the ESCI benchmark, augmenting 30 human annotations with Claude 3 Sonnet judgments reduces the standard error of Precision@4 estimates from 4.45 to 3.50 (a 21% relative reduction). In a production system, our framework correctly identified the best of three system variants from 100 human labels and 2 hours of domain-expert annotation; A/B testing confirmed this ranking with +407 bps in daily sales.

</details>


### [229] [GOTabPFN: From Feature Ordering to Compact Tokenization for Tabular Foundation Models on High-Dimensional Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05441)
*Al Zadid Sultan Bin Habib,Md Younus Ahamed,Prashnna Kumar Gyawali,Gianfranco Doretto,Donald A. Adjeroh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文研究如何在不重新训练大型骨干网络的情况下，让小型表格基础模型在高维低样本量场景中有效工作。作者提出了一种图引导排序与局部精炼方法(GO-LR)，将其等价于加权最小线性排列问题，并用类TSP路径的替代方案求解。在此基础上构建了GOTabPFN模型，结合神经启发的子单元压缩模块，将局部相邻的有序特征池化为元特征，实现了紧凑表示，使得TabPFN式预测在HDLSS条件下切实可行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的表格基础模型（如TabPFN）依赖Transformer架构，其自注意力机制的token预算在高维特征场景下会因计算和内存需求爆炸而失效。直接重训练大型骨干网络成本高昂且不现实，因此需要一种在不重新训练的前提下，将小型表格基础模型适配到高维低样本量（HDLSS）场景的方法。

Method: 核心方法包含两部分：(1) GO-LR（Graph-guided Ordering with Local Refinement）：通过构造特征间依赖图，将特征排序问题转化为加权最小线性排列（wMLA），并采用类旅行商问题路径的替代求解器高效近似求解，实现特征的图引导有序排列；(2) NSC（Neuro-Inspired Subunit Compression）：借鉴神经系统的子单元压缩机制，将GO-LR排序后局部相邻的特征池化为元特征，大幅压缩token数量，形成适配TabPFN的紧凑表示。两者结合构成GOTabPFN模型。

Result: 在多个表格基准数据集上，GOTabPFN在严格token预算约束下展现出优于基线方法的稳定性和预测精度，有效验证了GO-LR排序与NSC压缩策略在HDLSS场景下的实用性。

Conclusion: 通过图引导的特征排序与神经启发的局部压缩，可以在不重新训练大型骨干模型的前提下使小型表格基础模型有效处理HDLSS数据，为表格预测提供了一条高效、可扩展的新路径。

Abstract: We investigate how to make small tabular foundation models effective for High-Dimensional, Low-Sample Size (HDLSS) tabular prediction without retraining large backbones. We introduce Graph-guided Ordering with Local Refinement (GO-LR), show its equivalence to weighted Minimum Linear Arrangement, and interpret the practical solver as a TSP-path-style surrogate. We propose GOTabPFN,which builds on GO-LR, and a Neuro-Inspired Subunit Compression (NSC) unit to pool locally adjacent ordered features into meta-features, yielding a compact representation that makes TabPFN-style prediction practical in HDLSS regimes. Across tabular benchmarks, GOTabPFN improves stability and accuracy under tight token budgets.

</details>


### [230] [PJ-RoPE: A Fourier-Jet-Affine Position Space for Relative Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05345)
*Yaobo Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PJ-RoPE 将 RoPE、Jordan-RoPE 和 ALiBi 统一到单一可学习的相对位置空间中，利用傅里叶-射流-仿射公式描述相对注意力，并通过受控探针和小规模语言/音乐实验揭示不同任务对该空间中不同区域的选择偏好，同时引入LC/快度坐标稳定高阶射流。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有位置编码方法（RoPE的傅里叶相位、Jordan-RoPE的有限射流、ALiBi的仿射近因偏置）各自独立设计，缺乏统一的数学框架来理解它们之间的关系，也不清楚不同任务会选择位置空间中的哪些区域。

Method: 提出 PJ-RoPE（Fourier-Jet-Affine 公式），将三种位置编码统一为有限常系数差分模：滞后算子的单根对应傅里叶/RoPE字符，非零重根对应Jordan/傅里叶射流，单位重根对应ALiBi式仿射近因。框架将标量PJ偏置核与精确PJ旋转特征变换分离，引入自适应扇区诊断和LC/快度坐标以稳定高阶射流。

Result: 受控探针验证了扇区包含与选择；小规模语言实验揭示了仿射/近因边界；音乐token流实验表明LC/仿射变体表现强劲且携带可测量的高阶修正；LC诊断显示尺度稳定性增益与相位分辨率损失之间存在耦合。

Conclusion: PJ-RoPE成功将主流位置编码统一在一个代数框架内，通过扇区诊断和LC坐标实现了对不同任务中位置表示选择的可解释性分析，为位置编码的设计与选择提供了理论指导。

Abstract: We unify RoPE's Fourier phase, Jordan-RoPE's finite jets, and ALiBi's affine recency into a single learnable relative-position space, and study which regions of this space are selected by different tasks. PJ-RoPE is a Fourier-Jet-Affine formulation for relative attention, with an optional Poincare-type reading as the affine completion of a homogeneous Fourier-jet positional representation. Algebraically, the same primitives form a finite constant-coefficient difference module: simple roots of the lag-shift operator give Fourier/RoPE characters, repeated nonzero roots give Jordan/Fourier jets, and the repeated unit root gives ALiBi-like affine recency.
  The framework separates scalar PJ-bias kernels from exact PJ-rotary feature transforms, introduces adaptive sector diagnostics, and uses LC/rapidity coordinates to stabilize high-order jets. Controlled probes verify sector containment and selection; small language runs expose an affine/recency boundary; music-token streams provide the clearest case where LC/affine variants remain strong while carrying measurable high-order corrections; and LC diagnostics show a scale-stability gain coupled to phase-resolution loss.

</details>


### [231] [Zero-Copy Semantic Contagion: An In-Memory Streaming Architecture for Evolving Attention Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05733)
*Kabir Murjani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种异构Rust-Python流式架构，将跨公司注意力建模为直接从文本驱动的连续时间图。系统利用零拷贝Rust边缘端在纳秒级解析新闻，结合多变量神经Hawkes过程与自适应剪枝进行推理，端到端延迟仅13毫秒。在FNSPID数据集上，该系统在次日收益的90分位数阈值上实现了相较随机1.70倍、相较同行业基线3.36倍的精确率提升，且移除图拓扑后精确率归零，证实了动态注意力网络的核心驱动作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统逐只股票的预测模型忽视了公司间的交叉传播效应（如台积电代工厂中断对苹果股价的滞后影响），单一资产模型无法捕捉此类跨公司信号，需要一种能够建模跨公司动态注意力的架构。

Method: 提出异构Rust-Python流式架构，包含两大模块：(1) 摄入端——零拷贝Rust边缘解析器，约100纳秒解析新闻记录，约1.2微秒扫描目标股票池；(2) 推理端——多变量神经Hawkes过程，配备逐节点连续时间LSTM状态和双线性潜在投影以传播有向激励，同时引入自适应剪枝规则控制动态邻域更新的计算成本。两阶段合并后在单颗商用CPU上实现约13毫秒的端到端处理延迟。

Result: 在FNSPID语料库的一个月时序留存集（638篇文章，47只股票）上，系统在次日收益的90分位数阈值上实现相较随机基准1.70倍的精确率提升，相较同行业基线3.36倍提升。移除图拓扑后精确率降至零，证实动态注意力网络是跨公司信号的唯一驱动因素。

Conclusion: 跨公司注意力建模对金融时间序列预测至关重要，所提出的流式架构在极低延迟下有效捕获了文本驱动的公司间传播信号，图拓扑是信号来源的核心，移除后将完全丧失预测能力。

Abstract: Per-ticker forecasting models dominate financial time-series work yet remain blind to cross-company propagation: a foundry disruption in Taiwan does not register in a single-asset model until Apple's own price has already moved. To address this limitation, we introduce a heterogeneous Rust-Python streaming architecture that maps cross-company attention as a continuous-time graph driven directly from text. We show that on the ingestion side, a zero-copy Rust edge parses news records in $\sim$100 ns and scans the target equity universe in $\sim$1.2 $μ$s. On the inference end, a multivariate Neural Hawkes Process featuring per-node continuous-time LSTM states and a bilinear latent projection propagates directed excitation, while an adaptive pruning rule bounds the computational cost of dynamic neighborhood updates. Combining these stages, we demonstrate an end-to-end processing latency of $\sim$13 ms per incoming news record on a single commodity CPU. Evaluated on a one-month temporal holdout of the FNSPID corpus (638 articles across 47 tickers), the system delivers a $1.70\times$ precision lift over random at the 90th-percentile next-day return threshold, and $3.36\times$ over a same-sector baseline. Crucially, removing the graph topology collapses precision to zero, confirming that the dynamic attention network is the sole driver of cross-company signal in this architecture.

</details>


### [232] [Causal Longitudinal Prior-Fitted Networks for Counterfactual Outcome Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05797)
*Amirhossein Zare,Amirhessam Zare,Herlock Rahimi,Reza Salarikia,Mohammad Kashkooli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CausalLongPFN 是一种在大规模合成因果时序数据上预训练的冻结模型，无需针对特定领域重新训练即可进行纵向因果预测，在反事实基准和MIMIC-III真实数据上表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际纵向治疗决策面临时变混杂、患者动态异质性及领域数据稀缺等挑战。现有方法需为每个队列或模拟器单独训练模型，当重复训练成本高昂或不切实际时，亟需一种一次预训练即可泛化至多场景的替代方案。

Method: 提出 Causal Longitudinal Prior-Fitted Networks，基于广泛的时序结构因果模型先验合成海量训练片段，涵盖治疗-混杂反馈、隐异质性、非线性状态演化、延迟效应及累积治疗响应等机制。预训练后在测试时冻结参数，仅通过上下文支持轨迹、查询历史及拟议的未来治疗序列，无需梯度更新或倾向模型拟合，直接输出反事实结果的预测分布；多步预测通过递归调用单步预测器实现。

Result: 在可分支的癌症、HIV 和华法林反事实基准上，CausalLongPFN 与领域定制纵向基线方法具竞争力；在 MIMIC-III ICU 事实性滚动预测任务上也表现强劲。

Conclusion: 大规模合成因果预训练可在重复领域训练成本高或不现实时，作为一种有效的冻结模型替代方案用于纵向因果预测。

Abstract: Longitudinal treatment decisions require predicting potential outcomes under future treatment sequences in the presence of time-varying confounding, heterogeneous patient dynamics, and limited domain-specific data. Existing longitudinal causal estimators typically train a new model for each cohort or simulator. We introduce Causal Longitudinal Prior-Fitted Networks (CausalLongPFN), a prior-fitted in-context predictor for longitudinal causal prediction. The model is pretrained entirely on synthetic episodes sampled from a broad prior over temporal structural causal models, exposing it to treatment-confounder feedback, latent heterogeneity, nonlinear state evolution, delayed effects, and cumulative treatment responses. At test time, CausalLongPFN is frozen: it conditions on support trajectories, a query history, and a proposed future treatment sequence, and returns a predictive distribution over future outcomes without gradient updates or propensity-model fitting. Multi-step predictions are obtained by recursively applying the one-step predictor under the specified treatment sequence. We evaluate on branchable cancer, HIV, and warfarin benchmarks with ground-truth counterfactual labels, and on factual-only rolling-origin prediction in MIMIC-III ICU trajectories. CausalLongPFN is competitive with domain-trained longitudinal baselines on counterfactual benchmarks and performs strongly on factual MIMIC-III prediction, suggesting that broad synthetic causal pretraining can provide a useful frozen alternative when repeated domain-specific training is costly or impractical.

</details>


### [233] [Evidence-Guided Neural Architecture Selection under Uncertainty for Subject-Specific Blood Glucose Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05373)
*Md Azharul Islam,Dwyer Deighan,Tarunraj Singha,Danial Faghihi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EVIDENT 框架通过贝叶斯训练、证据排序和不确定性下的验证，系统性地选择兼具可靠性与泛化能力的最小容量神经架构，尤其适用于数据受限、噪声大且异质的个体化血糖预测场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在时间序列预测中，尤其是数据有限、噪声大且异质（如1型糖尿病患者的个体化血糖预测）的条件下，传统启发式架构设计与验证方法难以保证预测的准确性和可靠性。需要一个系统化的架构选择框架来识别既能满足验证标准、又具备良好泛化能力的最低复杂度模型。
