### [303] [Non-Negative Matrix Factorization for Event Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06205)
*Raphaël Romero*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出EventNMF，一种直接在连续时间事件数据上进行非负矩阵分解的模型。该方法将每个实体的事件建模为泊松过程，其强度函数通过非负B样条基进行分解，从而恢复可解释的共享时间模板，避免了传统分箱或平滑预处理带来的信息损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续时间事件数据广泛存在于神经科学、地震学、社交网络等领域。尽管NMF是发现此类数据可解释结构的自然工具，但现有方法必须先对实体级别的计数测度进行分箱或平滑处理，这一预处理步骤会抹去实体级别的异质性和细粒度时间特征。因此，需要一种直接在连续时间域上运行的NMF方法。

Method: EventNMF将每个实体的事件建模为泊松过程，其强度函数通过非负B样条基进行分解，从而提取跨实体共享的、可解释的时间模板。该模型在数学上有严格基础，估计过程简单且计算高效。作者还证明了标准的分箱计数方法是零阶样条的特殊情形，并探讨了偏差-方差权衡。

Result: 在合成潜在因子模型上，EventNMF与现有方法进行了比较，展示了其在不同设置下的偏差-方差权衡特性。在多个真实世界应用中，EventNMF展现了有效性，能够恢复出可解释的共享时间模式。

Conclusion: EventNMF为连续时间事件数据提供了一种无需预处理的非负分解方案，兼具数学严谨性、实现简便性和计算效率。零阶样条与分箱方法的理论联系进一步巩固了该方法的基础，实验结果表明其在合成和真实数据上均具有优异表现。

Abstract: Continuous-time event data, in which entities emit instantaneous events over time, arises naturally across many domains such as neuroscience, seismology, and social networks. Non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) is a natural tool to uncover interpretable structure in such data, but it has so far only been applied after binning or smoothing the entity-level counting measures. This preprocessing step comes with the risk of erasing entity-level heterogeneities and fine-grained temporal features. In this paper, we introduce EventNMF, a continuous-time non-negative factorization model that operates directly on event times: each entity's events are modeled as a Poisson process whose intensity factorizes through a non-negative B-spline basis, and a simple estimation procedure recovers interpretable temporal templates shared across entities. The resulting method is mathematically principled, easy to implement, and computationally efficient. We further show that standard binned-count approaches arise as the special case of degree-zero splines, explore bias-variance tradeoffs and compare against existing methods on a synthetic latent factor model, and demonstrate the effectiveness of EventNMF on several real-world applications.

</details>


### [304] [Design a Reliable LLM-Integrated Interface for Mortality Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06235)
*Thi Kim Ngan Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种集成大语言模型（LLM）的死亡率预测界面，将自然语言输入转化为结构化预测配置，在保持统计严谨性和可复现性的同时，大幅降低了非专家用户的使用门槛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 死亡率预测在精算与政策制定中至关重要，但其技术实现复杂，非专业用户难以直接使用。现有的统计方法虽然成熟，但缺乏易用的交互界面。作者旨在探索如何利用LLM提升可访问性，同时不牺牲预测的透明度、可复现性和精算有效性。

Method: 采用三阶段方法论：(1) 基于CoMoMo包构建基线预测流程，复现已有的死亡率预测结果；(2) 扩展流程以生成多步预测，并使用滚动起点评估（rolling-origin evaluation）和均方误差（MSE）进行验证；(3) 开发原型界面，利用本地LLM作为受约束的编排层，将用户的自然语言请求转化为确定性预测流程的结构化配置。

Result: 系统成功证明：LLM可以在不损害可复现性、透明度和精算有效性的前提下，增强高风险分析工作流的可访问性。本地LLM作为编排层，能够准确地将自然语言指令映射到结构化的预测配置，且底层预测引擎保持确定性和可审计性。

Conclusion: 将LLM作为受约束的编排层集成到死亡率预测流程中，是一条兼顾易用性与统计严谨性的可行路径。该方法为在高风险精算与政策分析场景中引入AI辅助交互提供了安全、透明的范式。

Abstract: Mortality forecasting plays an important role in actuarial and policy decision-making, but its implementation remains technically complex and inaccessible to non-expert users. This project proposes a reliable large language model (LLM)-integrated interface that improves usability while maintaining statistical power. The LLM is designed as a constrained orchestration layer that translates natural-language inputs into structured configurations for a deterministic forecasting pipeline. A three-phase methodology is employed to ensure accuracy, usability, and transparency. First, a baseline pipeline is implemented using the CoMoMo package, reproducing established mortality forecasting results. Second, the pipeline is extended to generate multi-step forecasts using rolling-origin evaluation and mean squared error (MSE). Third, a prototype interface uses a local LLM to handle users' forecasting requests in plain language. The system demonstrates that LLMs can enhance accessibility without compromising reproducibility, transparency, or actuarial validity in high-stakes analytical workflows.

</details>


### [305] [Tracing the Oracle: Improving Diffusion Timestep Scheduling for 3D CT Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06236)
*Yujia Wu,Zhaoqiang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Tracing the Oracle (TrO) 提出一种即插即用的优化时间步调度框架，通过动态规划将少量采样步精确分配至扩散反向过程中的关键演化阶段，显著提升3D CT重建的精度与效率，尤其在≤10步的严格预算下表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练扩散模型在3D CT逆问题求解中潜力巨大，但推理计算开销高；现有均匀时间步调度未能捕捉逆向条件扩散SDE的非均匀演化特性，引入显著的截断误差。因此需要一种能感知演化动态的优化调度策略。

Method: 提出TrO框架：首先在少量样本上以密集采样数值积分轨迹作为"神谕"参考（oracle）；然后利用动态规划全局最小化少步近似与oracle之间的累积误差，从而提取出非均匀的优化时间步调度，将有限采样步精准分配到最易受截断误差影响的关键演化阶段。

Result: 在AAPM数据集上的多类3D CT重建任务中，TrO与SOTA方法DDS结合后，相比现有启发式调度策略，在不超过10个采样步的严格预算下，显著提升了重建保真度和计算效率。

Conclusion: TrO作为一种即插即用的时间步优化框架，有效解决了扩散模型在3D CT重建中推理效率与精度的矛盾，通过动态规划实现非均匀调度，在极低采样步数下仍能保持高保真重建。

Abstract: Pretrained diffusion models demonstrate impressive potential in solving highly ill-posed 3D computed tomography (CT) inverse problems, while the inference process suffers from significant computational overhead. Furthermore, existing uniform timestep schedules fail to capture the non-uniform evolution of the reverse conditional diffusion stochastic differential equation, thereby introducing substantial truncation errors. To overcome this limitation, we propose Tracing the Oracle (TrO), a plug-and-play framework for improved timestep scheduling. Specifically, we treat densely sampled numerical integration trajectories on a few samples as the reference oracle. The optimized schedule is extracted by leveraging dynamic programming to globally minimize the cumulative error between the few-step approximation and the oracle. This mechanism precisely allocates the limited sampling steps to critical evolution stages that are highly susceptible to truncation errors. Our extensive experiments on the AAPM dataset across multiple 3D CT reconstruction tasks demonstrate that, when combined with the state-of-the-art 3D CT reconstruction method DDS, our optimized timesteps significantly improve reconstruction fidelity and computational efficiency compared to existing heuristic schedules, especially under a strict budget of no more than 10 sampling steps.

</details>


### [306] [Generative Criticality in Large Language Model Temperature Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06238)
*Huajian Ruan,Jinyang Li,Xingyu Guo,Lingxiao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将LLM生成的token嵌入视为一维链上的连续自旋变量，通过统计场论框架分析softmax温度变化下的集体行为，发现类似连续相变的临界现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索大型语言模型输出文本的集体统计结构，寻找解码策略与临界现象之间的深层联系，为LLM行为提供定量分析工具。

Method: 构建统计场论框架：将token嵌入作为一维链上的连续自旋变量；定义连接两点关联函数的磁化率，以及系综平均嵌入场的序参量；在不同softmax温度T下测量磁化率峰值和序参量变化；用TwoNN方法独立估计本征维度进行交叉验证；在Qwen3系列（0.6B-32B）多尺度模型和多种提示类别上测试。

Result: 在特征温度Tc附近观测到尖锐的磁化率峰值，呈现幂律标度行为；序参量在Tc附近快速变化；低于Tc时系统坍缩到单一语义方向；TwoNN本征维度在Tc处达到最小值；结果在模型尺度和提示类别上具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: LLM输出表现出与连续相变高度相似的集体统计现象，但由于自回归生成的非平衡本质，尚不能断定为真正的平衡态相变。该框架为探究LLM输出的统计结构提供了定量工具，并提示解码策略与临界现象之间可能存在深层关联。

Abstract: We propose a statistical-field framework for text generated by large language models (LLMs), treating token embeddings as continuous spin variables on a one-dimensional chain. Defining a susceptibility from the connected two-point correlator and an order parameter from the ensemble-averaged embedding field, we vary the \texttt{softmax} temperature $T$ and observe a sharp susceptibility peak near a characteristic $T_c$ with power-law-like scaling, a concurrent rapid change in the order parameter, and a collapse onto a single semantic direction below $T_c$. The intrinsic dimension estimated by the two nearest neighbor (TwoNN) method independently corroborates these findings, reaching a minimum near $T_c$. Results are robust across model scales (Qwen3: 0.6B--32B) and prompt categories. While the phenomenology closely resembles a continuous phase transition, the non-equilibrium nature of autoregressive generation warrants further investigation. Our framework provides quantitative tools for probing the collective statistical structure of LLM outputs and suggests connections between decoding strategies and critical phenomena.

</details>


### [307] [Your GFlowNet Secretly Learns an Optimal Transport Plan](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06272)
*Ian Maksimov,Nikita Morozov,Denis Belomestny,Sergey Samsonov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立了非无环 GFlowNets 与最优传输之间的理论联系，证明在最小流 GFlowNet 中固定初始流分布可将其目标转化为图诱导最短路径成本下的 Kantorovich 最优传输问题，从而通过采样轨迹恢复最优耦合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GFlowNets 是一类通过有向图中的随机轨迹采样结构化对象的框架，但此前缺乏将其与最优传输（OT）理论联系起来的理论分析。作者旨在弥合这一理论空白，使 GFlowNet 学习框架能够应用于大规模图上的最优传输问题。

Method: 作者从理论上推导证明：在最小流（minimum-flow）GFlowNet 中固定初始流分布，等价于将 GFlowNet 目标函数转化为一个以图诱导最短路径为代价的 Kantorovich 最优传输问题。在最优解处，GFlowNet 学习到的策略编码了从源分布到目标分布的最优传输计划，且从最小流 GFlowNet 中采样轨迹可恢复对应的最优耦合。该方法利用边流（edge flows）和神经网络参数化在大规模图上进行实现。

Result: 实验结果表明，所提方法与精确 OT 求解器结果一致，并证明 GFlowNets 能够学习到高质量的传输计划。

Conclusion: GFlowNets 与最优传输之间存在深层理论联系，借助该联系可将 GFlowNet 框架有效应用于大规模图上的 OT 问题，且能学习到高质量的最优传输计划。

Abstract: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) are a framework for sampling structured objects via stochastic trajectories in a directed graph. In this work, we establish a theoretical connection between non-acyclic GFlowNets and optimal transport (OT). We show that fixing the initial flow distribution in a minimum-flow GFlowNet reduces its objective to a Kantorovich OT problem with graph-induced shortest path costs. At the optimum, the learned GFlowNet policy therefore encodes an optimal transport plan from the source distribution to the target distribution: we show that sampling trajectories from the minimum-flow GFlowNet recovers the corresponding optimal coupling. Our formulation enables applying the GFlowNet learning framework to OT problems on large graphs via edge flows and neural parameterization. Experiments confirm agreement with exact OT solvers and demonstrate that GFlowNets can learn high-quality transport plans.

</details>


### [308] [Reactive Flux Matching: Mechanism Discovery and Adaptive Sampling of Rare Events](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06295)
*Rishal Aggarwal,David Ryan Koes,Nicholas M. Boffi,Eric Vanden-Eijnden*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通量匹配（Flux Matching）是一种从反应性轨迹数据中直接学习反应路径和反应坐标的框架，无需底层动力学先验知识，且在非马尔可夫集体变量投影下依然良态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 路径采样方法能生成大量连接亚稳态的反应性轨迹，但从这些数据中提取清晰的机理洞见（如主导反应路径和反应坐标）仍具挑战。现有基于承诺者（committor）的方法在投影到非马尔可夫集体变量时会失效。

Method: 提出Flux Matching框架，通过最小化反应路径系综上的二次泛函，直接从轨迹数据中学习两个互补对象：(1) 流速场 u(z)，其流线追踪主导反应通路；(2) 标量势 h(z)，由反应流的加权Helmholtz-Hodge分解得到，作为数据驱动的反应坐标。该框架类似生成建模中的flow matching损失，且无需知晓底层动力学或稳态分布。

Result: 在分子体系上验证了Flux Matching：成功生成流速轨迹，并用于速率常数计算。u 和 h 在非马尔可夫集体变量投影下保持良态，其水平集可为增强采样方法提供自适应界面。

Conclusion: Flux Matching为从反应性轨迹数据中提取反应机理提供了统一且鲁棒的框架，兼具反应路径可视化和反应坐标构建功能，并与增强采样方法自然衔接。

Abstract: Path sampling methods generate ensembles of reactive trajectories connecting metastable states, but extracting mechanistic insight from these data remains nontrivial. We introduce Flux Matching, a framework that learns two complementary objects directly from reactive trajectory data: a current velocity $u(z)$, whose streamlines trace the dominant reaction pathways, and a scalar potential $h(z)$, obtained from a weighted Helmholtz-Hodge decomposition of the reactive current, that serves as a data-driven reaction coordinate. Both minimize quadratic functionals over the reactive path ensemble, analogous to the flow matching loss in generative modeling, and require no knowledge of the underlying dynamics or stationary distribution. Unlike committor-based methods, $u$ and $h$ remain well-defined under projection onto non-Markovian collective variables, and their level sets in turn provide adaptive interfaces for improved sampling with enhanced sampling methods. Flux Matching is validated through the generation of current velocity trajectories and rate constant calculations on molecular systems.

</details>


### [309] [Tangram: Unlocking Non-Uniform KV Cache for Efficient Multi-turn LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06302)
*Hyungmin Kim,Minsoo Kim,Hongseok Kim,Jungwook Choi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Tangram 是一个面向非均匀 KV 缓存压缩的 LLM 推理服务系统，通过确定性预算分配、Head Group Page 和 Ahead-of-Time 负载均衡三项技术，解决了非均匀 KV 缓存带来的内存碎片、调度复杂性和 GPU 利用率下降等系统性问题，在保持模型精度的同时将吞吐量提升至基线系统的 2.6 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮 LLM 服务中 KV 缓存线性增长对 GPU 内存和带宽构成巨大压力。虽然非均匀 KV 压缩通过考虑每个 KV 缓存的重要性来更有效地保留信息，但其引入的异构性导致内存碎片、调度复杂化和内核利用率下降等系统性挑战，现有服务系统难以高效处理。

Method: Tangram 提出三项核心技术：(1) 确定性预算分配 (Deterministic Budget Allocation)，根据每个注意力头的内在模式分配静态内存占用，彻底消除动态调度开销和预填充停顿；(2) Head Group Page，将具有相似保留需求的注意力头聚类，并以独立的向量化页表进行管理，最大化物理内存回收；(3) Ahead-of-Time (AOT) 负载均衡，利用静态预算配置在运行时零开销条件下实现 GPU 利用率的均衡。

Result: 实验结果表明，Tangram 在完全保持模型精度的前提下，相较现有基线系统将吞吐量提升高达 2.6 倍。

Conclusion: Tangram 成功将非均匀 KV 缓存压缩从理论可行性推向实用化，为解决 LLM 推理服务中的内存瓶颈提供了高效的系统级方案。

Abstract: Multi-turn Large Language Model (LLM) serving is critical for consistent user experiences, yet the linear growth of the Key-Value (KV) cache imposes significant pressure on GPU memory and bandwidth. Non-uniform KV compression effectively preserves more information by considering the individual importance of each KV cache. However, such KV cache heterogeneity introduces various systemic challenges - including memory fragmentation, scheduling complexities, and diminished kernel utilization - which collectively lead to significant inefficiencies in existing LLM serving systems.
  To overcome these challenges, we present Tangram, a novel serving system designed to make Non-uniform KV caches practical. Tangram addresses systemic inefficiencies through three core techniques: (1) Deterministic Budget Allocation assigns a static memory footprint to each head based on its intrinsic pattern, entirely eliminating dynamic scheduling overhead and prefill stalls; (2) Head Group Page clusters attention heads with similar retention demands and manages them with independent, vectorized page tables, thereby maximizing physical memory reclamation; and (3) Ahead-of-Time (AOT) Load Balancing leverages static budget profiles to ensure uniform GPU utilization without runtime overhead. Experimental results show that Tangram improves throughput by up to 2.6x compared to existing baselines, while fully preserving model accuracy. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/aiha-lab/TANGRAM.

</details>


### [310] [Plug-and-Play Guidance for Discrete Diffusion Models via Gradient-Informed Logit Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06303)
*Hongkun Dou,Zike Chen,Fengji Li,Hongjue Li,Yue Deng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GILC 是一种即插即用的可控离散扩散生成框架，通过将预训练去噪网络作为变分代理来估计引导信号，并引入无雅可比机制直接修正 logits，实现对可微与不可微奖励函数的支持，在 DNA、蛋白质和分子生成任务上达到 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散模型的可控生成通常面临计算开销高或需要重新训练的问题，现有方法在梯度稳定性和通用性上存在不足。

Method: 提出 GILC 框架：(1) 将预训练去噪网络复用作变分代理，高效估计引导信号；(2) 引入无雅可比机制（Jacobian-free），绕过离散高维空间中的梯度不稳定问题，直接对干净预测 logits 进行修正；(3) 同时兼容可微与不可微奖励函数。

Result: 在 DNA 序列、蛋白质序列和分子生成三个任务上取得 SOTA，无需额外训练，且常优于需要微调的方法。

Conclusion: GILC 提供了一种无需重训练、即插即用的离散扩散可控生成方案，兼具高效性、稳定性和通用性，在多个生物序列与分子设计任务上验证了其优越性。

Abstract: Controllable generation with discrete diffusion models is often hindered by high computational overhead or the need for retraining. In this paper, we present \underline{\textbf{G}}radient-\underline{\textbf{I}}nformed \underline{\textbf{L}}ogit \underline{\textbf{C}}orrection (\textbf{GILC}), a plug-and-play framework that efficiently estimates guidance signals by repurposing the pretrained denoising network as a variational proxy. To circumvent the gradient instability inherent in high-dimensional discrete spaces, we introduce a Jacobian-free mechanism that directly corrects the clean prediction logits, facilitating stable and effective guidance. Our method accommodates both differentiable and non-differentiable reward functions. Extensive experiments across DNA, protein sequence, and molecular generation tasks demonstrate that GILC achieves state-of-the-art performance without additional training, frequently outperforming fine-tuning approaches.

</details>


### [311] [Learning What to Forget: Improving LLM Unlearning via Learned Token-Level Importance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06320)
*Gizem Yüce,Giorgos Nikolaou,Nicolas Flammarion*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出交替令牌加权遗忘（ATWU）框架，通过联合优化模型参数和令牌权重，利用保留目标冲突自动识别需要遗忘的令牌级信息，无需外部监督即可实现最先进的遗忘-保留权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法要么忽略令牌层面的异质性，要么依赖辅助模型、启发式或外部标注来估计令牌的遗忘相关性。作者提出通过"保留冲突"这一内在标准来刻画令牌的遗忘特异性——即最小化某令牌上的遗忘损失是否与保留最优性产生冲突。

Method: 将遗忘问题形式化为模型参数与令牌权重的联合优化问题，理论证明在自然分离条件下可恢复oracle遗忘令牌支持集。基于此提出ATWU框架：在遗忘过程中通过隐藏状态上的简单线性评分器联合学习令牌遗忘特异性和模型参数，无需外部令牌级监督。

Result: 在TOFU和RWKU基准上，ATWU实现了最先进的遗忘-保留权衡，优于样本级方法、基于概率的令牌加权启发式方法以及基于辅助模型的方法。学习到的评分与真实遗忘跨度高度对齐，能识别语义上有意义的令牌级遗忘信号。

Conclusion: 保留冲突是识别语言模型应遗忘内容的有效标准，使从模型表示中无监督学习令牌级遗忘特异性成为可能，且计算开销极小。

Abstract: Machine unlearning aims to remove targeted knowledge from a trained model while preserving its general capabilities. For autoregressive language models, not all tokens in a forget sample are equally relevant to forgetting. Existing approaches either ignore this heterogeneity or rely on auxiliary models, heuristics, or external annotations to estimate each token's relevance for forgetting. We instead characterize it through the interaction with the retain objective: a token is forget-specific to the extent that minimizing the forget loss on that token does not conflict with retain optimality. We formalize this perspective as a joint optimization problem over the model parameters and the token weights and show that, under a natural separation condition, the resulting objective recovers the oracle forget-specific token support. Motivated by this formulation, we introduce Alternating Token-Weighted Unlearning (ATWU), a lightweight framework that jointly learns token forget-specificity and model parameters during unlearning using a simple linear scorer over the hidden states, without external token level supervision. Across TOFU and RWKU, ATWU achieves state of the art forget-retain trade-offs, outperforming sample-level methods, probability-based token weighting heuristics, and auxiliary-model-based approaches. Moreover, the learned scores align substantially better with ground truth forget-specific spans, indicating that ATWU identifies semantically meaningful token level forgetting signals. Overall, our results suggest that retain conflict provides an effective criterion for identifying what language models should forget, enabling unsupervised learning of token level forget-specificity directly from model representations with minimal computational overhead.

</details>


### [312] [PAMF: Prior-Aware Multimodal Fusion for Incomplete Time Series Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06328)
*Ziwen Kan,Wugeng Zheng,Tianlong Chen,Song Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PAMF框架，针对医疗多模态时间序列中的两种缺失模式（模态内缺失与模态级缺失），通过先验感知的流匹配和权重共享机制，将缺失值填补与下游预测任务耦合，在多个医疗时序基准上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗多模态时间序列常面临不完整观测，缺失呈两种结构模式：模态内缺失（如ECG片段丢失）和模态级缺失（如整个呼吸通道不可用）。现有方法要么仅用掩码隐式表示缺失，要么将填补与下游任务隔离，且忽视两种缺失模式的结构差异，导致填补信息不够任务相关。

Method: 提出PAMF框架：(1) 用类型特定先验初始化流匹配的源状态，区分两种缺失类型；(2) 通过架构匹配的编码器实现权重共享，将任务相关表征传递到填补过程中，使填补与分类任务耦合。整体基于先验感知流匹配（prior-aware flow matching）实现显式缺失估计。

Result: 在多个多模态医疗时间序列基准数据集上，PAMF在多种缺失设定下均取得最优的下游任务性能，超越现有基线方法。

Conclusion: PAMF通过显式区分缺失模式并将填补与下游预测耦合，有效提升了对不完整多模态医疗时序数据的建模能力，验证了任务引导的填补策略相较于隔离式填补的优越性。

Abstract: In healthcare, multimodal time series tasks often operate on incomplete observations in practice, for example when ECG segments are lost because electrodes detach or an entire respiratory channel is unavailable during overnight monitoring. Such missingness typically appears in two structurally distinct patterns: within-modality missing, where values are absent within an otherwise observed modality, and modality-level missing, where an entire modality is unavailable. Existing methods typically represent unobserved data implicitly through masks or missing embeddings, without learning instance-specific missing information, and most are designed for only one missingness pattern. A natural approach is to explicitly estimate the missing data; however, existing imputation methods treat missingness uniformly despite their different structural priors, and the imputation process is often isolated from downstream tasks, preventing downstream tasks from guiding imputation toward more informative representations. To address these limitations, we present PAMF, a multimodal time-series framework that explicitly handles different missingness patterns while coupling imputation with downstream prediction through prior-aware flow matching and weight sharing. Specifically, the method initializes the flow-matching source state with type-specific priors to distinguish two missing types. It further connects imputation and classification through architecturally matched encoders with weight sharing, transferring task-relevant representations into the imputation process. Experiments on multiple multimodal healthcare time-series benchmarks show that the proposed method achieves the strongest overall downstream performance across diverse datasets and missing settings compared with existing baselines.

</details>


### [313] [Subspace-Aware Sparse Autoencoders for Effective Mechanistic Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06333)
*Seyed Arshan Dalili,Mehrdad Mahdavi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 标准稀疏自编码器假设特征是单维的，但实际模型特征具有多维结构，导致特征分裂呈指数级增长。本文提出子空间感知稀疏自编码器（SASA），用学习到的解码器子空间替代单向量解码器，将样本复杂度从指数级降至多项式级，在GPT-2和Mistral-7B上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准SAE为每个潜在特征分配单一解码器方向，隐含假设特征是一维的。但LLM中的特征本质上是多维的（如具有内在维度d_i≥2）。这种单维假设与实际多维结构之间的失配会导致特征分裂（feature splitting），即一个完整特征被碎片化为大量近似共线的潜在表示，产生伪多重性并模糊内在几何结构。

Method: 提出Subspace-Aware Sparse Autoencoders (SASA)。核心改进包括：（1）用可学习的解码器子空间替代单一向量解码器；（2）通过Top-s组门控机制实现块稀疏性；（3）利用核范数正则化器自适应调整各组的有效秩。理论证明，当块大小r ≥ d_i时，单个组不仅能表示完整特征切片，而且是SASA目标的全局最小化器。

Result: 理论上证明了两种特征分裂机制：几何上，用单方向解码器重建d_i维特征到误差ε需要指数级数量的原子；优化角度上，存在从真实d_i维基到严格更低ℓ1正则化SAE风险的连续路径。SASA将样本复杂度从指数级降至d_i的多项式级。实验上，在GPT-2和Mistral-7B上，SASA减少了特征分裂和吸收现象，提升了单义性和可解释性，仅需约一半的token预算即可达到或超越标准SAE。

Conclusion: 标准SAE的单方向解码器假设是其根本性局限，会导致特征的系统性碎片化。SASA通过子空间解码器和块稀疏性有效解决了这一问题，兼具理论优雅性和实践有效性，为LLM的机制可解释性提供了更可靠的工具。

Abstract: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used for mechanistic interpretability in large language models, yet their formulation assigns each latent feature a single decoder direction, implicitly assuming features to be one-dimensional. We show that this assumption mismatches with the multi-dimensional structure of model features, provably inducing feature splitting through two distinct mechanisms. Geometrically, reconstructing a feature of intrinsic dimension $d_i \ge 2$ to error $\varepsilon$ with single-direction decoders forces a number of atoms that is exponential in $d_i$. From an end-to-end optimization perspective, this splitting is not merely possible but actively preferred. We prove that there exists a continuous path from the true $d_i$-dimensional basis to a strictly lower risk of the $\ell_1$-regularized SAE objective, whose descent directions drive any trained dictionary into that exponential regime. A single coherent feature is therefore fragmented across many near-collinear latents, producing spurious multiplicity and obscuring the intrinsic geometry. Motivated by this, we introduce Subspace-Aware Sparse Autoencoders (SASA), which replace single-vector decoders with learned decoder subspaces, enforce block sparsity via Top-$s$ group gating, and adapt each group's effective rank with a nuclear-norm regularizer. We then show that once the block size satisfies $r \ge d_i$, a single group not only can represent the entire feature slice but is the global minimizer of the SASA objective. This consolidation yields a sample complexity polynomial in $d_i$ rather than exponential -- a decisive advantage given that every training activation costs an LLM forward pass. Empirically, on GPT-2 and Mistral-7B, SASA reduces feature splitting and absorption, improves monosemanticity and interpretability, and matches or exceeds standard SAEs while training on roughly half the token budget.

</details>


### [314] [Quantifying the Privacy of Counterfactuals by Leveraging Membership Inference Attacks Against Synthetic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06334)
*Maryam Babaei,Yingke Wang,Hadrien Lautraite,Heber H. Arcolezi,Ulrich Aivodji,Sebastien Gambs*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了反事实解释可被用于实施成员推理攻击，即使攻击者仅拥有反事实样本而无模型查询权限，借鉴针对合成数据的攻击方法即可成功推断训练数据成员信息，警示模型开发者发布反事实时的隐私风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反事实解释在高风险决策中被广泛用于解释机器学习模型，但已有研究主要关注需模型查询权限的隐私攻击。作者注意到反事实与合成数据在"作为真实训练数据的现实替代品"这一特性上的相似性，旨在探索是否可借鉴合成数据领域的成熟攻击方法，在无需模型访问的条件下对反事实解释实施成员推理攻击。

Method: 研究者借鉴针对合成数据的成员推理攻击框架，将其迁移至反事实解释场景。具体而言，将多种类型的反事实样本视为类合成数据，应用已有的合成数据成员推理攻击技术，在不访问生成模型的前提下，仅基于一组反事实样本评估训练数据成员信息的泄露程度。

Result: 实验证明：针对合成数据设计的成员推理攻击可成功迁移至各类反事实解释上；更重要的是，即使攻击者完全无法查询原始模型、仅掌握一组反事实样本，也能有效推断某条记录是否属于模型训练集，这对现有攻击假设（通常需要模型查询权限）构成重要突破。

Conclusion: 模型开发者在向用户发布反事实解释时必须更为谨慎，因为反事实样本本身即可能泄露训练数据成员信息，构成隐私泄露风险。研究拓展了对反事实解释隐私威胁的认知边界。

Abstract: Counterfactuals are typically used in high-stakes decision areas to explain a machine learning model by showing how changes to the user profiles result in the desired outcome. However, explaining the model's decisions through counterfactuals can also be exploited by an adversary to conduct privacy attacks against the model or its training data. Drawing on the analogy that counterfactuals provide realistic substitutes for real training data, similar to synthetic data, we demonstrate in this paper how it is possible to successfully perform privacy attacks on counterfactuals by drawing on the attacks developed against synthetic data. More precisely, we investigate the effectiveness of the membership inference attacks designed for synthetic data on various types of counterfactuals. Additionally, while existing membership inference attacks against counterfactuals usually require to be able to query the model, we show how it is possible to perform successful membership inference attacks using only a set of counterfactuals, with no access to the model from which they are generated. Our results demonstrate that model developers should be more cautious when releasing counterfactuals to various users, as it can lead to a privacy breach.

</details>


### [315] [Bridging Domain Expertise and Generalization for Performance Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06335)
*Shuxuan Li,Zhilin Zhao,Quyu Kong,Wei-Shi Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FRAP方法，通过融合外部基础模型与待评估模型的预测分布，构建更可靠的伪标签参考，从而在分布偏移场景下实现更准确的模型性能估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分布偏移下的性能估计方法仅依赖待评估模型自身的输出，当分布发生偏移时，模型偏差被放大，导致与真实性能的相关性减弱。因此需要引入外部可靠信号来构建更好的性能指标。

Method: FRAP方法分为三步：(1) 通过温度缩放校准，最小化基础模型与待评估模型预测分布之间的散度，实现分布对齐；(2) 基于置信度加权融合两个模型的预测，构建一个融合了基础模型鲁棒性与待评估模型领域专长的参考分布；(3) 通过测量待评估模型预测与融合参考分布之间的一致性程度来估计模型性能。

Result: 在多种数据集和模型架构上的广泛实验表明，FRAP在分布偏移场景下相比代表性性能估计方法取得了一致且显著的提升。

Conclusion: FRAP有效利用外部基础模型的互补优势，通过分布对齐与置信度融合构建高保真参考信号，为无标签分布偏移场景下的模型性能估计提供了可靠解决方案。

Abstract: Performance estimation under distribution shift aims to predict how a model behaves on an unlabeled test set whose distribution differs from the training data, a scenario that requires reliable indicators that can faithfully reflect model behavior without ground-truth labels. Existing approaches rely solely on the outputs of the given model whose biases are amplified once the distribution shifts, weakening the correlation with the true performance. Motivated by this limitation, we propose Fused Reference Alignment Prediction (FRAP), which leverages the complementary strengths of an external foundation model and the base model to construct a more reliable surrogate of the ground-truth labels. FRAP aligns the prediction distribution of the foundation model with that of the base model by applying temperature-scaled calibration that minimizes their divergence. The aligned predictions are fused through confidence-based weighting into a refined reference distribution that integrates robustness from the foundation model and domain-specific expertise from the base model, and performance estimation is obtained by measuring how closely the base model predictions agree with this reference. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets and architectures show that FRAP provides consistent and substantial improvements over representative performance-estimation methods under distribution shift.

</details>


### [316] [Equivariant Neural Belief Propagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06344)
*Zehua Cheng,Wei Dai,Jiahao Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ENBP 提出一种在 SE(3) 等变因子图上传递高斯混合模型消息的框架，通过等变外积合成秩-2 精度张量，利用谱分解与 KL 散度贪心缩减保持可处理性，在分子构象覆盖与多体机器人推理上均实现高精度、快速收敛和机器精度的等变性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有等变网络仅输出标量和向量，无法产生各向异性不确定性所需的秩-2 精度张量；且单分量消息会将多模态能量景观坍缩为物理上无意义的平均。因此需要一种能保持 SE(3) 对称性、同时表达丰富不确定性结构的概率推理框架。

Method: 提出等变神经信念传播（ENBP），在因子图上传递等变高斯混合模型消息。关键技术包括：(1) 通过等变外积合成秩-2 精度矩阵；(2) 使用可微谱分解注入网络；(3) 利用基于 KL 散度的贪心混合缩减保持消息可处理，且该缩减被证明与 SE(3) 变换可交换。

Result: 在 GEOM-QM9 和 GEOM-Drugs 数据集上，ENBP 以亚秒级延迟实现 98.9% 构象覆盖率、0.090 Å 误差，比扩散基线快 100 倍以上且精度更高。在多体机器人推理中，普通 loopy BP 在 15+ 智能体时发散，而 ENBP 收敛且碰撞率接近零，等变性误差约 10⁻⁷（增强基线约 10⁻¹）。

Conclusion: ENBP 将等变表示从标量/向量扩展到完整的秩-2 张量消息，实现了严格 SE(3) 等变的概率推理，在分子构象生成和多体机器人推理等空间推理任务上展现出显著的速度、精度和对称性保持优势。

Abstract: Probabilistic inference over spatially embedded variables requires beliefs that respect $SE(3)$ symmetry, yet existing equivariant networks produce only scalars and vectors -- not the rank-2 precision tensors needed for anisotropic uncertainty, and single-component messages collapse multi-modal energy landscapes to physically meaningless averages. We introduce Equivariant Neural Belief Propagation (ENBP), a factor-graph framework whose messages are equivariant Gaussian mixture models with sufficient statistics that transform exactly under $SE(3)$. Rank-2 precision matrices are synthesised via equivariant outer products, ingested through differentiable spectral decomposition, and kept tractable by a greedy KL-based mixture reduction that provably commutes with $SE(3)$. On GEOM-QM9 and GEOM-Drugs, ENBP achieves 98.9% conformational coverage at 0.090 $\mathring{A}$ error with sub-second latency -- over $100\times$ faster than diffusion baselines at higher accuracy. On multi-body robotic inference, vanilla loopy BP diverges at 15+ agents while ENBP converges with near-zero collision rates and machine-precision equivariance error (${\sim}10^{-7}$ vs.\ $10^{-1}$ for augmented baselines).

</details>


### [317] [In-Context Multiple Instance Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06458)
*Alexander Möllers,Marvin Sextro,Julius Hense,Gabriel Dernbach,Klaus-Robert Müller*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于上下文学习（in-context learning）的MIL方法，使用Perceiver架构在合成数据上预训练，推理时无需梯度更新即可从少量标注包中解决新任务，在12个MIL基准上超越需要任务特定训练的监督基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MIL算法在低标签场景下表现不佳：灵活模型容易过拟合，而刚性模型无法适应具体任务。需要一种能在极少标注样本下快速适应新任务的方法。

Method: 采用Perceiver架构的上下文学习器，在多种合成数据生成器产生的包结构数据上进行预训练。推理时通过单次前向传播完成分类，无需梯度更新。提出并研究了多种互补的合成数据生成器，并将它们的混合用于预训练。

Result: 在12个MIL基准数据集上，混合生成器预训练的模型取得了最佳平均性能，超越了需要任务特定训练的监督基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过在多样化合成数据上预训练上下文学习器，可以有效解决低标签MIL问题。合成数据生成器各具互补的归纳偏置，混合预训练使模型兼具各任务的优势。

Abstract: Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) addresses problems where supervision is available at the level of bags of instances and has been successfully applied in fields ranging from computational pathology to satellite imagery. Nevertheless, existing algorithms struggle in the low-label regime that characterizes many real-world applications. Flexible models overfit and rigid ones fail to adapt to the task at hand. We show that pretraining an in-context learner with a Perceiver-style architecture on synthetic data yields a model that can solve new tasks from a handful of labeled bags. At inference time, classification happens in a single forward pass and requires no gradient updates. We propose and investigate different synthetic data generators for bag-structured data and find that they capture complementary inductive biases. A model pretrained on a mixture of these generators inherits their per-task strengths and achieves the best average performance across twelve MIL benchmarks, outperforming supervised baselines that require task-specific training.

</details>


### [318] [Performance Evaluation of GraphCast for Medium-Range Weather Forecasting over Brazil](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06348)
*Wolfgang R. Rowell,Lucas S. Kupssinskü*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究评估了GraphCast在巴西四个气候亚区的预报性能，与ECMWF IFS HRES基线对比，揭示了其技能呈现明显的气候区制依赖特征：冬季对南巴西斜压系统预报偏弱，但扩展期因平滑混沌变率而占优；夏季则准确捕获大尺度水汽输送，同时抑制对流变率对确定性预报的干扰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLWP模型在全球尺度展现卓越技巧，但在全球南方（尤其是高度对流活跃的复杂环境）的区域验证严重匮乏。有必要填补巴西这类典型热带-副热带过渡区的评估空白，为后续模型的"热带化"优化提供物理边界。

Method: 以ECMWF IFS HRES作为确定性基线，将IFS分析场作为真值；选取T₈₅₀、Q₈₅₀、Z₅₀₀三个对流层变量，覆盖四个季节窗口；采用WeatherBench-X框架和云原生可扩展流水线，在巴西四个气候亚区计算统计指标，对比评估GraphCast operational的预报技巧。

Result: GraphCast呈现区制依赖的预报技巧：(1)南半球冬季，Z₅₀₀在2-7天中期预报上对南巴西快速传播的斜压系统表现不及IFS，但在7天以上扩展期因其对小尺度混沌变率的平滑特性而重新占优；(2)南半球夏季湿季，GraphCast对大尺度水汽输送模拟准确，同时内在地抑制了高频对流变率——这种变率恰是导致确定性NWP温度预报退化的因素。

Conclusion: 该研究为巴西确立了MLWP区域性能基准，明确了模型在热带-副热带环境下存在的特定物理局限与优势，为未来的"热带化"微调工作提供了明确方向，以增强基础AI模型在区域尺度的业务适用性和抗灾韧性。

Abstract: The paradigm of global weather forecasting is rapidly shifting with the emergence of Machine Learning Weather Prediction models (MLWP). While these data-driven architectures demonstrate remarkable global skill, regional benchmarks in the Global South remain scarce, leaving their efficacy in complex, highly convective environments largely unverified. This study evaluates the performance of GraphCast operational against the deterministic ECMWF IFS HRES as baseline across four distinct Brazilian climatic sub-regions. Utilizing a scalable, cloud-native pipeline and the WeatherBench-X framework for benchmarking weather models, we assess selected tropospheric variables ($T_{850}$, $Q_{850}$, $Z_{500}$) over four selected seasonal windows, employing the operational IFS analysis as the ground truth to calculate the statistical metrics for both models. Results reveal a regime-dependent skill profile. During the austral winter, GraphCast underperforms in the medium range (lead days 2-7) for $Z_{500}$ when resolving fast-propagating baroclinic systems over southern Brazil, but regains an advantage in the extended range, where its inherent smoothing of chaotic small-scale variability becomes beneficial under deterministic skill metrics. Conversely, during the austral summer wet season, GraphCast accurately captures large-scale moisture transport while intrinsically dampening the high-frequency convective variability that degrades deterministic NWP temperature forecasts. These findings establish a baseline for Brazil and define the specific physical boundaries that will guide future ``tropicalization'' efforts, aiming to optimize these foundational AI models for regional resilience.

</details>


### [319] [Maximising the Set-Piece Return: Optimising Football Corner Tactics with Graph Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06353)
*Sean Groom,Michael Groom,Francisco Belo,Axl Rice,Liam Anderson,Victor-Alexandru Darvariu,Shuo Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于图强化学习的角球战术优化方法，能够对任意初始球员站位进行通用调整，以最大化首次触球射门概率，在3000+英超角球数据上显著优于传统基线优化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有足球战术机器学习方法主要局限于对历史动作的模仿或分析人员指定的反事实场景，缺乏发现新颖、可泛化的球员配置与策略的能力。作者旨在超越历史模式复现，转向以奖励驱动的战术发现。

Method: 将角球战术优化建模为决策问题：一个中央策略网络对进攻球员的位置和速度进行调整，以最大化首次触球射门概率。核心贡献是构建了一个在图结构数据上运行的强化学习架构，使策略能够泛化到任意初始球员站位，而非仅针对孤立固定阵型进行优化。

Result: 在超过3000个英超角球数据上的评估表明，在匹配推理预算条件下，该方法显著优于传统基线优化技术。

Conclusion: 图强化学习能够将定位球分析范式从历史评估与模仿，转向以奖励为驱动的战术发现，为足球战术分析开辟了新路径。

Abstract: Machine learning is increasingly employed for the evaluation of football tactics. However, existing approaches focus on characterising historical actions or analyst-specified counterfactual scenarios. In this work, we seek to go beyond the imitation of historically observed patterns towards discovering new generalisable player configurations and strategies. To tackle this, we focus on optimising corner kick routines, and formulate a decision-making problem in which a central policy makes adjustments to attacking player positions and velocities to maximise first contact shot probability. Unlike classic optimisation that solves for isolated setups, we contribute a reinforcement learning architecture operating on graph-structured data that yields a general policy for adjusting arbitrary starting player positions. Evaluated on over 3,000 Premier League corners, our approach strongly outperforms baseline optimisation techniques under matched inference budgets. Our results suggest that graph reinforcement learning can shift set-piece analysis from historical evaluation and imitation towards reward-driven tactical discovery.

</details>


### [320] [Learned Response-Field Inertia Operator for HEC-RAS 2D Water-Surface Elevation Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06385)
*Edward Holmberg,Elias Ioup,Md Meftahul Ferdaus,Mahdi Abdelguerfi,Julian Simeonov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了LRFIO，一种基于增量的无强迫学习代理模型，直接在HEC-RAS 2D的非均匀原生计算单元上进行水面高程预测。通过跨数据集评估，证明原生单元增量是强预测支架，且复杂模型组件仅在经验验证合理时才应保留。在四个基准上实现了最高4.30%的验证遗憾，部署速度比HEC-RAS快约2.75×10⁴倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统HEC-RAS 2D代理模型通常依赖栅格重映射，这会引入重映射误差和信息访问混杂。作者希望直接在原始非均匀计算单元上评估学习型代理模型，消除这些干扰因素，并探索在保证求解器一致性的前提下，如何自适应地选择模型复杂度。

Method: 提出LRFIO（Learned Response-Field Inertia Operator）：一种基于增量的无强迫学习代理模型。其核心是一个三层响应层级结构——持久性预测、全局标定惯性和分段响应场惯性。从已求解的HEC-RAS轨迹中离线标定惯性响应算子，部署时通过闭式原生单元 rollout 进行推理。分段、残差校正和神经化惯性被设计为可学习的建模选项，仅当验证证据证明其代价合理时才保留额外复杂度。评估采用显式策略分离静态项目输入、当前水力状态、项目输入强迫、标定导出量和未来求解器输出目标。

Result: 在四个不同HEC-RAS 2D基准上，LRFIO为不同域保留了不同的响应结构，展示了自适应的学习复杂度。选择器审计显示复杂度受控，最大验证遗憾为4.30%。部署时rollout时间在0.003 s至0.242 s之间。Beaver Bayou实测对比给出约2.75×10⁴倍的地平线归一化加速比。

Conclusion: 原生单元增量是强求解器条件化的预测支架；额外的响应场、神经或空间复杂度仅应在经验上得到验证支持时才保留。LRFIO的策略为HEC-RAS 2D代理建模提供了既高效又可解释的自适应方案。

Abstract: This article presents a cross-dataset evaluation of learned native-cell surrogate models for solver-consistent water-surface elevation (WSE) prediction in HEC-RAS 2D. To avoid raster remapping error and information-access confounding, surrogates are evaluated directly on the original nonuniform computational cells under an explicit policy that separates static project inputs, current hydraulic state, project-input forcing, calibration-derived quantities, and future solver-output targets. We introduce the Learned Response-Field Inertia Operator (LRFIO), a no-forcing, increment-based learned surrogate that calibrates an inertial response operator from solved HEC-RAS trajectories and deploys the retained operator through closed-form native-cell rollout. LRFIO evaluates a base-case-first response hierarchy consisting of persistence, global calibrated inertia, and segmented response-field inertia. Segmentation, residual correction, and neuralized inertia are treated as learnable modeling choices, with added complexity retained only when validation evidence justifies its cost. Evaluated across four diverse HEC-RAS 2D benchmarks, LRFIO retains different response structures for different domains, demonstrating adaptive learned complexity. The selector audit shows controlled complexity with a maximum validation regret of 4.30%. During deployment, retained rollout times range from 0.003 s to 0.242 s, and the Beaver Bayou measured-solve comparison gives an estimated 2.75 x 10^4 horizon-normalized speedup over HEC-RAS. These results indicate that the current native-cell increment is a strong solver-conditioned predictive scaffold and that added response-field, neural, or spatial complexity should be retained only when empirically justified.

</details>


### [321] [Proper Scoring Rules for Right-Censored Survival Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06393)
*Jef Jonkers,Glenn Van Wallendael,Luc Duchateau,Sofie Van Hoecke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对右删失生存结果的适当评分规则框架，通过将预测分布经删失机制映射后再应用基础适当评分，得到了定删失时间的局部化评分和随机删失下的边缘化评分，恢复并统一了右删失似然和IPCW类准则，同时构造了CRPS、分位数损失、Brier分数和能量分数的右删失版本，并提出了删失engression这一多元右删失生存建模的样本学习目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 适当的评分规则为概率预测的训练和评估提供了严格理论基础，但在右删失情境下，事件时间仅被部分观测，传统评分规则的标准形式无法直接应用。现有方法缺乏统一框架，且常用的依赖预测的加权评分可能导致排序逆转问题。

Method: 核心思路是将预测分布通过删失机制映射到观测数据律上，再应用基础适当评分。具体包括：(1) 对固定删失时间构造局部化评分；(2) 对随机或部分观测的删失时间，通过在删失时间分布上边缘化得到边缘化评分；(3) 在条件独立删失下证明边缘化评分的适当性和在可识别区域上的严格适当性；(4) 将该原理推广到多元删失生存建模，提出删失engression这一基于样本的学习目标。

Result: 所提评分在多种删失机制下正确排序了oracle预测，而依赖预测的加权评分出现排序逆转。删失engression相比在删失结果上的朴素训练有显著改进。

Conclusion: 该框架为右删失生存预测提供了统一的适当评分构造方法，兼具理论严谨性和实践有效性，避免了现有加权方法的排序逆转问题，并成功拓展至多元删失建模。

Abstract: Proper scoring rules provide a rigorous theoretical basis for the training and evaluation of probabilistic forecasts. However, in the presence of right censoring, the event time is only partially observed, rendering conventional scoring rules inapplicable in their standard form. We propose a framework for proper scoring of right-censored survival outcomes based on a simple idea: first, map the predictive distribution through the censoring mechanism, then apply the underlying proper score on the induced observed-data law. This yields localized scores for fixed censoring times and marginalized scores when the censoring time is random or only partially observed. The resulting construction recovers familiar right-censored likelihood and IPCW-type criteria within a coherent framework, while also yielding right-censored versions of the CRPS, pinball loss, Brier score, and energy score. We show that the marginalized score is proper under conditional independent censoring and strictly proper on the identifiable region. The same principle also leads to censored engression, a sample-based learning objective for multivariate right-censored survival modeling. In experiments, our scores correctly rank the oracle forecast across several censoring regimes, whereas forecast-dependent plug-in weighted scores can exhibit ranking reversals. Censored engression likewise substantially improves over naive training on censored outcomes.

</details>


### [322] [The Post-GCN Decade Revisited: Curvature-Stratified Evaluation of Relational Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06397)
*Shuo Wang,Xiangyu Wang,Quanxin Wang,Bailin Wu,Bokui Wang,Shunyang Huang,Boyan Deng,Haonan Liu,Ruiyi Fang,Zhenxiang Xu,Boyu Wang,Zhao Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文揭示了关系学习中基于平坦排行榜的聚合评估存在系统性偏差，提出按数据集内在几何曲率（正、负、近零）分层评估的框架，发现模型排名在曲率区间内稳定但跨区间显著变化，并据此设计了更可靠的几何感知评估协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前关系学习的评估实践将异构数据集上的性能简单平均，隐含假设所有数据集具有统一底层结构。作者指出这一假设引入系统性偏差，掩盖了模型性能对数据几何属性的依赖，可能导致对模型泛化能力的误导性结论。

Method: 提出曲率分层评估框架（Curvature-Stratified Evaluation Framework）：首先识别数据集的 intrinsic geometry 作为关键潜在因子；然后将数据集按曲率划分为正曲率、负曲率和近零曲率三个区间；在14个数据集上对18个代表性模型（含GCN、图基础模型GFM、表格学习方法）进行基准评测，分析各曲率区间内及跨区间的模型排名变化。

Result: 模型排名在各曲率区间内高度稳定，但跨区间显著偏移，表明性能本质上是几何依赖的而非普遍可迁移的。在特定曲率区间，图基础模型（GFM）相比几何对齐的GNN出现收益递减。曲率分层评估能揭示聚合指标所掩盖的关键性能权衡。

Conclusion: 提出几何感知评估协议，比标准聚合基准更可靠、更具可解释性。公开所有代码、曲率分层数据集划分及评估工具，旨在支持未来关系学习方法的可复现和严格评估。

Abstract: Current evaluation practices in relational learning rely heavily on flat leaderboards that average performance across heterogeneous datasets, implicitly assuming a uniform underlying structure. We show that this assumption introduces systematic bias: it obscures geometry-dependent performance variations and can lead to misleading conclusions about model generalization. In this work, we identify intrinsic geometry as a key latent factor governing model effectiveness. We demonstrate that conventional aggregated metrics mask critical performance trade-offs that only become visible when datasets are stratified by their geometric properties. To address this issue, we introduce a curvature-stratified evaluation framework that partitions datasets into positive, negative, and near-zero curvature regimes. Our benchmark evaluates 18 representative models including Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs), Graph Foundation Models (GFMs), and tabular learning methods across 14 datasets. We find that model rankings are highly stable within each curvature regime but shift significantly across regimes, indicating that performance is fundamentally geometry-dependent rather than universally transferable. Notably, we identify regimes where GFMs offer diminishing returns compared to geometry-aligned GNNs. Based on these findings, we propose a geometry-aware evaluation protocol that yields more reliable and interpretable comparisons than standard aggregated benchmarks. We release all code, curvature-stratified dataset splits, and evaluation tools to support reproducible and rigorous assessment of future relational learning methods. Code and datasets are provided in our project homepage: https://sirbabbage.github.io/CurvBench_HOME/.

</details>


### [323] [Double Preconditioning (DoPr): Optimization for Test-Time Performance, not Validation Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06418)
*Thomas T. Zhang,Alok Shah,Yifei Zhang,Vincent Zhang,Nikolai Matni,Max Simchowitz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对测试时反馈（TTF）场景中训练损失与下游指标不匹配的问题，提出了一种新的优化范式——双重预处理（DoPr），将梯度预处理与激活预处理相结合。实验表明，DoPr 能在不提升验证损失的情况下显著改善下游任务表现，为 TTF 场景下的模型优化与评估提供了新视角。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习应用中普遍存在“训练-部署不一致”问题：模型使用单步预测损失（如L2回归、交叉熵）训练，但部署时需沿自身预测逐步展开（如自回归语言模型、流生成模型、机器人策略学习）。这种现象被称为测试时反馈（TTF），其核心矛盾在于训练/验证损失与任务成功率、生成质量等下游指标之间的差距会随任务长度增长而放大。此前工作多从数据、架构和目标函数设计入手，本文则首次将优化算法作为缓解TTF误差累积的新设计维度。

Method: 提出双重预处理（Double-Preconditioning, DoPr）优化范式：将梯度维度上的预处理（如Adam、Muon）与激活维度上的预处理（Activation-wise Preconditioning, AP，如KFAC）相结合。AP作为即插即用的干预模块嵌入现有优化器，旨在更好地应对TTF场景下的误差累积问题。

Result: 在多种TTF场景下，加入AP能持续提升下游模型性能。有趣的是，这些测试时性能的提升并不总是伴随验证损失的改善，这对仅以单步监督目标评估模型的标准做法提出了质疑。

Conclusion: 优化算法可作为缓解TTF中训练-测试偏移的有效设计轴。DoPr通过结合激活预处理，以即插即用方式提升下游表现，且揭示了验证损失与任务表现之间的脱节，呼吁重新思考TTF场景下的模型评估方法。

Abstract: Many modern applications of deep learning involve training a neural network via a one-step prediction loss (e.g., $L^2$ regression, cross-entropy), but deploy the network by rolling out along its own predictions. Key examples include autoregressive language modeling, flow-based generative modeling, and robot policy learning. It is well-documented that these settings induce a phenomenon we call test-time feedback (TTF): the mismatch between the training/validation loss and downstream metrics of interest, such as task success rate and generation quality, which grows with task length. While data curation, architecture, and objective design have been proposed to combat train-test shift in TTF settings, this paper proposes optimization as a new design axis to mitigate error accumulation. Specifically, we introduce a new optimization paradigm called double-preconditioning (DoPr) uniquely tailored to the challenges of TTF. DoPr combines gradient-wise preconditioning, as in Adam and Muon, with activation-wise preconditioning (AP), such as in KFAC. We show that the addition of AP yields a drop-in intervention for increasing downstream model performance across a range of TTF settings. Interestingly, these gains in test-time performance do not consistently accompany improvements in validation loss, opening new questions about how to properly evaluate models trained with one-step supervised objectives.

</details>


### [324] [Event Detection for Parameter-to-KPI Dependency Learning for AI-RAN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06459)
*Christie Djidjev,Nicholas Kaminski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种将连续网络遥测数据转换为二值事件指示器的方法，作为AI-RAN/O-RAN多控制回路依赖关系学习的基础步骤，核心是将此转换建模为显著性检测问题，并通过合成闭环流量生成器验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI-RAN和O-RAN架构中多个AI驱动的控制功能并发运行时会产生难以从原始数据中直接检测的相互干扰，缺乏一套可靠、可解释的依赖结构来捕捉哪些控制参数正在影响哪些网络性能指标。实现这一依赖学习的前提是能将噪声连续遥测数据可靠地转换为二值事件信号，但并非所有数据波动都反映真实控制交互，如何区分真实参数-指标关系与背景噪声是关键难题。

Method: 1）构建一个合成闭环流量生成器，植入已知的潜在依赖结构，以解决真实AI-RAN流量数据缺乏参数-KPI真值标注的问题；2）提出基于机器学习的依赖关系恢复流程，将连续遥测轨迹到二值事件指示器的转换建模为显著性检测问题；3）在有控制的遥测数据上进行实验评估。

Result: 实验表明，当信号与背景变异充分分离时，所提出的流程能可靠地恢复潜在依赖结构；阈值校准被识别为控制事件检测质量的关键因素。

Conclusion: 该工作为面向自适应AI-RAN控制系统的可解释依赖关系学习奠定了方法论基础，是构建多控制回路协同管理的必要前置步骤。

Abstract: Next-generation wireless networks are expected to rely on multiple concurrent AI-driven control functions that optimize different network objectives simultaneously, particularly in AI-integrated and open radio access network architectures such as AI Radio Access Network (AI-RAN) and Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN). When these functions interact, they can interfere with one another in ways that are difficult to detect from raw network data alone. A key missing piece for managing such interactions is a reliable, interpretable dependency structure that captures which control parameters are actively influencing which network performance outcomes at any given time. This paper focuses on the event-detection step needed to support such dependency learning by converting noisy continuous telemetry into binary indicators of parameter activity and KPI response. The central difficulty is that not every fluctuation in the data reflects a genuine control interaction, so the method must distinguish real parameter-outcome relationships from background variation. Because real AI-RAN traffic traces with known parameter-KPI ground truth are difficult to obtain, we introduce a synthetic closed-loop traffic generator with planted latent dependencies. We use this controlled telemetry to evaluate a machine-learning-based dependency recovery pipeline that formulates the conversion of continuous traces into binary event indicators as a significance-detection problem. Experimental evaluation shows that the proposed pipeline reliably recovers the latent dependency structure from noisy continuous traces when the signal is sufficiently separated from background variation, while highlighting threshold calibration as the key factor controlling event-detection quality. These results constitute a foundational step toward interpretable dependency learning for adaptive AI-RAN control systems.

</details>


### [325] [PC Layer: Polynomial Weight Preconditioning for Improving LLM Pre-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06470)
*Senmiao Wang,Tiantian Fang,Haoran Zhang,Yushun Zhang,Kunxiang Zhao,Alex Schwing,Ruoyu Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种多项式预条件（PC）层，通过低阶多项式预条件器重塑权重矩阵的奇异值谱，确保LLM训练过程中权重条件数稳定。训练后预条件权重可无损合并回原始架构，无推理开销。在Llama-1B预训练上验证了对AdamW和Muon优化器的提升，并给出理论收敛性证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络训练中，权重矩阵的条件数（奇异值分布）会随着训练进程恶化，导致优化困难、收敛缓慢。现有方法如归一化层、重参数化等虽有所缓解，但仍缺乏直接在权重层面进行谱控制且零推理开销的方案。本文旨在通过预条件技术从根本上稳定权重谱，提升大语言模型训练效率。

Method: 提出PC（Preconditioning）层，核心思想是将权重矩阵W参数化为W = P(s)Ŵ的形式，其中P(s)是一个低阶多项式预条件器，作用于权重矩阵的奇异值谱。训练时优化的是Ŵ，而P(s)通过多项式变换重塑奇异值分布，使得等效权重W的条件数在整个训练过程中保持稳定有界。训练完成后，通过矩阵乘法将P(s)吸收合并回权重，恢复为标准Transformer结构，消除推理开销。理论上，证明了对于特定深度线性网络，逐层一致有界奇异值可保证梯度下降几何收敛到全局最优。

Result: 在Llama-1B规模的预训练实验中，PC层相较标准Transformer在AdamW和Muon两种优化器下均表现出优势。配合Muon优化器时提升尤为显著，验证了谱控制与先进优化器的协同效应。理论方面，证明了均匀有界奇异值条件是深度线性网络梯度下降几何收敛的充分条件。

Conclusion: 多项式预条件层是一种轻量、即插即用、零推理开销的权重参数化方案，能有效稳定训练过程中的权重谱条件，提升LLM预训练性能。该方法兼具理论保证和实际有效性，尤其与Muon等先进优化器结合时效果突出。

Abstract: We propose a preconditioning (PC) layer, a weight parameterization via polynomial preconditioner that ensures stable weight conditioning throughout LLM training. The PC module reshapes the singular-value spectrum of weight matrices via low-degree polynomial preconditioning. After training, the preconditioned weights can be merged back into the original architecture, incurring no inference overhead. We demonstrate the advantage of the proposed PC layer over standard transformers in Llama-1B pre-training, for both the AdamW and Muon optimizers. Theoretically, we justify this spectrum-control principle by proving that uniformly bounding each layer's singular values ensures geometric convergence of gradient descent to global minima, for certain deep linear networks. Our code is available at https://github.com/Empath-aln/PC-layer.

</details>


### [326] [RREDCoT: Segment-Level Reward Redistribution for Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06475)
*Mykyta Ielanskyi,Kajetan Schweighofer,Lukas Aichberger,Sepp Hochreiter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RREDCoT方法，利用模型自身近似最优奖励重分配，解决GRPO等RL微调中因延迟奖励导致的高方差问题，避免蒙特卡洛采样的计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO及其变体在推理语言模型RL微调中面临延迟奖励问题——奖励仅在完整CoT轨迹结束后才能分配。标准蒙特卡洛方法存在高方差，而通过蒙特卡洛采样估计中间状态价值虽能实现credit assignment，但计算开销过大，不适用于长上下文高粒度场景。

Method: 提出RREDCoT（Reward REDistribution for Chain of Thoughts），利用语言模型自身近似最优奖励重分配，无需额外生成步骤。方法涉及CoT轨迹的分段策略和状态价值估计技术，绕开了MC采样的计算瓶颈。

Result: 与MC采样及多种归因方法相比，RREDCoT在奖励重分配上展现优势。论文还分析了CoT分段和状态价值估计等构建奖励重分配的关键因素。

Conclusion: RREDCoT为推理语言模型RL微调中的延迟奖励问题提供了一种高效解决方案，通过模型自身的奖励重分配实现低方差credit assignment，避免了MC采样的计算开销。

Abstract: Recent advancements in reasoning language models have been driven by Reinforcement Learning (RL) fine-tuning. Most often, these rely on the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) algorithm or modifications thereof to steer the models to produce Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces. The final answer can only be verified, and the reward assigned, after the CoT trace is complete, making it a delayed reward problem. GRPO and its modifications correspond to Monte Carlo methods in standard RL, which are known to suffer from high variance. A possible solution to this problem is the redistribution of rewards through credit assignment, where segments of the CoT trace that are important for arriving at the desirable solution are emphasized by assigning a higher reward. While Monte Carlo sampling can be used to provide an unbiased estimate of intermediate state values, its computational overhead makes it unsuitable for train-time credit assignment in long contexts at high granularity. We introduce RREDCoT (Reward REDistribution for Chain of Thoughts), which utilizes the model itself to approximate the optimal reward redistribution without additional generation. We investigate the advantages of our method compared to MC sampling and several attribution methods. We further analyze several aspects relevant to the construction of the redistribution such as segmentation of CoT traces and state value estimation.

</details>


### [327] [Pretraining Recurrent Networks without Recurrence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06479)
*Akarsh Kumar,Phillip Isola*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SMT 是一种新型非线性 RNN 训练方法，它通过 Transformer 编码器生成记忆转换标签，将 RNN 训练转化为一步监督学习，从而实现时间并行训练、O(1) 梯度路径，且无需展开网络，在语言建模等任务上优于 BPTT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 BPTT 训练 RNN 存在两大根本缺陷：(1) 时间序列上的顺序计算限制了并行化；(2) 梯度消失/爆炸使长程依赖难以学习。作者希望彻底绕过循环信用传播，实现时间并行且梯度稳定的 RNN 训练。

Method: 提出 Supervised Memory Training (SMT)。核心思路是将 RNN 训练解耦为两个阶段：(1) 训练一个 Transformer 编码器，基于预测状态目标——仅保留预测未来所必需的过去信息——来生成一步记忆转换标签 (m_t, x_{t+1}) → m_{t+1}；(2) 用这些标签以监督学习方式训练 RNN，无需在时间上展开网络。由此，任意两个 token 之间的梯度路径长度稳定在 O(1)，且训练可在时间维度上完全并行。

Result: 在语言建模和像素序列建模等任务的 RNN 预训练中，SMT 表现优于 BPTT。非线性 RNN 能更好地捕获长程依赖，同时实现并行训练。

Conclusion: SMT 通过将"记住什么"与"如何更新记忆"解耦，克服了 BPTT 的核心瓶颈，使非线性 RNN 能够有效学习长程时序抽象，为大规模时序模型扩展开辟了新可能。

Abstract: Training recurrent neural networks (RNNs) requires assigning credit across long sequences of computations. Standard backpropagation through time (BPTT) addresses this problem poorly: it is sequential in time, limiting parallelism, and suffers from vanishing or exploding gradients, making long-range associations difficult to learn. We propose Supervised Memory Training (SMT), a method for training nonlinear RNNs that sidesteps recurrent credit propagation entirely by reducing RNN training to supervised learning on one-step memory transition labels $(m_t, x_{t+1}) \rightarrow m_{t+1}$. SMT acquires these memory labels by training a Transformer-based encoder on a predictive state objective--retaining only information from the past necessary to predict the future. By decoupling what to remember from how to update memory, SMT enables time-parallel RNN training with a stable $O(1)$ length gradient path between any two tokens--without ever unrolling the RNN. We find that SMT outperforms BPTT when pretraining various RNN architectures on tasks like language modeling and pixel sequence modeling. SMT enables nonlinear RNNs to better capture long-range dependencies and train in parallel, potentially unlocking the scaling of models that build temporal abstractions of past experience.

</details>


### [328] [Regret Minimization with Adaptive Opponents in Repeated Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06486)
*Mingyang Liu,Asuman Ozdaglar,Tiancheng Yu,Kaiqing Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的博弈论遗憾度量——重复策略遗憾（RP-Regret），用于衡量在具有自适应对手的重复博弈中，考虑所有玩家可基于历史做出响应时，实际累积效用与事后最佳效用之间的差距。该度量能容纳更强的比较器和约束更少的对手，并支持找到更优均衡。作者分析了获得次线性RP-Regret的必要条件，并针对其非凸性提出了三种算法：基于优化预言机的算法、最小化凸线性化替代目标的算法、以及在对手策略变化缓慢时直接最小化的算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统在线学习中的外部遗憾（external regret）无法捕捉自适应对手基于博弈历史做出响应的能力。现有考虑反事实推理的遗憾概念要么对对手施加了强假设（如对手固定或无响应），要么比较器不够强大。本文旨在提出一种更贴近重复博弈本质的遗憾度量，使得：（1）比较器策略也能响应历史；（2）对手约束更少；（3）当所有玩家都最小化该遗憾时，能学到更优均衡。

Method: 首先定义RP-Regret：玩家实际策略序列与事后最佳策略序列（均可基于历史响应）之间的累积效用差。分析了获得次线性RP-Regret的必要条件（比较器策略的变异程度、比较器和对手的记忆长度）。针对RP-Regret在策略空间中的非凸性，提出三种算法：（i）基于优化预言机（optimization oracle）的方法；（ii）每次迭代最小化RP-Regret的凸线性化替代目标；（iii）在对手策略变化缓慢时直接最小化RP-Regret。进一步证明当所有玩家运行这些算法时，可学到重复博弈的某些子博弈精炼均衡。

Result: 识别了获得次线性RP-Regret的必要条件；证明了三种算法在相应条件下可有效最小化RP-Regret；当所有玩家均最小化RP-Regret（或其线性化变体）时，可以学到重复博弈的某些子博弈精炼均衡；在Stag-Hunt等博弈中，实验表明最小化RP-Regret能收敛到更合作、效用更高的解。

Conclusion: RP-Regret作为一个更契合重复博弈场景的遗憾度量，放宽了对对手的假设、增强了比较器的表达能力，并保持了好均衡的可学习性。尽管面临非凸优化的挑战，通过合适的算法设计依然可以有效最小化该遗憾，并在多玩家场景下导向更优的合作均衡。

Abstract: In this paper, we study regret minimization in repeated games with \emph{adaptive} opponents who can respond based on histories of play. The standard metric of \emph{external regret} in online learning is known to fail to capture such adaptivity. To account for players' counterfactual reasoning, we introduce {\tt Repeated Policy Regret (RP-Regret)}, a game-theoretic metric that measures the difference between the \emph{realized} and the \emph{best-in-hindsight} accumulated utility when all players can \emph{respond} to the history of play. Compared to existing regret notions in this setting, ours is native to repeated game playing, enabling stronger comparators and opponents with fewer constraints, while maintaining the possibility of finding better equilibria when all players minimize it. We first identify necessary conditions for obtaining {\tt RP-Regret} sublinear in time, on the variation of the player's comparator strategies in the regret definition and on the memories of both the comparator and opponents' strategies. We then study additional conditions and provable algorithms to minimize {\tt RP-Regret}, which is by definition \emph{non-convex} in the strategy space. To address this challenge, we propose three algorithms: (i) one based on an optimization oracle, as assumed in some prior work in online non-convex learning; (ii) one that minimizes a convex and \emph{linearized} surrogate of {\tt RP-Regret} at each iteration; (iii) one that directly minimizes {\tt RP-Regret} when opponents change strategies slowly. Furthermore, when all players can run algorithms to minimize the {\tt RP-Regret} (or its linearized variant), certain subgame perfect equilibria of the repeated game can be learned. We also provide experiments showing that minimizing our regret notions can lead to more cooperative solutions with higher utility in games such as Stag-Hunt.

</details>


### [329] [TailLoR: Protecting Principal Components in Parameter-Efficient Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06494)
*Marius Dragoi,Ioana Pintilie,Alexandra Dragomir,Antonio Barbalau,Florin Brad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TailLoR 提出一种基于奇异值分解的参数高效持续学习方法：利用预训练权重的奇异基 U 和 V 作为固定参照系，对奇异值矩阵进行低秩更新，并通过软频谱惩罚将更新引导至高灵活性的长尾频谱坐标，从而减少灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续学习中，参数高效微调方法面临的核心挑战是灾难性遗忘——新任务训练会覆盖对旧任务重要的权重方向。现有基于频谱分解的方法虽有进展，但在如何将更新与已学知识空间解耦方面仍有改进空间。本文希望设计一种机制，既能保留主导奇异方向所承载的通用知识，又能利用长尾奇异方向的高灵活性进行任务特定适配。

Method: TailLoR 将预训练权重的奇异值分解 (SVD) 中的奇异基 U 和 V 固定为参照系，仅学习作用于奇异值矩阵的低秩更新（即 ΔΣ）。核心创新是一个软频谱惩罚项（soft spectral penalty），该惩罚对与主导奇异方向对齐的更新施加更强的抑制，从而将参数更新路由到频谱尾部的低秩坐标空间，实现对预训练知识的保护与新任务的灵活适配。

Result: 摘要中未报告具体实验结果数据，但暗示该方法能够有效减少任务间干扰，将细粒度适配引导至长尾频谱坐标，从而在持续学习场景中实现参数高效微调。

Conclusion: TailLoR 通过固定奇异基、仅对奇异值矩阵做低秩更新，并引入软频谱惩罚机制，成功将更新与主导频谱解耦，为持续学习中的参数高效微调提供了一种新范式。该方法在保护旧知识的同时，保留了充分的模型可塑性。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient finetuning methods based on spectral decomposition have enabled progress in Continual Learning. In this paper we introduce TailLoR, which utilizes the singular bases U and V of the pre-trained weights as a fixed reference frame to learn a low-rank update applied to the singular value matrix. A soft spectral penalty discourages updates aligned with dominant singular directions, reducing interference while routing fine-grained adaptation into the highly flexible, long-tail spectral coordinates.

</details>


<div id='stat.ML'></div>

# stat.ML [[Back]](#toc)

### [330] [Central Description Length (CDL) Clustering Validation Index](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05230)
*Mahdi Shamsi,Soosan Beheshti*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: CDL-CVI是一种新的聚类验证指数，它利用聚类内紧凑性、估计的聚类中心和协方差，计算出不可观测的真实聚类中心的描述长度的概率上界。该指标不依赖真实标签，在非凸、不规则形状的聚类数据上表现优于传统CVI，无需额外的核预处理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有聚类验证指数（CVI）多基于欧氏紧凑性和分离性，偏向于凸的、紧凑的划分，在非凸、不规则或变密度数据上性能下降。虽然核变换或替代距离度量可缓解此问题，但会引入额外的调参和计算成本。因此需要一种无需额外预处理、对非凸和任意形状聚类仍有效的内部验证指标。

Method: 提出中心描述长度（CDL）聚类验证指数。CDL利用可观测的簇内紧凑性、估计的簇中心和估计的簇协方差，计算关于不可观测的真实簇中心的描述长度概率上界。该上界将簇内紧凑性和质心位移浓缩为一个可计算量，仅依赖可观测数据（数据、划分、估计中心和估计协方差），无需真实标签。在多种聚类算法（K-means、DBSCAN、谱聚类）产生的划分上评估该指标。

Result: 在非凸和任意形状簇的合成基准测试中，CDL-CVI比传统CVI更频繁地选出参考簇数量，并获得更高的调整兰德指数（ARI），且无需额外的核预处理。在基于冻结无监督嵌入的图像基准（MNIST、CIFAR-10、STL-10）上，CDL-CVI在K-means、DBSCAN和谱聚类中返回的簇数均接近参考类别数。

Conclusion: CDL-CVI是一种通用的、无需核变换的聚类验证指数，能有效处理非凸和任意形状的聚类，在合成数据和图像数据上均表现出优于传统CVI的性能，为无监督聚类模型选择提供了一种鲁棒的解决方案。

Abstract: Selecting a clustering algorithm and its hyperparameters without labels is a common difficulty in engineering machine learning pipelines that work with unsupervised analysis of sensor, image, or process data. Clustering validation indices (CVIs) provide internal scores for ranking candidate clusterings, but most popular CVIs are built from Euclidean compactness and separation terms and so tend to favour compact, convex partitions. Their performance is known to degrade on non convex, irregular, or variable density data, where kernel transformations or alternative distance measures are typically used at the cost of additional tuning and computation. This paper introduces the Central Description Length (CDL) clustering validation index. CDL uses the observed within cluster compactness, the estimated cluster centers, and the estimated cluster covariances to compute a probabilistic upper bound on the description length associated with the unobservable true cluster centers. The bound condenses intra cluster compactness and centroid displacement into a single computable quantity and is evaluated on the partition produced by any clustering algorithm. The implementation uses only observable quantities (the data, the partition, the estimated centers, and the estimated covariances) and does not use ground truth labels. On synthetic benchmarks with non convex and arbitrary shape clusters, CDL-CVI selected the reference number of clusters more often and reached higher Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) values than the conventional CVIs we tested, without an additional kernel preprocessing stage. On image benchmarks (MNIST, CIFAR-10, STL-10) clustered from frozen unsupervised embeddings, CDL-CVI returned cluster numbers close to the reference class counts across K-means, DBSCAN, and spectral clustering in the reported trials.

</details>


### [331] [HyFAD: Hybrid Time-Frequency Diffusion with Frequency-Aware Embedding for Time Series Imputation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05239)
*Hongfan Gao,Wangmeng Shen,Bin Yang,Jilin Hu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: HyFAD 是一种混合时频扩散模型，采用时间域到频率域的串联去噪框架（先捕获低频全局趋势，后细化高频频谱分量），并引入频率感知步嵌入实现步进相关的频谱引导，在时间序列填补任务中达到 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散模型在时间序列建模中存在三个核心不足：(1) 对频率敏感的去噪能力差；(2) 高频重建质量不佳；(3) 难以平衡全局趋势与局部动态的建模。

Method: 基于 DDPM 范式，HyFAD 构建了耦合的时频扩散框架——反向去噪从时间域到频率域顺序进行，实现粗到细的生成。时间域扩散过程负责捕获低频全局趋势，频率域扩散过程则精细化高频频谱分量。此外，提出频率感知步嵌入，显式建模扩散步与频谱分量之间的关系，为各步提供频谱引导以提升逐带重建精度。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上进行大量实验，HyFAD 取得了最先进的性能。

Conclusion: HyFAD 通过时频耦合扩散框架和频率感知步嵌入，有效解决了频率敏感去噪、高频重建及全局-局部平衡问题，在时间序列填补任务上验证了其优越性，代码已开源。

Abstract: Diffusion models have demonstrated strong performance in time series modeling due to their ability to progressively capture complex data distributions through iterative denoising. However, existing approaches struggle with frequency-sensitive denoising, high-frequency reconstruction and balancing global trends with local dynamics. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{HyFAD}, a \textbf{Hy}brid time-frequency \textbf{D}iffusion model with \textbf{F}requency-\textbf{A}ware embedding for time series imputation. Built upon the DDPM paradigm, HyFAD adopts a coupled time-frequency diffusion framework, in which the reverse denoising proceeds sequentially from the time domain to the frequency domain, enabling coarse-to-fine generation. Specifically, the time-domain diffusion process captures low-frequency global trends, while the frequency-domain diffusion process refines high-frequency spectral components. We further introduce a frequency-aware step embedding that exploits the relationship between diffusion steps and spectral components, providing step-dependent spectral guidance and facilitates more accurate band-wise reconstruction. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that HyFAD achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our source code is available at https://github.com/hongfangao/HyFAD.

</details>


### [332] [Deterministic Envelopes for Tamed SGLD: Decoupling Stochastic-Gradient Noise and Localizing Taming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05242)
*Yiwei Zhou,Ziheng Chen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文揭示了随机梯度 Langevin 算法中使用与梯度同源的随机分母进行驯化（taming）会引入稳态偏差，并提出了一种基于确定性包络的结构保持框架，在保持稳定性的同时消除该偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机梯度 Langevin 算法通常使用驯化分母来稳定非全局 Lipschitz 漂移项，但作者发现当分母依赖于与分子相同的随机梯度实现时，会改变随机预言（stochastic oracle）的性质，即使原始随机梯度是无偏的，也会产生稳态偏差。因此需要一种既能保持驯化稳定性、又能避免引入偏差的新框架。

Method: 提出结构保持的驯化分母设计框架：(1) 在采样 oracle 噪声之前固定分母，避免分母对梯度实现的条件依赖；(2) 使用局域化确定性包络（deterministic envelopes），在典型区域避免不必要的驯化；(3) 在该框架下分析稳态误差分解——由 oracle 依赖驯化造成的偏差 + 确定性稳定化引入的剩余误差；(4) 识别远尾条件，指出现有局部软包络的局限，并提出混合设计：典型区域使用软包络，极端偏离时切换为硬尾控制。

Result: 实验验证了：(1) 随机分母确实会产生预测的稳态扭曲；(2) 确定性包络设计可有效降低偏差；(3) 混合结构（软包络+硬尾保护）具有优越的稳定化效果。

Conclusion: 提出了一类基于确定性包络的驯化核，将分母设定与随机梯度噪声解耦，可消除由 oracle 依赖驯化引入的稳态偏差，同时保留驯化的稳定化能力。混合软-硬设计在远尾区域提供了更稳健的保护，为随机梯度 Langevin 动力学中的分母设计提供了新的理论理解和实用方案。

Abstract: Stochastic-gradient Langevin algorithms often use tamed denominators to stabilize non-globally Lipschitz drifts. This paper shows that when the denominator depends on the same stochastic-gradient realization as the numerator, the taming step changes the stochastic oracle itself and can create a stationary bias even if the original stochastic gradient is unbiased. We propose a structure-preserving framework for designing tamed denominators. It fixes the denominator before the oracle noise is sampled and uses localized deterministic envelopes to avoid unnecessary taming in typical regions. These kernels keep the stabilizing effect of taming while avoiding the bias introduced by a gradient-dependent denominator. Our theory explains how the stationary error splits into the bias caused by oracle-dependent taming and the remaining error introduced by deterministic stabilization. Within this deterministic-envelope family, the analysis identifies a far-tail condition that explains the limitation of local soft envelopes and motivates a hybrid member: soft in the typical region, but protected by hard-tail control on rare excursions. Experiments confirm the predicted stationary distortions of random denominators, the bias reduction of deterministic-envelope designs, and the stabilizing effect of the hybrid construction.

</details>


### [333] [Harnessing Source Heterogeneity for Cluster-Structured Transfer Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05258)
*Xiaohui Yin,Jun Jin,Shane J. Sacco,Robert H. Aseltine,Kun Chen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出Trans-GLMC方法，一种基于聚类结构的迁移学习框架，用于广义线性模型，通过发现源数据中的潜在簇结构来改进目标人群的预测，在自杀风险预测的CHIME数据中验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际应用中，目标人群数据有限但存在多个辅助数据源时，源数据间存在异质性——不同源的有用性可能呈现簇状结构，而现有方法通常只做二元的"有用/无用"判断，忽略了这种细粒度的可迁移性差异。CHIME数据集中，单家医院自杀案例稀少导致模型不稳定，但简单合并所有医院数据又会掩盖机构间差异。

Method: Trans-GLMC分三步：(1) 构建目标源与候选源之间基于系数的距离度量，恢复潜在的源簇结构；(2) 通过全局融合、簇内精炼和目标去偏三个环节，产生自适应于检测结构的估计量；(3) 建立非渐近误差界，证明当存在有意义的簇时优于无聚类方法，否则退化至相同速率。

Result: 理论上证明了非渐近误差界在存在有效目标簇时优于无聚类对照方法。在模拟实验和CHIME研究（636,758名患者、27家医院）中，Trans-GLMC改进了机构特异性预测，识别出具有相互可迁移性的医院社区，并恢复了临床一致的自杀风险因素。

Conclusion: Trans-GLMC通过挖掘源数据中的簇结构，实现了比传统二元选择方法更精细的迁移学习，在理论和实践上均验证了其优势，为多源异构数据的迁移学习提供了新范式。

Abstract: Transfer learning is a natural strategy when a target population has limited data but multiple related auxiliary sources are available. A central difficulty is source heterogeneity: auxiliary sources may not be equally useful, and their usefulness may vary in a structured, cluster-like fashion. Existing transfer-learning methods often reduce source selection to a binary informative/non-informative decision, overlooking subgroups of sources with differential transferability. Motivated by a suicide-risk study using data from the Connecticut Hospital Information Management Exchange (CHIME), comprising 636,758 patients across 27 hospitals, we propose Trans-GLMC, a cluster-structured transfer-learning procedure for generalized linear models. The CHIME setting illustrates the core challenge: hospital-specific risk models are unstable because suicide attempts are rare at any single facility, whereas indiscriminate pooling across hospitals can obscure facility-level differences in patient mix and risk profiles. Trans-GLMC first constructs a coefficient-based distance among the target and candidate sources to recover latent source clusters. It then combines global fusion, within-cluster refinement, and target debiasing to produce an estimator that adapts to the detected structure. We establish a non-asymptotic error bound that improves over its unclustered counterpart whenever a meaningful target cluster exists and matches the unclustered rate up to constants otherwise. In simulations and in the CHIME study, Trans-GLMC improves facility-specific prediction, identifies interpretable communities of hospitals with mutual transferability, and recovers clinically coherent suicide-risk factors.

</details>


### [334] [TabSODA: Tabular Diffusion based Imputation with Skip Pattern Detection and Ordinal Awareness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05361)
*Yuyu Chen,Taehyo Kim,Hai Shu,Yang Feng*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: TabSODA是一种基于EDM框架的表格数据扩散插补方法，通过EM算法处理大规模调查中的结构化跳转和有序变量两大挑战，在PATH和NSDUH数据集上显著优于现有基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模调查数据的缺失值插补面临两个现有表格扩散方法未能妥善处理的关键问题：(1) 结构化跳转（因问卷设计导致的不适用题项）常与题项无响应混淆，不应被插补；(2) 有序分类响应通常被错误地当作名义变量处理（如独热编码），丢失了类别间的顺序信息。

Method: 提出TabSODA，基于Elucidated Diffusion Model (EDM)框架构建的EM扩散插补器。核心设计包括：(1) 通过去噪损失和逆向时间采样器传播结构化跳转信息；(2) 对有序变量采用累积probit标量潜变量表示，对名义变量保留analog-bit编码；(3) 当编码簿跳转掩码可用时直接使用，否则通过TabSODA+SKIP变体，利用基于CART的跳转模式挖掘器从原始响应和问卷顺序中估计掩码。

Result: 在PATH和NSDUH两个美国全国代表性调查数据集上，TabSODA在MCAR、MAR和MNAR三种缺失机制下，有序变量MACE指标最高降低23.7%，分类准确率提升达9%，均优于最强基线方法。跳转挖掘器在两个数据集上均达到近乎完美的精确率，使TabSODA+SKIP能够紧密逼近使用编码簿掩码的变体性能。

Conclusion: TabSODA通过显式建模结构化跳转和有序变量的顺序特性，有效解决了大规模调查数据插补中的两个核心挑战，在真实调查数据上展现了显著的性能提升和实用价值，即使在没有编码簿掩码的情况下也能通过自动挖掘保持高性能。

Abstract: Missing data imputation in large-scale surveys faces two challenges that are not well handled by current tabular diffusion methods. First, \emph{structural skips}, cells made inapplicable by questionnaire design, should not be imputed but are often conflated with item nonresponse. Second, \emph{ordinal} responses encode ordered categories, yet most pipelines treat them as nominal levels through one-hot or analog-bit encodings. We introduce \textbf{TabSODA} (\textbf{Tab}ular diffusion with \textbf{S}kip pattern detection and \textbf{O}r\textbf{d}inal \textbf{A}wareness), an Expectation-Maximization (EM)-based diffusion imputer built on the Elucidated Diffusion Model (EDM) framework. TabSODA propagates structural skips through the denoising loss and reverse-time sampler, and represents ordinal variables with cumulative-probit scalar latents while retaining analog-bit encodings for nominal variables. When a codebook skip mask is available, TabSODA uses it directly; otherwise, the TabSODA+SKIP variant estimates the mask from raw responses and questionnaire order using a CART-based skip-pattern miner. On Population Assessment of Tobacco and Health (PATH) study and the National Survey on Drug Use and Health (NSDUH), two nationally representative U.S.\ surveys, TabSODA reduces ordinal MACE by up to $23.7\%$ and improves categorical accuracy by up to $9\%$ over the strongest baseline across MCAR, MAR, and MNAR masking. The skip miner achieves near-perfect precision on both datasets, allowing TabSODA+SKIP to closely track the codebook-mask variant.

</details>


### [335] [Environment-Robust Representation Learning with Empirical Bayes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05365)
*Yuli Slavutsky,Matthew Shen,Bohan Wu,David M. Blei*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文针对多环境预测问题，提出了一种贝叶斯模型：假设环境仅改变潜在变量的分布，而观测协变量和目标的生成机制在给定潜在变量的条件下保持稳定。通过变分推断和分层先验（经验贝叶斯），实现对新环境的稳健预测，在多个真实场景中优于已有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多环境预测中，分布偏移通常源于环境中潜在变量分布的变化（如不同医院的患病率差异），而非协变量与目标之间机制的变化。现有方法未能很好地利用这种结构不变性，导致跨环境迁移性能不佳。

Method: 建立包含潜在变量的贝叶斯分层模型，推导变分目标（ELBO），该目标自然分解为各环境项和交叉环境平衡项；采用经验贝叶斯设定先验；基于此开发摊销变分推断算法，利用学到的潜在变量对新环境进行预测。

Result: 在模拟实验和三个真实场景（天文源识别、微生物组疾病检测、ICU脓毒症预测）中，所提方法在未知新环境上的预测性能均优于此前各类多环境预测方法。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模环境间潜在变量分布的变化并保持生成机制不变，所提出的贝叶斯变分推断框架能够有效应对多环境分布偏移，具有良好的跨环境泛化能力。

Abstract: We consider multi-environment prediction problems. We assume the environments change the distribution of a latent variable, while the mechanisms generating observed covariates and targets remain stable conditional on that variable. For example, hospitals or clinical cohorts may differ in the prevalence of latent patient states, even though the relationships between those states, physiological measurements, and outcomes remain unchanged. Given a dataset from multiple environments, we formulate a Bayesian model for such problems and derive the corresponding variational objective. We show that this objective decomposes into per-environment terms and an additional cross-environment balancing term induced by the model's structure. We use an empirical Bayes method to set the prior and incorporate it into the objective. Based on this objective, we develop an amortized variational algorithm for posterior approximation, and use the resulting learned latent variables to form predictions in new environments.We study our approach through simulations and real-world studies of astronomical source identification, microbiome-based disease detection, and ICU sepsis prediction. Across these settings, our method outperforms previous approaches for prediction in new environments.

</details>


### [336] [Sparse Functional Singular Value Decomposition for Biclustering and Triclustering Longitudinal Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05488)
*Yue Zhao,Thierry Chekouo,Sandra Safo*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: Tri-SfSVD 是一个统一的稀疏函数型奇异值分解框架，能够在纵向数据中直接发现双聚类和三聚类，无需插补，且同时进行主体、特征和时间子区域的选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纵向组学数据（如IBD多组学数据）具有高维、稀疏采样和不规则观测的特点，传统双聚类和函数型数据分析方法难以有效捕捉其中的潜在模式。现有函数型双聚类方法依赖插补或强加形状同质性假设，限制了实用性。

Method: 提出 Tri-SfSVD，将连续轨迹估计与主体、特征和时间选择整合到统一优化框架中，通过对主体、变量和时间子区域施加稀疏惩罚，直接在观测数据上发现主体层面、主体-特征层面和主体-特征-时间层面的局部结构。

Result: 仿真表明 Tri-SfSVD 在高维场景下优于现有方法。在IBD多组学数据中识别出三个双聚类，关联样本簇与微生物通路群；在多通道EEG数据中识别出三个三聚类，揭示酒精相关表型与局部脑活动模式的关联，包括同一空间区域内时间子区域区分的亚组差异。

Conclusion: Tri-SfSVD 为纵向高维数据中的异质性发现提供了一种灵活、可解释且无需插补的统一方案，在生物医学多组学和神经影像数据中展示了强大的应用价值。

Abstract: Identifying subtypes of complex conditions, such as Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD), often requires capturing latent patterns in longitudinal omics data. However, these data are typically high-dimensional, sparsely sampled, and irregularly observed over time, posing substantial challenges for conventional (bi)clustering and functional data analysis methods. We propose Tri-SfSVD, a unified sparse functional Singular Value Decomposition framework for discovering biclusters and triclusters in longitudinal data. Unlike existing functional biclustering methods that rely on ad hoc imputation or enforce restrictive shape-homogeneity assumptions, Tri-SfSVD integrates continuous trajectory estimation with simultaneous subject, feature, and temporal selection within a single optimization framework. By imposing sparse penalties across subjects, variables, and temporal subregions, the proposed method works directly on observed data to uncover localized structures at the subject, subject-feature, and subject-feature-time levels. Extensive simulations demonstrate that Tri-SfSVD outperforms existing approaches in high-dimensional settings. Applied to IBD multi-omics data, the method identified three biclusters linking sample clusters with distinct IBD-related clinical characteristics to microbial pathway groups associated with specific bacterial taxa, providing interpretable subject-pathway associations for characterizing disease heterogeneity. Applied to multi-channel EEG data, the method identified three triclusters linking sample clusters with distinct alcohol-related phenotypes to localized brain activity patterns, including subgroup differences separated by temporal subregions within the same spatial region.

</details>


### [337] [Conformal Risk-Averse Decision Making with Action Conditional Guarantee](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05551)
*Zihan Zhu,Shayan Kiyani,George Pappas. Hamed Hassani*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文将共形预测扩展为动作条件共形预测，为每个决策动作提供显式的安全保证，并表明动作条件预测集可作为风险厌恶决策者优化动作条件VaR的可行决策空间代理，同时提出基于弹球损失最小化的有限样本算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于共形预测的风险厌恶决策策略仅继承了边际安全保证，无法为每个具体动作提供条件化的安全保障，这在实际决策场景中不足以支持可靠决策。

Method: (1) 提出动作条件共形预测，将安全保证显式地条件化于每个动作；(2) 证明动作条件预测集可作为风险厌恶决策者优化动作条件VaR的可行决策空间代理；(3) 基于弹球损失最小化设计有限样本算法，将Gibbs等人的框架与动作条件保证相连接。

Result: 在两个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，所提方法在动作条件性能上显著优于现有共形预测基线。

Conclusion: 动作条件共形预测有效强化了风险厌恶决策的安全保证，为可靠ML决策管道提供了更精细的不确定性量化工具。

Abstract: Reliable decision making pipelines powered by machine learning models require uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods that come with explicit safety guarantees. Conformal prediction provides such UQ by wrapping ML predictions into prediction sets, and recent work by Kiyani et al. (2025b) established that these sets can be translated into optimal risk-averse decision policies -- yet only inheriting marginal safety guarantees. We generalize and strengthen their results by (i) introducing action-conditional conformal prediction, which yields safety guarantees conditioned explicitly on each action taken by the decision maker, (ii) showing that action-conditional prediction sets serve as a proxy for the feasible decision space for risk-averse decision makers aiming to optimize action-conditional value-at-risk, and (iii) proposing a principled finite-sample algorithm based on pinball-loss minimization, connecting the framework of Gibbs et al. (2025) to action-conditional guarantees. Experiments on two real-world datasets confirm that our approach significantly improves action-conditional performance over conformal baselines.

</details>


### [338] [Finding Most Influential Sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05919)
*Lucas D. Konrad,Nikolas Kuschnig*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种高效识别最具影响力集合（MIS）的算法，针对具有线性分式留出效应的目标估计量，将MIS选择问题转化为一参数序列的top-k问题，利用Dinkelbach方法实现每次迭代O(n)成本且有限步终止，在仿真与应用中恢复了此前计算不可达的精确MIS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 识别大小为k的最具影响力子集（其移除能最大程度改变目标估计量）在计算上通常是不可行的，因为需要遍历组合数级别的子集。作者旨在为具有线性分式留出效应的估计量提供一种计算上高效且具有理论保证的MIS选择方法。
