Method: 作者将MIS选择问题归约为一系列单参数的top-k问题，采用Dinkelbach方法进行求解，每次迭代计算成本为O(n)，且保证有限步终止。在固定残差化输入下，算法针对单变量比率目标返回全局最优集（包括oracle残差化的部分线性模型）。当使用估计的讨厌函数时，借助分母一致性和生成得分稳定性，可近似一阶oracle正交得分目标；在分离条件下实现精确集合恢复。

Result: 算法能够恢复全局最优的MIS。在固定残差化输入下获得精确最优；在使用估计讨厌函数时，通过渐近理论保证了对oracle目标的近似及分离条件下的精确恢复。仿真和实际应用验证了该方法能够恢复此前计算上不可达的精确MIS。

Conclusion: 该方法将MIS选择的组合爆炸问题转化为高效可解的单参数top-k序列，兼具计算效率（O(n)每次迭代）和理论保证（有限终止、全局最优性、渐近近似与精确恢复），显著拓展了影响力分析在大型数据集上的应用前景。

Abstract: Identifying most influential sets (MIS) - size-$k$ subsets whose removal maximally changes a target estimand - is typically infeasible because it requires searching over $\binom{n}{k}$ subsets. For estimands with linear-fractional leave-set-out effects, we show that MIS selection reduces to a one-parameter sequence of top-$k$ problems. Dinkelbach's method yields an algorithm with $\mathcal{O}(n)$ cost per iteration and finite termination. For fixed residualized inputs, the algorithm returns a globally optimal set for the univariate ratio objective, including the oracle-residualized partial linear model. With estimated nuisance functions, uniform denominator and generated-score stability imply approximation to the first-order oracle orthogonal-score objective; exact set recovery follows under a separation condition. Simulations and applications show that the method recovers exact MIS that were previously computationally inaccessible.

</details>


### [339] [EML-CD: Causal Mechanism Recovery via EML Symbolic Trees in Structure Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05942)
*Sota Asanuma*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: EML-CD 将可解释的演化模块化学习算子集成到因果发现中，用门控 EML 二叉树表示每条边的因果机制，自动发现闭式因果方程，在蛋白质信号等真实数据上取得与 PC/GES 相当的 SHD，同时赋予每条检测到的边以解析方程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于神经网络的非线性因果发现方法虽能恢复 DAG 结构，但因果机制仍是黑箱；Waxman 等人指出从 NN 权重中提取因果机制是不适定的。因此亟需一种既能学习因果图结构、又能输出可解释闭式因果方程的方法。

Method: 提出 EML-CD 框架：(1) 将 EML 算子（能从单一二元算子组合出初等函数）集成到因果结构学习中；(2) 每条边机制表示为一棵门控 EML 二叉树；(3) 自动搜索并发现闭式因果方程；(4) 从输出方程直接计算解析 Jacobian，量化因果效应。

Result: 在 Sachs 蛋白质信号数据 (d=11) 上，SHD=11.2±0.4（5 种子均值），与 PC/GES 相当、低于 CAM，精度 0.756、召回 0.365；双变量测试中恢复 11 个初等函数族中的 10 个（留出形状相关性 ≥0.96，仅高频正弦不完全）；符号合成基准上持有机制 f-MSE 远低于固定 SINDy 字典（3.67 vs. 7644）；Causal Chambers 光隧道子集上，深度-2 模型 F1 超越 OLS-BIC（0.444 vs. 0.273）。

Conclusion: EML-CD 在可解释因果机制发现上迈出重要一步，能在恢复因果图结构的同时输出闭式方程和解析 Jacobian，在机制恢复质量上显著优于固定字典方法，但结构恢复精度仍有提升空间。

Abstract: Neural network (NN)-based nonlinear causal discovery methods recover DAG structure but leave each causal mechanism as a black box. Waxman et al. argued that extracting causal mechanisms from NN weights is ill-posed. We propose EML-CD, a framework that integrates the EML operator (capable of composing elementary functions from a single binary operator) into causal structure learning, with interpretable mechanism recovery as the primary objective. EML-CD represents each edge mechanism as a gated EML binary tree and automatically discovers closed-form causal equations. Analytical Jacobians can be directly computed from the output equations, enabling quantitative understanding of causal effects. On real data (Sachs protein signaling, d=11), EML-CD achieves SHD=11.2 +/- 0.4 (5-seed mean; baselines are single deterministic runs), on par with PC/GES within seed variance and below CAM, while attaching closed-form equations to each detected edge (precision 0.756, recall 0.365). In a controlled bivariate test with known mechanisms, EML-CD recovers 10 of 11 elementary function families faithfully (held-out shape correlation >= 0.96; only high-frequency sine is partial). On a symbolic synthetic benchmark, EML-CD attains a substantially lower and more stable held-out mechanism f-MSE than a fixed SINDy dictionary (mean 3.67 vs. 7644, the latter inflated by catastrophic extrapolation on one seed), although its structure recovery (SHD 14.0) only matches the dictionary and stays below specialized optimizers; on the Causal Chambers light-tunnel subset, a depth-2 model improves F1 over linear OLS-BIC (0.444 vs. 0.273).

</details>


### [340] [Fast and Robust Convergence Rate for TD(0) with Linear Function Approximation, Universal Learning Steps and I.I.D. Samples](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05967)
*Ziad Kobeissi,Éloïse Berthier*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究了线性函数近似下TD(0)算法的有限时间行为，在i.i.d.采样、恒定学习率和Polyak-Juditsky平均方法下，建立了均方误差的一个新收敛速率O(1/k)，该速率具有最优依赖性、对病态条件鲁棒且常数因子小于11，同时提出了具有更好收敛性质的变体PCTD(0)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TD(0)文献中O(1/k)收敛速率均依赖于线性参数化非中心协方差矩阵的最小特征值，导致在病态条件下收敛极慢。本文旨在消除这一依赖性，建立更鲁棒的最优收敛速率。

Method: 采用在线策略、i.i.d.采样、恒定学习步长与Polyak-Juditsky平均方法，对TD(0)进行有限时间分析，推导均方误差的上界。此外，提出PCTD(0)变体，在马尔可夫链强混合条件下获得更好的收敛性质。

Result: 得到了均方误差的O(1/k)收敛速率，该速率：(i)具有最优迭代次数依赖性；(ii)对病态条件鲁棒，仅依赖初始误差和模型无关常数；(iii)乘性常数紧致且小于11。该速率不依赖于非中心协方差矩阵的最小特征值，优于所有现有结果。PCTD(0)在强混合条件下进一步改善收敛。

Conclusion: 本文首次在TD(0)中建立了完全不依赖协方差矩阵最小特征值的O(1/k)最优速率，显著提升了对病态问题的鲁棒性，PCTD(0)变体在更一般的马尔可夫噪声下也有更优表现。

Abstract: In this paper, we study the finite-time behavior of the TD(0) temporal-difference method with linear function approximation (LFA). We consider on-policy independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) samples, a constant learning step, and the Polyak-Juditsky averaging method. We establish a new convergence rate, for the Mean-Square Error (MSE) on the approximated function, that is (i) fast in the sense that it admits an optimal dependency in the number of iterations k (i.e., of order 1/k), (ii) robust to ill-conditioning: it only depends on an initial error and modelindependent constants and (iii) sharp up to a multiplicative constant lower than 11. In particular, it does not depend on the smallest eigenvalue of the uncentered covariance matrix of the linear parametrization, unlike all pre-existing O(1/k) rates in the TD(0) literature. We also introduce PCTD(0), a variant of TD(0), which benefits from better convergence properties under an additional assumption of strong mixing on the Markov Chain.

</details>


### [341] [Adaptive Learning Rates with Surrogate Probability for Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06043)
*Jongyeong Lee,Junya Honda,Shinji Ito,Chansoo Kim*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文为跟随扰动领导（FTPL）算法提出了一种基于替代概率函数的自适应学习率设计方法，克服了FTPL因无优化过程而难以引入概率依赖学习率的局限，在Pareto扰动下的bandit问题及带专家建议的bandit问题中均获得了BOBW保证，且保持计算简洁性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FTRL框架在在线学习中取得了成功，其自适应学习率设计已获得诸多BOBW保证；然而，作为计算高效替代方案的FTPL，由于其无优化特性，难以设计依赖臂选择概率的自适应学习率，导致其BOBW保证相对有限。本文旨在弥补这一差距。

Method: 作者引入替代概率函数（surrogate probability functions），这些函数仅依赖已可获取的量即可计算，无需精确概率。基于这些替代函数构造自适应学习率，应用于Pareto扰动（任意形状参数α>1）的FTPL中，并扩展至带专家建议的bandit问题，推导出BOBW保证。

Result: 对于任意形状参数α>1的Pareto扰动FTPL，成功建立了BOBW保证，推广了此前仅适用于α=2的结果；同时在带专家建议的bandit问题中也获得了BOBW保证。该方法保持了FTPL的计算简便性，同时实现了概率依赖的自适应性。

Conclusion: 基于替代概率函数的自适应学习率设计有效解决了FTPL中概率依赖学习率难以引入的问题，统一并推广了已有BOBW结果。该替代函数方法论具有超越FTPL及学习率设计的独立研究价值。

Abstract: Follow-the-regularized-leader framework has shown effectiveness and flexibility in online learning problems, where the choice of learning rates are known to be crucial. Recently, adaptive learning rates defined in terms of the arm-selection probabilities, obtained by solving convex optimization, have achieved improved best-of-both-worlds (BOBW) guarantees in various bandit problems. In contrast, BOBW guarantees for its computationally efficient alternative, follow-the-perturbed-leader (FTPL), remain relatively limited since its optimization-free nature ironically makes the design of adaptive, probability-dependent learning rates non-trivial. To address this challenge, we propose an adaptive learning rate for FTPL by introducing surrogate probability functions that can be computed only from the available quantities, without requiring the exact probabilities. Based on these learning rates with surrogate functions, we provide the BOBW guarantee for FTPL with Pareto perturbations for any shape parameter $α>1$, generalizing prior results restricted to specific choices of $α=2$. We further show the BOBW guarantees for FTPL with adaptive learning rates in the bandit problem with expert advices. Our approach preserves the computational simplicity of FTPL while enabling probability-dependent adaptivity, and the surrogate-based methodology may be of independent interest in other algorithmic frameworks beyond FTPL and learning rate designs.

</details>


### [342] [Effective Dimensionality as an Operator Invariant for Physics-Preserving Constraint Adaptation in Physics-Informed Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06171)
*Cornelius Otchere,Michael Shields*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 物理信息神经网络(PINNs)因共享参数空间同时满足控制方程和边界条件而存在任务干扰。本文利用Fisher信息矩阵定义有效自由度$d_{eff}$，衡量微分算子未约束的参数方向维度。对于有限维核算子，$d_{eff}$收敛到核维度，成为算子的结构不变量；对于无限维核算子，$d_{eff}$则度量网络的有限维表示带宽。将适定问题的$d_{eff}$驱零可认证物理与边界约束已吸收所有自由方向。基于此，提出子空间投影策略用于边界自适应，在预训练物理算子零空间中投影参数更新，实现秒到分钟级的快速适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINNs因共享参数同时满足微分方程和边界条件而存在任务干扰问题，但目前缺乏一种结构化的诊断工具来量化和分析这种冲突。作者希望找到一个能表征物理约束模型自由度的结构不变量，并利用它来指导高效的边界条件自适应。

Method: 1. 利用Fisher信息矩阵(FIM)定义有效自由度$d_{eff}$，即微分算子未约束的参数方向维度（通过对FIM特征值谱分析得到）。2. 证明对于有限维核算子，$d_{eff}$收敛到核维度，与网络宽度、深度、激活函数无关。3. 对于无限维核算子，$d_{eff}$度量网络的有限维表示带宽。4. 提出子空间投影策略：将参数更新投影到预训练物理算子的零空间中，实现新边界条件的快速适应而无需重新训练。

Result: $d_{eff}$可作为PINNs的先验结构诊断工具：适定问题$d_{eff} \to 0$表明物理和边界约束已完全约束网络。子空间投影方法在新边界条件适应上达到与梯度微调相当甚至更优的质量，但只需数秒到数分钟（对比梯度微调需更多计算时间和调参）。在线性和非线性算子上验证了该方法对初边值偏移及未遇见约束类型的准确适应能力。

Conclusion: $d_{eff}$成功将PINN的有效自由度从拟合诊断提升为微分算子的结构不变量，为物理约束模型提供了新的理论分析工具。子空间投影提供了一种高效、即插即用的边界适应方案，避免了重新训练的高昂成本，在科学计算和工程应用中具有实际价值。

Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks inherently suffer from task interference because they rely on a shared parameter space to satisfy both governing differential equations and boundary conditions. We analyze this structural conflict using the Fisher Information Matrix to quantify the effective degrees of freedom ($d_{eff}$) in a physics-constrained model. Unlike the classical $d_{eff}$ which measures how many parameter directions are informed by data against a statistical prior, our $d_{eff}$ measures the dimension of the parameter directions unconstrained by the differential operator. For operators with finite-dimensional kernel, we show that $d_{eff}$ converges to the kernel dimension exactly, independent of network width, depth, or activation function, recasting it from a fit diagnostic into a structural invariant of the underlying continuous operator. For operators with infinite-dimensional kernel, $d_{eff}$ instead measures the network's finite-dimensional representational bandwidth for that kernel rather than recovering an integer invariant. Importantly, $d_{eff}$ also serves as an a priori structural diagnostic. Driving $d_{eff}$ of a well-posed problem to zero certifies that the physics and boundary constraints have absorbed the network's free directions. Building on this characterization, we introduce subspace projection strategies for boundary adaptation. Rather than retraining from scratch, we project parameter updates into the null space of the pre-trained physics operator so that new boundary conditions are satisfied without disturbing the learned physics. Gradient-based fine-tuning can match or exceed this but needs more wall-clock time and tuning, whereas subspace projection delivers near-equivalent quality in seconds to minutes. We validate on linear and nonlinear operators, demonstrating accurate adaptation to initial and boundary shifts and unencountered constraint types.

</details>


### [343] [Diffusion Models Observe Only Gradients: A Geometric Perspective on Score Matching Errors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06179)
*Naïl B. Khelifa,Richard E. Turner,Ramji Venkataramanan*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文揭示了L²分数匹配误差与分布采样质量之间的结构性脱节：即使L²分数误差任意大，扩散模型仍可完美匹配目标分布。通过亥姆霍兹-霍奇分解，作者将分数误差分为梯度分量和螺线管分量，证明只有梯度分量影响边际分布演化，螺线管分量在动力学中不可见。基于此，给出了三项结果：不可能性定理、更紧的KL散度上界、以及梯度分量的可计算估计器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准扩散模型理论依赖L²分数匹配误差来界定采样误差，但作者发现该度量并不能真正反映学习分布与目标分布之间的差异——存在L²误差极大但分布完美匹配的反例。这促使作者探究分数误差的几何结构，寻找与分布质量内在相关的度量。

Method: 利用亥姆霍兹-霍奇分解将分数误差分解为梯度分量（源自势函数）与螺线管分量（旋度为零但散度也为零）。分析Fokker-Planck方程发现，仅梯度分量进入边际分布动力学，螺线管分量在路径空间中被"结构性地不可见"。基于此几何洞察，证明不可能性定理、推导Girsanov型KL散度上界（仅依赖梯度分量），并通过对偶Sobolev恒等式构造梯度分量的可处理估计器。

Result: 第一，证明不存在L²分数误差的单调函数能一致地下界学习分布与目标分布之间的任何散度。第二，推导出仅依赖可观测梯度分量的KL散度上界，比标准Girsanov界更紧，并指出其松弛度源于在路径空间而非边际空间操作。第三，梯度分量估计器在实证上与样本质量的相关性显著优于全L²误差。

Conclusion: L²分数匹配误差不是衡量扩散模型分布质量的合适内在度量；梯度分量才是决定采样保真度的核心要素。该发现为扩散模型的理论分析、损失函数设计和评估指标提供了新的几何视角。

Abstract: Score-based diffusion models are typically trained by minimizing the $L^2$ score matching error, and standard theoretical analyses rely on this quantity to bound the sampling discrepancy between the learned and target distributions. We show the $L^2$ score error is not the right intrinsic measure of marginal distributional quality: a learned diffusion model can incur arbitrarily large $L^2$ score error while perfectly matching the target distribution. By decomposing score errors into a gradient and a solenoidal component (a Helmholtz-Hodge decomposition), we identify the geometric reason behind this: only the gradient component enters the marginal Fokker-Planck dynamics, while the solenoidal component is structurally invisible. We make this precise in three results. First, building on the corrected geometry, we prove an impossibility result: no monotone function of the $L^2$ score error can uniformly lower bound any divergence between the learned and target distributions. Second, we derive an upper bound on the Kullback-Leibler divergence that depends only on the observable gradient component of the error, tightening the standard Girsanov bound and identifying its looseness as the cost of operating on path-space rather than marginal-space dynamics. Third, we give a tractable estimator of the gradient component via a dual Sobolev identity, which is shown to empirically correlate substantially better with sample quality than the full $L^2$ error.

</details>


### [344] [Anchor PCA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06233)
*Benedikt Seiter,Anya Fries,Julius von Kügelgen,Jonas Peters*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: Anchor PCA 是一种针对多域数据的鲁棒无监督降维方法，通过在整体解释方差与共享/域特定低秩嵌入之间进行权衡，找到各域共享的变化方向，从而在未见域上获得更好的泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统PCA在多个相关域数据上的简单池化处理容易捕捉仅在少数域中高方差的伪方向，导致在新域上泛化能力差。因此需要一种能够关注跨域共享变化方向的鲁棒嵌入方法。

Method: 提出Anchor PCA，通过对修正后的目标矩阵执行PCA，在总体解释方差与共享嵌入和域特定嵌入之间的一致性之间进行权衡。该方法可高效求解，且被证明能恢复最大不变子空间，并在有界域特定协方差膨胀下具有极小极大重构解释。

Result: 在模拟数据和含时间漂移的燃气传感器真实数据上，Anchor PCA 恢复出最大不变子空间，其在未见域上的方差解释能力优于池化基线方法和最坏情况替代方法。

Conclusion: Anchor PCA 是一种有前景的多域数据鲁棒无监督降维方法，能有效捕捉跨域共享的变化方向并提升对未见域的泛化能力。

Abstract: Principal component analysis (PCA) is one of the most widely used unsupervised dimension reduction techniques. We study PCA for data from multiple related domains. Since principal components generally differ across domains, one way to obtain a shared low-rank embedding is to perform PCA on the pooled data. However, this approach can focus on spurious directions that exhibit high variation in only a few domains. To find a robust embedding that still explains most variance in unseen but similar domains, we propose instead to focus on shared directions of variation. To this end, we introduce Anchor PCA which trades off overall explained variance with agreement between the shared and domain-specific low-rank embeddings. Anchor PCA amounts to PCA on a modified target matrix and thus can be solved efficiently. Moreover, we show that Anchor PCA recovers a maximal invariant subspace and admits a minimax reconstruction interpretation under bounded domain-specific covariance inflations. On simulated and real-world gas sensor data with temporal drift, we demonstrate, respectively, that Anchor PCA recovers the maximally invariant subspace and yields embeddings that explain more variance on unseen domains than the pooling baseline and a worst-case alternative. Taken together, these findings establish Anchor PCA as a promising approach to robust unsupervised dimension reduction from multi-domain data.

</details>


### [345] [Discrete Causal Representations from Heterogeneous Domains: A Bayesian Approach with Social Survey Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06288)
*Ankur Garg,Michael Stettler,Aaron Schein,Julius von Kügelgen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一种贝叶斯方法，从多环境数据中学习离散因果概念的因果表征，利用序贯蒙特卡洛采样近似多模态后验，并在社会调查数据上验证了其推断潜在文化价值观及因果关系的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 因果表征学习虽在可辨识性方面研究深入，但面向实际场景的不确定性感知方法仍探索不足。尤其是在异质性多环境数据中，分布偏移常由少数因果机制的稀疏局部变化引起，现有方法难以在离散概念和未知多节点软干预的设定下进行实用的不确定性量化。

Method: 提出分层贝叶斯模型，将因果假设和可解释性需求转化为先验分布与参数化选择；针对离散因果概念和未知多节点软干预场景，设计基于序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）采样的推断方案，以近似多模态后验分布。

Result: 在社会调查数据的案例研究中，模型成功推断出有意义的高层概念（如文化价值观、政治观点）及其之间的可信因果关系，其中潜在概念对应调查回答，环境对应不同国家或州。

Conclusion: 该贝叶斯框架能够从复杂的多环境真实数据中有效学习因果表征，兼具不确定性量化能力，为因果表征学习在实际应用中的推广提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Causal representation learning aims to infer the high-level latent causal concepts that give rise to observed low-level measurements. This is particularly relevant for heterogeneous data from different environments or domains since distribution shifts often arise through sparse, localized changes in some of the underlying causal mechanisms, while other parts of the generative process remain unchanged. Whereas identifiability of causal representations has been studied extensively, practical uncertainty-aware methods and real-world use cases remain less explored. In this work, we propose a Bayesian approach to learning causal representations from multi-environment data, focusing on the case of discrete causal concepts and unknown multi-node soft interventions. To this end, we translate causal assumptions and interpretability desiderata into suitable priors and parametric choices within a hierarchical model. We then devise an inference scheme based on sequential Monte Carlo sampling to approximate the resulting multimodal posterior. We showcase our approach through case studies on social survey data, where latent causal concepts correspond to cultural values or political opinions, measurements to survey responses, and environments to different countries or states. Our model infers meaningful high-level concepts and plausible causal relations among them, demonstrating its utility for learning causal representations of complex real-world data.

</details>


### [346] [Symmetric Divergence and Normalized Similarity: A Unified Topological Framework for Representation Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06342)
*Yan Wang,Tianyang Hu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一的拓扑数据分析工具包，包含两个核心组件：对称表示拓扑散度（SRTD/SRTD-lite）用于细粒度结构诊断，以及归一化拓扑相似度（NTS）用于标准化基准测试。该工具包解决了现有拓扑散度的理论不对称性和样本尺度依赖性问题，在CNN功能偏移检测和LLM谱系映射等任务上表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有配对拓扑散度（如RTD）存在两个关键缺陷：一是启发式不对称性导致理论不完备；二是得分无界且依赖样本规模，难以实现跨场景的可靠基准测试。研究者需要一个既能精细诊断结构差异、又能进行标准化评估的统一框架。

Method: 1. 提出对称表示拓扑散度（SRTD），通过整合跨条形码签名，将RTD框架完备化，消除不对称性并统一诊断信息；同时提出高效变体SRTD-lite以降低计算开销。2. 提出归一化拓扑相似度（NTS），利用层次合并顺序的秩相关性，产生有界于[-1,1]的尺度不变度量，克服未归一化散度的样本依赖问题。

Result: 在合成数据和真实深度学习场景中的实验表明：该工具包能捕捉CNN中被几何度量遗漏的功能性偏移，并能在距离饱和条件下稳健地映射LLM谱系关系，为CKA等现有度量提供了一种严谨的拓扑视角补充。

Conclusion: 该统一拓扑工具包成功弥合了细粒度结构诊断与标准化跨场景评估之间的鸿沟，SRTD/SRTD-lite与NTS的组合为神经表示分析提供了一套理论严谨、实践鲁棒的拓扑感知方案，有效补充了以CKA为代表的几何度量范式。

Abstract: Topological Data Analysis (TDA) offers a principled, intrinsic lens for comparing neural representations. However, existing paired topological divergences (e.g., RTD) are limited by heuristic asymmetry and, more critically, unbounded scores that depend on sample size, hindering reliable cross-scenario benchmarking. To address these challenges, we develop a unified topological toolkit serving two complementary needs: fine-grained structural diagnosis and robust, standardized evaluation. First, we complete the RTD framework by introducing Symmetric Representation Topology Divergence (SRTD) and its efficient variant SRTD-lite. Beyond resolving the theoretical asymmetry of prior variants, SRTD consolidates diagnostic information into a single, comprehensive cross-barcode signature. This allows for precise localization of structural discrepancies and serves as an effective optimization objective without the overhead of dual directional computations. Second, to enable reliable benchmarking across heterogeneous settings, we propose Normalized Topological Similarity (NTS). By measuring the rank correlation of hierarchical merge orders, NTS yields a scale-invariant metric bounded between -1 and 1, effectively overcoming the scale and sample-dependence of unnormalized divergences. Experiments across synthetic and real-world deep learning settings demonstrate that our toolkit captures functional shifts in CNNs missed by geometric measures and robustly maps LLM genealogy even under distance saturation, offering a rigorous, topology-aware perspective that complements measures like CKA.

</details>


### [347] [Function-Space Priors for Bayesian Neural ODEs with Application to Vessel Trajectory Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06351)
*Jaeyeong Lee,Wonmo Koo,Heeyoung Kim*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合函数空间正则化与概率多重打靶的贝叶斯神经常微分方程方法，用于AIS船舶轨迹预测。核心创新在于：将高斯过程核先验直接施加于向量场的有限测点集上，通过核正则化项增强向量场的结构信息编码，并引入概率多重打靶处理长序列不规则轨迹，从而在连续时间框架下实现更好的轨迹预测与校准不确定性估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统贝叶斯神经常微分方程使用各向同性高斯权重先验，无法编码船舶动力学的平滑性和局部性等结构先验。现有函数空间贝叶斯神经网络方法仅适用于静态映射，不能直接迁移到神经常微分方程——因为关注对象是轨迹而非向量场本身。虽然理论上可将高斯过程先验直接置于ODE解上，但通过非线性ODE求解器传播分布在解析上不可行。因此需要一种实用方法，在向量场上施加结构化先验。

Method: (1) 函数空间正则化：在标准权重空间变分目标上增加基于GP核的正则化项，惩罚向量场在有限测点集上偏离GP先验所隐含的结构；(2) 概率多重打靶：将长序列不规则AIS轨迹沿时间轴分割为多个段，在各段上独立推断，同时通过打靶约束保持全局一致性，解耦推断过程以适应不规则采样和缺失报告。

Result: 论文摘要未给出具体定量实验结果。方法预期在连续时间轨迹建模中提供更准确的点预测和更好的校准不确定性估计，适用于不规则采样和缺失数据的AIS船舶轨迹预测场景。

Conclusion: 通过在向量场上施加GP核先验并结合概率多重打靶，该方法有效克服了贝叶斯神经常微分方程中先验信息不足和长序列推断困难的问题，为海事态势感知提供了更可靠的轨迹预测与不确定性量化框架。

Abstract: Vessel trajectory prediction from Automatic Identification System (AIS) data is essential for maritime situational awareness, yet it remains challenging due to irregular sampling, missing reports, and complex dynamics. Beyond accurate point forecasts, maritime applications also demand well-calibrated uncertainty estimates for reliable decision-making. Bayesian Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs) offer a principled framework for continuous-time trajectory modeling with uncertainty quantification by placing a prior over the neural vector field parameters. However, the commonly used isotropic Gaussian weight prior fails to encode informative structural properties of vessel dynamics, such as smoothness and locality. Existing function-space Bayesian neural network methods address this limitation for static mappings, but do not transfer directly to Neural ODEs, where the primary quantity of interest is the trajectory rather than the vector field itself. In principle, one could place a Gaussian process (GP) prior directly over ODE solutions, but this requires propagating distributions through a nonlinear ODE solver, which is analytically intractable. To address this challenge, we adopt a practical approach that imposes a GP-kernel-based prior directly on the vector field evaluated at a finite set of measurement points. Specifically, we augment the standard weight-space variational objective with a kernel-based regularizer that penalizes deviations of the vector field from the structure implied by a GP prior. To handle long and irregular AIS trajectories, we further combine this function-space regularization with probabilistic multiple shooting, which decouples inference across temporal segments while maintaining global consistency.

</details>


### [348] [Conformal Risk Sharing: Certified Cost Allocation with Participation Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06391)
*Ieva Kazlauskaite*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文提出"共形风险分担"（Conformal Risk Sharing）框架，通过将可解释的分担策略与分裂共形校准相结合，在有限数据且无分布假设的条件下，为每个参与者提供义务上限的分布无关保证，从而在控制对他人损害的同时，大幅降低高风险个体的极端财务负担。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀有不良事件的财务影响若由群体分担可以平滑个体极端负担，但任何因该安排而处境恶化的参与者都有动机退出。因此，需要一个可信的机制，既能给每个参与者一个可信的未来义务上限，又需确保对参与者的总体损害有界。现有方法通常依赖强分布假设，而现实中往往只有有限数据且难以做出分布假设。

Method: 将问题形式化为"认证分配问题"（Certified Allocation Problem）。提出共形风险分担（CRS）框架：首先定义一个可解释的共享策略（如风险池、保险类合约），其共享强度由训练数据调优；然后利用留出的校准数据集，通过分裂共形推理（split conformal prediction）为每个参与者生成分布无关的、有限样本有效的义务上限保证（在可交换性假设下成立）。

Result: 在合成数据以及真实世界数据（包括降水数据和能源合作社数据）上的实验表明，CRS框架能在有效控制对其他参与者损害的前提下，显著降低高风险个体的极端义务负担。分布无关的保证在实验中得到了验证。

Conclusion: 共形风险分担在弱假设（仅要求数据可交换性）下，成功解决了认证分配问题，提供了一种可信的、可验证的风险共享机制，兼具理论保证和实用价值。

Abstract: Sharing the financial impact of rare adverse events across a group can soften extreme individual burdens, but any participant made worse off by the arrangement has reason to leave. A credible mechanism must therefore provide each agent with a trustworthy cap on their future obligation and should be deployed only if the aggregate harm across participants is bounded. We formalise this as the Certified Allocation Problem: from finite data and without distributional assumptions, find a redistribution rule, produce obligation caps for every participant, and verify that no participant is made materially worse off. We propose Conformal Risk Sharing, which solves this problem by pairing an interpretable sharing policy with split conformal calibration. The sharing intensity is tuned on training data, while held-out calibration data produces distribution-free per-agent guarantees (valid under exchangeability). Experiments on synthetic and real-world data, including precipitation and energy-cooperative data, confirm that the framework can substantially reduce extreme obligations for high-risk agents while controlling harm to others.

</details>


<div id='stat.ME'></div>

# stat.ME [[Back]](#toc)

### [349] [A Family of Quantile Functions Useful in Clinical Studies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05317)
*Sankaran P. G.,Prasanth V. P.,Midhu N. N*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文研究了基于分位数的有效性持久性函数（quantile-based effectiveness persistence function），定义为尾部均值与分位数函数之比。作者推导了该度量的统计性质，并采用莫比乌斯（有理）规范形式，在自然边界条件下简化为一个典范形式，由此导出一个双参数非负分布族。文中给出了该分布族的描述性度量、L-矩及基于分位数的可靠性概念，并发展了极大似然估计方法，最后以真实生存数据集进行示例说明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者受上尾分位数域摘要（upper-tail quantile-domain summaries）的启发，旨在通过分位数函数而非传统分布函数来刻画有效性与持久性之间的关系。传统方法多基于分布函数，而分位数方法在处理重尾分布、可靠性分析及生存数据时具有独特优势，为此需要构建一套基于分位数的有效性持久性度量体系及其对应的分布族。

Method: 1. 定义分位数基础的有效性持久性函数为尾部均值与分位数函数之比；2. 推导该度量的统计性质；3. 采用莫比乌斯（Möbius）有理规范形式对该函数进行参数化；4. 在自然边界条件下将规范形式约简为典范形式（canonical form）；5. 通过该典范分位数函数导出一个双参数非负分布族；6. 推导该分布族的描述性统计量、L-矩及基于分位数的可靠性指标；7. 建立极大似然参数估计方法；8. 使用真实生存数据集进行实证验证。

Result: 1. 得到了分位数基础有效性持久性函数的统计性质；2. 莫比乌斯规范形式在边界条件下可唯一简化为一个典范分位数函数；3. 该典范族定义了一个双参数非负分布类，具有解析的分位数函数表达；4. 推导出该族的L-矩、分位数基可靠性度量等闭式表达式；5. 建立了可行的极大似然估计方法；6. 在真实生存数据集上展示了该分布族的适用性和拟合效果。

Conclusion: 基于分位数的有效性持久性函数为分布建模提供了一种新颖而灵活的框架。莫比乌斯规范下的典范族不仅具有简洁的解析形式，还能有效捕捉生存数据的尾部特征。该双参数分布族在可靠性分析和生存分析中具有良好的应用前景，其分位数驱动的建模思路可进一步推广至更广泛的统计应用场景。

Abstract: Motivated by upper-tail quantile-domain summaries, we study the quantile-based effectiveness persistence function defined as the ratio between the tail mean and the quantile function. We derive statistical properties of this measure and consider a rational (Möbius) specification of the quantilebased effectiveness persistence function. Under natural boundary conditions, this specification reduces to a canonical form. The resulting canonical family defines a two-parameter class of nonnegative distributions through its quantile function. Various properties, including descriptive measures, L-moments, and quantile-based reliability concepts, are derived for this class. Estimation of the model parameters using maximum likelihood is also developed. The proposed family is illustrated using a real survival dataset.

</details>


### [350] [Analyzing spatial point processes degraded by displacement and imperfect detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05374)
*Kevin M. Collins,Erin M. Schliep,Alan E. Gelfand,Tina M. Yack,Christopher W. Clark,Robert S. Schick*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文研究空间点过程在观测不完美（即存在退化）情况下的建模问题，聚焦于空间泊松过程的两种退化形式——稀疏化（thinning）和位移（displacement），证明了在弱条件下模型的可识别性，并通过模拟研究和北大西洋露脊鲸声学数据验证方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间点过程的观测数据往往存在不完美性（退化），包括稀疏化和位移。若忽略这些退化直接建模，会导致推断偏差和模型误设。因此需要发展能够同时考虑退化机制和强度函数的联合学习方法，以实现更准确的推断。

Method: 针对空间泊松过程，作者系统研究了两种退化形式：稀疏化（thinning，即部分点被随机移除）和位移（displacement，即观测位置偏离真实位置）。理论上，证明了在弱条件下模型具有可识别性——可以联合学习位移尺度、参数化稀疏化函数以及非参数强度函数。通过模拟研究验证了联合学习各组分的能力，并与忽略退化的误设模型进行对比。

Result: 理论结果表明，在弱条件下可联合识别位移尺度、参数化稀疏化形式和非参数强度函数。模拟研究证实该方法能有效学习所有退化组分，且相比忽略退化的误设模型，推断精度有显著提升。在科德角湾北大西洋露脊鲸叫声数据的实际应用中同样展现出良好效果。

Conclusion: 考虑观测退化对于空间点过程的准确推断至关重要。所提出的框架能够同时处理稀疏化和位移两种退化，在理论和实证层面均验证了方法的有效性，为生态声学等领域的空间点过程建模提供了更为可靠的统计工具。

Abstract: Spatial point processes are a valuable tool for probabilistic modeling to explain location data. However, the data themselves are often observed imperfectly. In order to perform accurate inference, one must account for these imperfections, which we refer to as degradation. We consider two forms of degradation for spatial Poisson processes: thinning and displacement. First, we provide some theoretical results on model identifiability, showing that, under weak conditions, one can jointly learn the scale of the displacement, a parametric form of thinning, and a nonparametric intensity function. The ability to learn all of these components and the resulting improvements for inference compared to the conceptual non-degraded but misspecified model are shown empirically via simulation study. Finally, we apply this approach to North Atlantic right whale call data from Cape Cod Bay.

</details>


### [351] [Wasserstein Exponential Smoothing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05560)
*Takuo Matsubara,Peiwen Jiang,Minh-Ngoc Tran,Wilson Ye Chen*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文将经典指数平滑法推广至Wasserstein空间中的分布时间序列，提出了一种简洁的Wasserstein指数平滑模型，并证明平滑参数可通过最小化Wasserstein距离进行一致估计，在金融高频收益与家庭电力需求等分布时间序列上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 指数平滑在实数域时间序列预测中表现优异，但现实应用中越来越多地遇到分布时间序列（每个观测值是ℝ上的概率分布），传统ES无法直接适用，亟需将其拓展到分布数据场景。

Method: 在Wasserstein空间框架下，利用Wasserstein重心的几何结构，将经典指数平滑递归公式推广为分布间的加权Wasserstein重心迭代；平滑参数的估计通过最小化Wasserstein距离来实现，并提供了理论一致性证明。

Result: 理论上证明了平滑参数可由最小化Wasserstein距离一致估计；实证上，在高频金融收益率分布和家庭用电需求分布的预测任务中，所提Wasserstein ES模型展现出良好的实用效果。

Conclusion: 该工作在保持经典指数平滑高度简洁性的前提下，成功将其推广至Wasserstein空间，为分布时间序列预测提供了一种原则性强、直观且有效的统一框架。

Abstract: Exponential smoothing (ES) often outperforms other techniques in time series forecasting across a wide range of data-generating processes. While ES has traditionally been applied to time series in $\mathbb{R}$, this paper extends the methodology to distributional time series, where each observation is a probability distribution on $\mathbb{R}$. The primary contribution of this work is twofold. First, we propose a principled and intuitive generalization of ES within the Wasserstein space, which retains the exceptional parsimony of classical ES. Second, we theoretically and empirically demonstrate that the smoothing parameter can be consistently estimated by minimizing a Wasserstein distance. Applications to distributional time series of high-frequency financial returns and household electricity demands confirm the practical effectiveness of our Wasserstein ES model.

</details>


### [352] [Weighting a Census as a Non-Probability Sample: A Doubly Robust Framework for Correcting Differential Undercoverage in Uruguay's 2023 Census](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05666)
*Ferreira Juan Pablo,Goyeneche Juan Jose*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 2023年乌拉圭人口普查存在10.3%的非随机漏报，集中在弱势群体、农村和年轻人。作者将有效登记户视为未知选择机制的非概率样本，采用双重稳健估计器构建权重：结合区段层面的响应倾向模型（以网页链接率作为接触代理）与组合普查人口总数校准。该方法在倾向模型或校准模型任一正确时保持一致，并在三百万条记录上应用，评估了对社会指标的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行政记录虽能恢复总量，但缺乏核心普查变量、存在城市化和机构可见性偏差，且无法重构住户，导致枚举微数据估计仍有偏。需要一种能够在非随机漏报条件下修正选择偏差的加权方法。

Method: 将有效登记住户视为非概率样本，采用双重稳健（Doubly Robust, DR）估计框架。具体包括：(1) 构建区段级响应倾向模型，使用网页链接率作为接触代理变量；(2) 对组合普查的人口统计总量（性别、年龄、行政区）进行校准；(3) DR估计器在倾向模型或校准模型至少一个正确设定时保持一致性；(4) 基于等效分层整群设计给出方差近似。

Result: 在三百万条记录规模上成功应用该方法，量化了对社会指标的修正效应，并给出了方差近似结果。

Conclusion: 提出了一个方法论框架，指导各国统计机构根据其可用的登记册和辅助数据（paradata）优化无应答调整策略。

Abstract: The 2023 Uruguayan Census recorded a population of 3,444,451 with an estimated undercoverage of 10.3%. Post-enumeration evidence shows that omission was non-random, concentrated in vulnerable areas, rural territories, and among young adults. Integrating administrative records (AR) recovered aggregate counts but did not resolve selection bias in outcome variables, as AR lack core census variables, exhibit urbanicity and institutional-visibility biases, and do not reconstruct households. Estimates derived from enumerated microdata remain biased. We treat effectively enumerated households as a non-probability sample with an unknown selection mechanism and construct weights using a doubly robust (DR) estimator. This framework combines a segment-level response-propensity model, using the web linkage rate as a contact proxy, with calibration to combined-census demographic totals (sex, age, department). Because the DR estimator is consistent when either model is correctly specified, it provides robustness against undercoverage misspecification. We describe the application at a scale of three million records, document its effect on social indicators, and present a variance approximation based on an equivalent stratified cluster design. Finally, we establish a methodological framework to guide national statistical offices on optimizing non-response adjustments based on their available registers and paradata.

</details>


### [353] [regcorr: An R Package for Regression Models of Pearson Correlation Coefficients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05676)
*Ze Lin,Bo Li,Jinyao Shen*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: regcorr 是一个 R 包，实现了将 Pearson 相关系数与协变量线性预测器相联系的回归模型，支持二元正态和二元伯努利响应，提供 Newton-Raphson 估计、数据生成和基于 bootstrap 的显著性检验功能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的 Pearson 相关系数仅提供单一的关联强度摘要，但在许多实际应用中，关联强度本身是异质的，可能随人口学、生物学、实验或环境协变量而变化。因此需要一种能够建模协变量依赖相关性的统计框架和软件工具。

Method: 基于 Dufera, Liu, and Xu (2023) 的似然框架，将 Pearson 相关系数通过链接函数与协变量的线性预测器关联，建立回归模型。支持二元正态和二元伯努利两种响应类型。估计采用 Newton-Raphson 算法，并提供基于 bootstrap 的子程序评估协变量效应的显著性和检验功效。

Result: 该包以轻量级 R 接口实现，无编译代码，依赖项极少。提供了模拟数据生成器、可复现的使用示例以及对协变量依赖相关性结果的实用解释指导。包已发布在 CRAN 上，采用 MIT 许可证。

Conclusion: regcorr 包填补了 R 生态中建模协变量依赖相关性的工具空白，通过简洁的接口和完整的推断功能，使研究者能够方便地分析关联强度随协变量变化的异质性模式。

Abstract: Pearson's correlation coefficient is commonly used as a single-number summary of association between two responses. In many applications, however, the strength of association is itself heterogeneous and may vary with demographic, biological, experimental, or environmental covariates. The regcorr package implements regression models in which a Pearson correlation coefficient is linked to a linear predictor of covariates. The package supports bivariate normal responses and bivariate Bernoulli responses, provides Newton-Raphson estimation routines, includes data generators for simulation studies, and supplies a bootstrap-based subroutine for assessing the significance and power of covariate effects. The implementation follows the likelihood-based framework of Dufera, Liu, and Xu (2023) and exposes it through a lightweight R interface with no compiled code and minimal dependencies. This paper describes the statistical model, the computational design of regcorr, reproducible usage examples, and practical guidance for interpreting covariate-dependent correlations. The package is available from the Comprehensive R Archive Network at https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=regcorr under the MIT license.

</details>


### [354] [Smooth Concordance Metrics for Survival Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06411)
*Nicholas Hartman,Grace Richards*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出了一类平滑一致性指标（smooth concordance metrics），将风险判别概率建模为预测风险得分差异的连续函数，函数形状由观测数据估计，克服了传统一致性指标仅利用秩排序、对强预测变量不敏感的缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统一致性指标（如C-index）仅依赖预测风险得分的秩排序，对模型中加入强预测变量等重要变化不敏感，且无法揭示模型在不同风险得分差异区间上的判别表现差异。

Method: 将风险判别概率建模为预测风险得分差异的连续函数，函数形状由观测数据自适应估计，从而得到平滑一致性指标。该指标可在风险得分差异的全范围内评估模型性能。

Result: 模拟实验表明，相比传统一致性指标，平滑一致性指标能提供更详细的风险判别信息，且对有意义的预测变量加入更为敏感。在癌症复发预测生存模型的比较中验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 平滑一致性指标能够识别候选模型表现特别优异或优于其他模型的具体场景，为生存预测模型的判别能力评估提供了更精细、更敏感的工具。

Abstract: Concordance indices are widely popular metrics for assessing the ability of predictive survival models to discriminate underlying risk levels. However, these statistics have also been criticized for using only the rank orderings of the model's predicted risk scores and being insensitive to important model features, such as the addition of strong predictor variables into the model. In this paper, we address these limitations by developing smooth concordance metrics that model the underlying risk discrimination probabilities as continuous functions of the predicted risk score differences, where the shapes of these functions are estimated from the observed data. As a result, these smooth concordance metrics assess model performance across the entire range of possible risk score differences, allowing one to identify specific scenarios where the candidate model performs especially well or better than other models. Simulations show that the proposed smooth concordance metrics provide more detailed information about risk discrimination performance and are much more sensitive to the addition of meaningful predictors. We apply these methods to compare predictive survival models for cancer recurrence.

</details>


### [355] [A Robust Framework for Model Order Selection in Correlated Large-Dimensional CES Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06426)
*Eugénie Terreaux,Emmanuelle Jay,Frédéric Pascal,Jean-Philippe Ovarlez*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在高维、相关、非高斯噪声下的模型阶数选择框架，基于Toeplitz结构的M估计器进行噪声白化，再结合大维随机矩阵理论进行信号子空间秩推断，在多种真实数据上验证了其优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统模型阶数选择方法（如AIC）通常假设高斯白噪声，在实际中面对高维、相关且服从复椭圆对称分布的非高斯噪声时性能严重退化。因此需要一种鲁棒的、适用于大维情形的模型阶数选择方法。

Method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段使用基于Toeplitz校正的M估计器（包括样本协方差矩阵、Maronna M估计器和Tyler M估计器三种变体）对噪声散度矩阵进行估计和白化；第二阶段利用大维随机矩阵理论的特征值上界，在观测维度和样本量成比例增长的渐近机制下，分离信号与噪声分量，实现信号子空间秩的一致推断。

Result: 证明了所提估计量的几乎必然一致性，并给出了显式的RMT特征值分离上界。在合成数据、高光谱图像、脑电信号和金融数据上的实验表明，该方法相比AIC和未经白化的方法有显著提升。

Conclusion: 该鲁棒两阶段框架能够有效处理高维、相关、非高斯噪声下的模型阶数选择问题，具有理论保证和广泛的实用价值。

Abstract: This paper addresses model order selection under large-dimensional, correlated, non-Gaussian noise. Sources are assumed to be embedded in additive Complex Elliptically Symmetric (CES) noise with an unknown Toeplitz-structured scatter matrix. We propose a two-stage robust framework: (i) a noise-whitening step based on a Toeplitz-rectified $M$-estimator of the scatter matrix, and (ii) signal subspace rank inference via large-dimensional Random Matrix Theory (RMT). Almost sure consistency of the proposed estimators is established, together with explicit RMT eigenvalue upper bounds separating signal from noise components, in the regime where the observation dimension $m$ and the sample size $N$ grow proportionally. Three estimation branches are derived, based respectively on the sample covariance matrix (SCM), Maronna's $M$-estimator, and the distribution-free Tyler $M$-estimator for whitening. The methodology is validated on synthetic data, real hyperspectral images, EEG recordings, and financial data, with significant gains over AIC and unwhitened methods.

</details>


### [356] [Leveraging External Controls for Treatment Switching in Randomized Controlled Trials: A Weighted Causal Inference Framework for Overall Survival](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06441)
*Andy A. Shen,Chenqi Fu,Ray Lin*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 针对肿瘤临床试验中因治疗转换导致疗效估计偏倚的问题，本文提出一个整合外部对照的通用框架，利用合成对照法和平衡权重，通过多重插补和时变权重来校正治疗转换，并通过模拟研究和两项III期试验验证了方法的优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在肿瘤临床试验中，患者常因疾病进展等原因从对照组转换至试验组或其他治疗，这破坏了随机化分组的因果保证，导致治疗效应估计产生偏倚。现有校正方法要么依赖强假设，要么模型设定复杂，亟需一种更灵活、更有效的方法来解决治疗转换问题。

Method: 提出一个通用框架：(1)引入外部对照数据，利用合成对照法（synthetic control method）和观察性因果推断中的平衡权重（balancing weights）构建外部参照；(2)提出多种基于多重插补（multiple imputation）和时变权重（time-varying weights）的估计量来校正治疗转换；(3)讨论如何选择用于插补的外部对照风险集。框架不依赖强参数假设，灵活性高。

Result: 广泛的模拟研究表明，所提方法相比那些以朴素方式利用外部对照或完全不利用外部对照的标准校正方法，在统计学上有显著改善。在两项III期肿瘤临床试验的实际应用中，进一步验证了基于外部对照方法的实用价值。

Conclusion: 通过整合外部对照并借助合成对照和平衡权重技术，所提出的框架能够有效校正随机对照试验中的治疗转换偏倚，为肿瘤临床试验的疗效评估提供了一种更具稳健性和实用性的分析工具。

Abstract: In many oncology clinical trials where overall survival is a key endpoint, patients are permitted to switch from the control arm to the experimental treatment arm or other suitable therapies. Switching can occur for various reasons, including disease progression. This violates the causal guarantees of randomized treatment assignment, resulting in biased treatment effect estimates. Existing methods often require strong assumptions, complicated model specifications, or both. In this paper, we propose a general framework that incorporates external controls to account for treatment switching in randomized controlled trials. Leveraging the synthetic control method and balancing weights from observational causal inference, we propose several estimators that use multiple imputation and time-varying weights to adjust for treatment switching. We also discuss approaches to selecting the risk set of external controls to impute from. Through extensive simulation studies, we show that our proposed methods lead to meaningful statistical improvements relative to standard adjustment methods that utilize external controls in naive ways or those that do not utilize external controls at all. We then demonstrate the utility of our external control-based approaches with two phase III oncology trials.

</details>


### [357] [Two-Sample Hypothesis Testing for Subspace Equality in Network Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06482)
*Rajdeep Brahma,Joshua Agterberg,Yuguo Chen*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种检验两个网络是否共享相同潜在子空间（如社区结构）的假设检验方法，即使边概率不同。检验统计量基于主导子空间投影矩阵差异的Frobenius范数，经中心化和尺度化后渐近服从高斯分布。理论结果依赖于经验与真实特征向量投影差的极限定理，并通过数值模拟和美国航班数据验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究者常常需要判断两个网络是否共享某些结构连接模式（如社区），但即便社区相同，边概率也可能显著不同。现有的许多检验方法要么假设边概率相同，要么无法分离子空间与边概率的差异。因此需要一种能够检验子空间相同性而允许边概率不同的通用检验方法。

Method: 提出基于主导子空间投影矩阵差异的Frobenius范数的检验统计量；证明其在适当中心化和尺度化后，当平均期望度至少随顶点数对数增长时，收敛于高斯分布；给出渐近均值和方差的估计量，并在更强信号条件下证明一致性；推导网络充分稠密时检验的局部功效。核心理论工具是经验与真实特征向量投影差的极限定理（可视为检验统计量的单样本版本）。

Result: 检验统计量经中心化和尺度化后渐近正态；渐近均值和方差估计量在更强信号条件下具有一致性；在网络充分稠密时给出了局部功效分析；数值模拟验证了理论性质，在美国航班数据应用中发现不同航空公司的航线网络存在显著的子空间差异。

Conclusion: 提出的检验方法能够有效判断两个网络是否共享相同的潜在子空间，尤其适用于随机块模型和混合成员随机块模型中的社区检测场景。该方法不要求边概率相同，具有广泛的适用性，且理论和数值结果均支持其有效性。

Abstract: In many settings one is often interested in determining whether two networks share some joint structural connectivity patterns such as communities. However, while communities may be shared across networks, edge probabilities may differ significantly. Therefore, in this paper we consider testing a general null hypothesis that two networks have the same underlying subspace, which in particular includes the setting that communities are the same for either stochastic blockmodels or mixed-membership stochastic blockmodels (even if edge probabilities are different). We propose a test statistic based on the Frobenius norm of the difference of the leading subspace projection matrices, and we prove that our test statistic, after appropriate centering and scaling, converges in distribution to a Gaussian random variable as long as the average expected degree grows at least logarithmically in the number of vertices. We then provide estimators for the asymptotic mean and variance and show consistency under a stronger signal condition, and we give the local power of our test when the networks are sufficiently dense. Our theoretical results are based on a limit theorem for the projection difference of empirical and true eigenvectors which can also be viewed as the one-sample version of our test statistic, and this result may be of independent interest. We demonstrate our results through numerical simulations and an application to US Flight data.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [358] [How Far Did They Go? The Persuasive Tactics of Covert LLM Agents in a Discontinued Field Experiment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05256)
*Kokil Jaidka,Saifuddin Ahmed*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究分析了一项已终止的Reddit r/ChangeMyView田野实验数据集，考察未披露的AI生成账户在身份丰富的审议论坛中的修辞行为。研究发现AI评论系统性地采用身份表演、权威信号、对齐策略和认知偏差触发，形成了一套以说服效率而非真实审议参与为目的的修辞架构，且其模式与人类反论存在显著的结构性差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一项由外部研究者在Reddit r/ChangeMyView上进行的未披露AI干预实验因伦理 backlash 被终止，随后公开了AI生成评论的档案。这为研究大语言模型在无披露情况下、于身份丰富的审议公共空间中如何运作提供了罕见窗口。作者旨在揭示AI系统在真实对话环境中构建说服性话语的修辞策略与模式，并探讨其对认知权威性与审议完整性的影响。

Method: 采用结构化内容分析法，对公开的AI评论语料库进行编码与评估。分析维度包括：身份表演（identity performance）、权威信号（authority signaling）、对齐策略（alignment strategies）以及认知启发式的激活（activation of cognitive heuristics）。同时将AI评论与人类撰写的CMV反论进行对比分析，以揭示两者在各维度上的分布差异。

Result: （1）超三分之二的AI评论涉及身份定位或身份采纳；（2）近乎全部评论包含对齐动作和权威声明；（3）绝大多数评论触发了认知偏差，尤以确认偏误、代表性启发式和可得性启发式最为显著；（4）上述模式系统性地共现，构成以说服效率为导向的修辞架构；（5）与人类CMV反论相比，AI评论在所有维度上呈现反向分布：更密集的权威使用、更具对抗性的对齐策略、更依赖外部引用而非经验基础。

Conclusion: 在AI代理参与审议的环境中，真实认知立场与合成认知立场之间的区别日益模糊，仅靠披露要求无法解决这一不对称性。研究结果指向需要建立新的审计框架，以评估AI系统如何构建可信度，而不仅仅是检测其是否存在。

Abstract: This study analyzes a publicly released dataset from a discontinued field experiment on Reddit's r/ChangeMyView. The intervention, conducted by unknown, external researchers and halted following ethical backlash, involved undisclosed AI-generated accounts engaging users in live debate. After public disclosure, Reddit authorized moderators to release an archive of the AI-generated comments, creating a rare opportunity to examine how large language models operated in an identity-rich deliberative forum without disclosure. We conduct a structured content analysis of this corpus, evaluating identity performance, authority signaling, alignment strategies, and activation of cognitive heuristics. Identity targeting or adoption appears in over two-thirds of comments, alignment moves and authority claims in nearly all of them, and cognitive-bias triggers -- particularly confirmation bias, representativeness, and availability -- in the large majority. These patterns co-occur systematically, composing a rhetorical architecture calibrated for persuasive efficiency rather than authentic deliberative participation. Compared against human-authored CMV counter-arguments, the agents inverted the typical distribution on every dimension: denser authority use, more adversarial alignment, and heavier reliance on external citation over experiential grounding. In such environments, distinctions between authentic and synthetic epistemic standing grow increasingly opaque -- an asymmetry that disclosure mandates alone cannot address. The results point toward auditing frameworks capable of assessing how AI systems structure credibility, not merely whether they are present.

</details>


### [359] [What Should Agents Say? Action-state Communication for Efficient Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05304)
*Chen Huang,Yuhao Wu,Wenxuan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文分析了多智能体系统中自由形式通信的代价，发现固定策略非普适最优，进而提出PACT协议将智能体输出压缩为精简的动作-状态记录，在多种拓扑下以更少的token实现同等或更强的任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统中自由形式自然语言通信会导致token使用膨胀、上下文窗口耗尽，影响性能和推理成本。现有固定通信策略缺乏普适性，因此需要一种更高效的通信协议。

Method: 首先分析五种常见智能体间通信策略在两种MAS拓扑下的表现，发现保留动作中心信息是关键。基于此提出PACT协议，将智能体间通信建模为公共状态更新问题，将每个智能体的原始输出投影为紧凑的动作-状态记录后再进入共享历史。

Result: PACT在不同MAS拓扑中一致性地改善了性能-成本权衡，用显著更少的token达到可比或更强的任务性能。在OpenHands上，PACT提升了解决率且每个解决任务减少10% token；在SWE-agent上实现解决率中性而输入token减半。

Conclusion: PACT协议通过将智能体间通信从自由文本转化为结构化的动作-状态更新，有效解决了多智能体系统的通信效率问题，在保持或提升任务性能的同时大幅降低token开销，具有良好的通用性和实用性。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built on large language models are typically organized around roles, pipelines, and turn schedules, while the content that agents pass to one another is often left as unconstrained natural language. However, this free-form communication can rapidly inflate token usage, consume the shared context window, and ultimately affect both system performance and inference cost. We analyze five common inter-agent communication strategies across two MAS topologies, finding that no fixed strategy is universally optimal. Instead, effective inter-agent messages consistently preserve action-centered information needed by downstream agents. Building on this, we propose the PACT (Protocolized Action-state Communication and Transmission), which treats inter-agent communication as a public state-update problem and projects each raw agent output into a compact action-state record before it enters shared history. Across different MAS topologies, PACT consistently improves the performance-cost trade-off, achieving comparable or stronger task performance with substantially fewer tokens. The gains extend to production coding harnesses: PACT lifts OpenHands' resolve rate at -10% tokens-per-resolved, and is resolve-neutral on SWE-agent while halving input tokens. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/iNLP-Lab/PACT.

</details>


### [360] [I Know What You Meme, Even If it Emerged Today: Understanding Evolving Memes through Open-World Knowledge Acquisition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05316)
*Shanhong Liu,Rui Cao,Pai Chet Ng,De Wen Soh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Query Retrieve Conclude零样本框架，通过检索开放网络证据补充缺失背景知识，提升多模态迷因的理解与检测效果，并发布了2024-2026年迷因理解基准数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态迷因理解方法忽视背景知识或依赖预训练模型固定的参数化知识，这些知识可能不完整、过时或对新兴迷因不可用，因此需要一种动态获取最新外部知识的方法。

Method: 提出Query Retrieve Conclude（QRC）零样本框架：首先识别迷因理解中缺失的背景知识（Query），然后从开放网络中检索相关证据（Retrieve），最后综合检索证据生成背景知识并用于迷因理解与检测（Conclude）。同时构建了2024-2026年最新迷因的理解基准数据集，包含外部背景知识标注。

Result: 在三个迷因理解数据集和五个迷因检测任务上的实验表明，该框架在知识恢复、迷因理解和下游检测任务上均优于零样本基线方法。

Conclusion: QRC框架通过动态检索开放网络知识，有效弥补了固定参数化知识的不足，显著提升了迷因理解和检测的性能，特别适用于需要最新背景知识的新兴迷因场景。

Abstract: Multimodal memes are dynamic and often require up to date background knowledge for interpretation. Existing methods often overlook such knowledge or rely on fixed parametric knowledge of pretrained models that may be incomplete, outdated, or unavailable for emerging memes. We introduce Query Retrieve Conclude, a zero shot framework that identifies missing knowledge, retrieves open web evidence, and synthesizes evidence grounded background knowledge for meme understanding and detection. We also introduce a curated meme understanding benchmark of recent memes from 2024 to 2026 with external background knowledge annotations. Experiments on three meme understanding datasets and five meme detection tasks show that our framework improves knowledge recovery, meme understanding and downstream detection over zero shot baselines.

</details>


### [361] [GITCO: Gated Inference-Time Context Optimization in TSFMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05332)
*Manya Pandey,Dhruv Kumar,Murari Mandal,Saurabh Deshpande*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出GITCO框架，通过推理时选择性抑制有害patch来缓解时序基础模型的上下文中毒问题，无需更新模型参数，在TimesFM 2.5上获得平均+1.95% MASE改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基于patch的时序基础模型（TSFMs）存在"上下文中毒"现象：结构异常的patch会不成比例地吸引模型注意力，在零样本预测中悄然降低预测质量。现有方法多聚焦于修改模型权重（如微调），但推理阶段的输入优化问题尚未被充分探索。作者希望在不触及模型参数的前提下，通过优化输入上下文来提升预测精度。

Method: 提出GITCO（Gated Inference-Time Context Optimization），一个轻量级三组件框架：(1) Gate——识别并选择性过滤有害patch；(2) Router——决定哪些patch需要被抑制以及抑制程度；(3) Critic——评估干预效果并提供反馈信号。整个流程在推理时进行，无需任何参数更新。此外，引入"上下文敏感性曲线"概念，刻画TSFM从时序元特征到预期精度提升的映射关系，该映射由模型架构和数据统计结构共同决定。

Result: 在TimesFM 2.5上对53个GIFT-Eval数据集进行K折交叉验证，GITCO实现平均MASE降低1.95%，捕获了改进上界的89.9%。上下文敏感性曲线揭示了模型对不同数据特征的差异化响应模式。

Conclusion: 推理时上下文优化是提升TSFM零样本预测能力的有效且轻量途径。GITCO证明无需修改模型权重即可显著缓解上下文中毒，上下文敏感性曲线为理解TSFM行为提供了新的分析工具。

Abstract: Patch-based Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) suffer from context poisoning: structurally anomalous patches capture disproportionate attention and silently degrade zero-shot forecast quality. We propose improving TSFM accuracy at inference time by optimizing the input context rather than modifying model weights. We present GITCO (Gated Inference-Time Context Optimization), a lightweight three-component framework: Gate, Router, and Critic that selectively identifies and suppresses harmful patches without any parameter updates. Evaluated on TimesFM 2.5 across 53 GIFT-Eval datasets under K-fold cross-validation, GITCO achieves an average +1.95% MASE reduction on TimesFM 2.5 while capturing 89.9% of the improvement upper bound. We introduce context sensitivity profiles as a new characterizable property of TSFMs: the mapping from time series meta-features to expected accuracy improvement under inference-time context intervention, shaped jointly by model architecture and the statistical structure of the data.

</details>


### [362] [Uncertainty Aware Functional Behavior Prediction and Material Fatigue Assessment for Circular Factory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05334)
*Nehal Afifi,Mehdi Khabou,Victor Mas,Jonas Hemmerich,Patric Grauberger,Stefan Dietrich,Volker Schulze,Sven Matthiesen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向角磨机的实例化可靠性评估框架，将不确定性感知的功能预测与部件级疲劳评估相结合。通过卷积编码器提取力-扭矩加载模式，LSTM预测九项功能变量的高斯分布，同时利用有限元应力重构与损伤累积模型评估输出轴疲劳，最终通过流式重放算法整合为功能、材料及系统可靠性轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环工厂中回收产品具有异质性退化状态和使用历史，当前仅靠一次检验无法决定其再利用可行性，因为未来功能履行和部件完整性会因下一个服役场景而呈现不同演化路径。现有PHM方法多针对固定工况或孤立部件，且材料疲劳评估与系统级功能预后缺乏关联，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 提出组合框架：(1)利用卷积编码器从主轴力和轴扭矩中提取加载模式，LSTM骨干预测九项功能变量的高斯均值与方差；(2)并行分支通过有限元辅助应力重构、S-N/Miner损伤累积（含Haibach扩展）及Paris裂纹扩展分析，将加载历史转化为输出轴疲劳信息；(3)流式重放算法整合两分支，生成功能、材料及系统可靠性轨迹。

Result: 留出测试表明，九项输出的平均2%容差精度达0.9652；热变量预测近乎完美；驱动电机电流和负载转速是最具挑战性的动态输出，R²分别为0.9750和0.9924；扭矩历史对这些变量尤为重要；在短历史条件下，传统LSTM优于GRU和xLSTM；可靠性校准对驱动电机电流的信息量最大。

Conclusion: 该框架有效实现了不确定性感知功能预测与部件级疲劳评估的深度融合，为循环工厂中异质性回收产品的再利用决策提供了系统级、实例化的可靠性量化手段。

Abstract: Returned products in circular factories re-enter production with heterogeneous degradation states, usage histories, and remaining capability. Reuse cannot be decided from the current inspection alone, because future function fulfillment and component integrity may evolve differently under the next service scenario. Existing PHM approaches support degradation prediction, but often target fixed operating conditions or isolated component benchmarks, while material-fatigue assessment is rarely linked to system-level functional prognosis. This paper addresses this gap for an angle grinder by combining uncertainty-aware functional prediction with component-level fatigue assessment in an instance-specific reliability workflow. The proposed framework combines the current tool state with recent force--torque usage windows. A convolutional encoder extracts loading patterns from spindle forces and shaft torque, and an LSTM backbone predicts nine functional variables as Gaussian mean and variance estimates. In parallel, the same loading history is translated into output-shaft fatigue information through finite-element-supported stress reconstruction, S--N/Miner damage evaluation with Haibach extension, and Paris-law crack-growth analysis. A streaming replay algorithm consolidates both branches into functional, material, and system reliability trajectories. Held-out tests show mean \(2\%\)-tolerance accuracy of 0.9652 across nine outputs. Thermal variables are predicted near-perfectly, while drive motor current and load speed remain the most demanding dynamic outputs, with \(R^2\) values of 0.9750 and 0.9924. Torque history is especially important for these variables, and the conventional LSTM outperforms GRU and xLSTM in the short-history setting. Reliability calibration is most informative for drive motor current, where predicted and observed exceedance probabilities ...

</details>


### [363] [SentinelBench: A Benchmark for Long-Running Monitoring Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05342)
*Matheus Kunzler Maldaner,Adam Fourney,Amanda Swearngin,Hussein Mozzanar,Gagan Bansal,Maya Murad,Rafah Hosn,Saleema Amershi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SentinelBench是一个面向长时间运行监控任务的基准测试，包含10个合成Web环境中的100个任务，衡量智能体在持续关注策略下的任务完成度、反应时间和资源消耗，揭示响应性与成本之间的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI智能体默认采用持续行动策略（不断调用工具、刷新页面等），但这对于需要长时间运行的任务并不合适。作者认为这类任务更适合“持续关注”策略——智能体应监控环境，仅在外部事件使进展成为可能时才及时响应，从而避免等待期间浪费资源。然而，目前缺乏衡量此类监控任务表现的基准。

Method: 作者构建了SentinelBench，一个开源的、面向时间演化监控任务的基准。它包含10个合成Web环境（邮件、日历、金融、职业社交、娱乐等），共100个任务。每个环境暴露一个实时Web界面并回放脚本化事件序列，要求智能体在页面状态动态变化的情况下进行导航和推理。基准测量三个维度：任务完成度、反应时间和资源使用。

Result: 在三种模型和两种浏览器智能体框架上报告了基线结果，展示了智能体设计选择如何显著影响关键指标。SentinelBench能够有效区分不同智能体行为之间的有意义的差异。

Conclusion: SentinelBench为长时间运行监控任务提供了标准化的评估平台，揭示了响应性与成本之间的根本权衡，并为未来研究和不同智能体架构的比较建立了性能基线。

Abstract: AI agents are increasingly asked to carry out work that spans minutes, hours, or longer. Yet the default model of agent behavior is continuous action: issuing tool calls, refreshing pages, searching for alternatives, or otherwise trying to force progress. This is the wrong approach for many long-running tasks, which are better served by a strategy of sustained attention. Instead, agents should monitor an environment, notice when an external event makes progress possible, then respond promptly without wasting resources while waiting. To measure progress on this class of tasks, we introduce SentinelBench, an open-source benchmark for time-evolving monitoring tasks.
  SentinelBench contains 100 tasks across 10 synthetic web environments, including email, calendars, finance, professional networking, and entertainment. Each environment exposes a live web interface and replays a scripted sequence of events, requiring agents to navigate and reason about web pages whose state shifts underfoot. SentinelBench measures task completion, reaction time, and resource use, exposing the tradeoff between responsiveness and cost. We report results across three models and two browser-agent harnesses, establishing performance baselines for future comparison and demonstrating how agent design choices can dramatically impact key metrics. Together, these results show that SentinelBench distinguishes meaningful differences in agent behavior.

</details>


### [364] [An interpretable and trustworthy AI framework for large-scale longitudinal structure-pain association studies using data from the Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05357)
*Jincheng Yu,Haoyang Li,Yiwen Liu,Shen Liu,Rachel Yuanbao Chen,C. Kent Kwoh,Hongxu Ding,Xiaoxiao Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文开发了一个可解释且可信的AI框架，将深度学习MOAKS评分预测与纵向潜类别混合模型相结合，在大规模OAI数据上揭示了骨髓病变、软骨丢失和半月板挤压三种结构异常与膝关节疼痛进展的关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于人工判读的MOAKS评分耗时费力，难以大规模开展；同时，深度学习模型缺乏不确定性量化，预测结果的可靠性无法保证。本文旨在通过引入保形预测实现可信的自动化MOAKS评分，并利用高质量预测结果扩展样本量，从而可靠地研究骨关节炎结构异常与疼痛之间的关系。

Method: 首先，开发深度学习模型从膝关节MRI直接预测MOAKS特征，并嵌入保形预测（conformal prediction）对预测结果进行不确定性量化，仅保留高置信度预测。其次，利用高置信度MOAKS预测结果将样本扩展至2175例膝关节，应用纵向潜类别混合模型（LCMM）分析BML、软骨丢失、半月板挤压三种结构异常与四种互补膝关节疼痛指标的纵向关联。

Result: 不确定性过滤策略显著提升了预测性能：BML的MCC从0.69提升至0.91，软骨丢失从0.45提升至0.80，半月板挤压从0.59提升至0.89。LCMM识别出两条不同的疼痛轨迹（快速进展组和稳定进展组）。快速进展组的比值比（95%CI）分别为：BML 1.62(1.12-2.35)，软骨丢失1.83(1.24-2.70)，半月板挤压2.50(1.75-3.57)。

Conclusion: 骨髓病变、软骨丢失和半月板挤压是骨关节炎疼痛及功能进展的重要危险因素，其中半月板挤压的风险最大。该可解释且可信的AI框架为大规模骨关节炎影像-临床关联研究提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Purpose: To develop an interpretable and trustworthy AI framework that combines deep learning based MRI Osteoarthritis Knee Score (MOAKS) prediction with interpretable statistical modeling to study structure-pain relationships at scale using data from the Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI). Materials and Methods: We first developed a deep learning framework to predict MOAKS features directly from knee MRIs and incorporated conformal prediction to provide prediction uncertainty quantification. This uncertainty-aware strategy enables explicit filtering of model outputs, retaining only high-confidence MOAKS predictions at the knee level. Second, we applied a longitudinal latent class mixed model (LCMM) to examine associations between key structural abnormalities and four complementary knee pain measurements. Results: Among the three MRI-defined abnormalities (i.e., bone marrow lesions (BML), cartilage loss (CART), and meniscal extrusion (ME)), our framework substantially improved the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) and some other metrics. For example, MCC increased from 0.69 to 0.91 for BML, from 0.45 to 0.80 for CART, and from 0.59 to 0.89 for ME. Using these high-confidence predictions, we expanded the sample size to 2,175 knees for the LCMM analysis. Two distinct pain trajectories were identified (rapid and stable pain progression). The estimated odds ratios (95% CI) for the rapid progression group were 1.62 (1.12-2.35) for BML, 1.83 (1.24-2.70) for CART loss, and 2.50 (1.75-3.57) for ME. Conclusion: These results highlight the importance of these structural abnormalities as risk factors for pain and functional progression in osteoarthritis.

</details>


### [365] [Synthetic Contrastive Reasoning for Multi-Table Q&A](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05382)
*Ankit Pratap Singh,Xin Su,Phillip Howard*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文针对多表问答(MMQA)缺乏推理监督信号的问题,构建了合成对比推理轨迹数据集,并利用对比偏好优化(CPO)微调开源LLM,在多个模型上取得了9.7%-16.3%的显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多表问答数据集通常只提供问题与最终答案,缺乏解释答案推导过程的推理监督信号,导致模型难以学习跨表检索、模式链接和组合推理能力。

Method: 首先,利用异构LLM生成经过验证的正确推理轨迹(正例)和看似合理但存在错误的推理轨迹(负例),构建偏好对数据集。然后,采用对比偏好优化(CPO)方法,基于这些偏好对微调开源权重LLM,强化模型对正确推理路径的偏好学习。

Result: 在Qwen3-14B、Mistral-8B和Llama-3.1-8B三个模型上,CPO相比传统Q&A监督微调平均绝对提升9.7%-16.3%,在MMQA基准上最高提升21个百分点。消融实验表明,异构的正负轨迹生成器增强了对比信号的强度。自动评估与人工评估均显示生成的偏好对具有较高的忠实度、连贯性和有意义的对比性。

Conclusion: 合成对比推理轨迹结合CPO训练范式,能有效弥补多表问答中推理监督缺失的短板,显著提升模型的跨表推理能力。

Abstract: Multi-table question answering requires models to retrieve relevant evidence, link schemas, and perform compositional reasoning across relational tables. Existing multi-table Q&A resources typically provide questions and final answers but lack reasoning supervision that explains how answers are derived. To address this gap, we construct a synthetic contrastive reasoning-trace dataset for MMQA by generating validated positive traces and plausible negative traces with heterogeneous LLMs. We then use the resulting preference pairs to fine-tune open-weight LLMs with Contrastive Preference Optimization (CPO). Across Qwen3-14B, Mistral-8B, and Llama-3.1-8B, CPO achieves absolute average improvements over Q&A supervised fine-tuning ranging from 9.7%-16.3%, with gains up to 21 percentage points on MMQA. Ablations show that heterogeneous positive and negative trace generators strengthen the contrastive signal, and automated as well as human evaluations indicate that the generated pairs are largely faithful, coherent, and meaningfully contrastive.

</details>


### [366] [Stability vs. Manipulability: Evaluating Robustness Under Post-Decision Interaction in LLM Judges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05384)
*Srimonti Dutta,Akshata Kishore Moharir*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了LLM-as-judge评估范式的一个关键漏洞：即法官模型在做出初步判断后，其裁决可通过有针对性的后续对话被显著逆转。即使法官表现出高置信度，评判结果仍不稳定，这会影响基准排名并与人类偏好产生偏差。作者提出了评估稳健性分数（ERS）来量化这种互动下的脆弱性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM-as-judge评估流程普遍假设评判结果是输入固定的稳定属性，忽略了后置互动可能带来的操纵风险。作者旨在揭示并量化这种"裁决后操纵"现象，指出仅依赖静态一致性指标不足以保障评估的可靠性。

Method: 作者在MT-Bench和AlpacaEval两个基准上设计了受控实验。核心实验包括：(1) 重复中性再评估，测试稳定性基线；(2) 反基线挑战协议（anti-baseline challenge protocol），通过动机性互动测试裁决反转程度；(3) 平衡目标验证协议（counterbalanced target-validation protocol），将纯粹的可逆性与有偏的方向性引导分离开来。进一步分析了权威框架（authority framing）对稳定性的影响、反转裁决的理由重叠度，并提出评估稳健性分数（ERS）将反转敏感性与方向效应相结合，量化互动稳健性。

Result: LLM法官在重复中性再评估下高度稳定，但在针对性挑战下表现出显著的可逆性。裁决反转会降低与人类偏好的对齐度、改变基准排名，并产生有害评估变化，尽管法官自报置信度很高。权威框架尤其具有破坏性，反转后的理由与原裁决重叠度低，暗示事后合理化而非真正的错误纠正。

Conclusion: 裁决后互动构成了LLM-as-judge评估的一个独特失效模式。评估协议不应仅测量静态一致性，还需衡量挑战下的稳健性。ERS为量化这一互动稳健性提供了实用工具。

Abstract: LLM-as-judge evaluation is widely used in benchmarking pipelines, where model outputs are compared and ranked using automated evaluators. These pipelines typically assume that judgments are stable properties of fixed inputs. We show that this assumption does not hold under interaction. We study post-decision manipulability: the extent to which an evaluation outcome can be altered through subsequent conversation with the judge after an initial decision has been made. Across controlled experiments on MT-Bench and AlpacaEval, we find that LLM judges are highly stable under repeated and neutral reevaluation, yet become substantially reversible under targeted post-decision challenge. An anti-baseline challenge protocol shows that stable judgments can be overturned through motivated interaction, while a counterbalanced target-validation protocol separates this reversibility from net target-directed steering. These reversals have practical consequences: they can degrade agreement with human preferences, shift benchmark rankings, and produce harmful evaluation changes despite high self-reported confidence. Authority framing is especially destabilizing, and revised judgments are often accompanied by low-overlap justifications, suggesting post hoc rationalization rather than reliable error correction. We introduce the Evaluation Robustness Score (ERS) to quantify interactional robustness by combining reversal susceptibility with counterbalanced directional effects. Our findings identify post-decision interaction as a distinct failure mode for LLM-as-judge evaluation and motivate evaluation protocols that measure not only static agreement, but robustness under challenge.

</details>


### [367] [Residual Modeling for High-Fidelity Learned Compression of Scientific Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05389)
*Liangji Zhu,Sanjay Ranka,Anand Rangarajan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对科学模拟中高保真压缩场景（NRMSE 10^-6 ~ 10^-4），现有GAE方法的残差修正流主导码率。本文提出残差中心视角，设计两种残差编码器LBRC（无训练自适应量化+无损编码管线）和NGLR（加入因果神经预测器进一步降低熵），在多个数据集上显著优于GAE和SZ。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有损压缩对大规模科学模拟数据至关重要。现有学习型压缩器虽能实现高压缩比，但无法保证逐块精度。GAE方法通过保留SVD/PCA系数做逐块残差修正，在中低精度下有效，但在高保真场景（块级NRMSE从10^-6到10^-4）下，所需保留系数急剧增长，残差修正流主导总码率，使得学习压缩优势丧失。

Method: 提出残差中心视角：学习残差与原始科学场结构不同，需专门设计的残差表示。设计两种残差编码器：(1) LBRC——确定性、无需训练的管线，自适应量化学习残差至目标NRMSE，通过3D Lorenzo差分、zigzag映射、位平面编码和熵编码对整数量化残差进行无损编码；(2) NGLR——在LBRC的确定性整数管线基础上，加入因果神经预测器，为整数舍入的Lorenzo预测输出归一化偏置，降低剩余残差码的熵，同时保持确定性解码，预测器权值序列化计入比特流。

Result: 在E3SM、JHTDB和ERA5数据集上，块级NRMSE目标10^-6至10^-4范围内：(1) LBRC相较GAE压缩比提升30-60%，与SZ大体相当；(2) NGLR在LBRC基础上再提升10-40%，在所评估的高保真场景下超越SZ。

Conclusion: 针对学习压缩器残差量身定制的残差表示方法，能够在全局残差修正成为码率主导因素时，保持学习压缩的优势。

Abstract: Lossy compression is essential for massive spatiotemporal data from scientific simulations. Learned compressors can achieve high compression ratios at moderate accuracy targets, but their aggregate reconstruction losses do not guarantee accuracy for each block. Existing Guaranteed Autoencoder (GAE) methods add a per-block residual correction by retaining SVD/PCA-style coefficients until the target is met. This works at moderate tolerances, but in the high-fidelity regime with block-level NRMSE from 10^-6 to 10^-4, the number of retained coefficients grows quickly and the correction stream dominates the total rate.
  We propose a residual-centric view: the learned residual is structurally different from the original scientific field and should be coded with a representation designed for that residual. We introduce two residual coders. LBRC is a deterministic, training-free pipeline that adaptively quantizes the learned residual to the target NRMSE and losslessly encodes the resulting integer residual using 3D Lorenzo differencing, zigzag mapping, bit-plane coding, and entropy coding. NGLR adds a causal neural predictor that outputs a normalized bias for an integer-rounded Lorenzo prediction in the same deterministic integer pipeline, reducing the entropy of the remaining residual code while preserving deterministic decoding. The predictor weights are serialized and counted in the bitstream.
  Across E3SM, JHTDB, and ERA5 at block-level NRMSE targets from 10^-6 to 10^-4, LBRC improves compression ratio over GAE by 30-60% and is broadly competitive with SZ. NGLR adds a further 10-40% over LBRC and outperforms SZ in the evaluated high-fidelity regime. These results show that residual representations tailored to learned-compressor residuals can preserve the advantage of learned compression when global residual correction becomes rate-dominant.

</details>


### [368] [LeanMarathon: Toward Reliable AI Co-Mathematicians through Long-Horizon Lean Autoformalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05400)
*Yuanhe Zhang,Yuekai Sun,Taiji Suzuki,Jason D. Lee,Fanghui Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LeanMarathon 是一个用于研究级数学 Lean 形式化的多智能体系统，通过进化蓝图（evolving blueprint）和两阶段编排器，将脆弱的长时间运行拆分为局部、可恢复的并行事务。在四项 Erdős 问题上，它成功形式化了全部 7 个目标定理，证明了 258 个引理和定理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视界自动形式化在规模上失败：语句漂移、依赖纠缠、上下文衰减、局部修复破坏远端工作。现有方法缺乏在漫长数学发展中保持目标保真度的持久化机制。

Method: 设计了一个名为 LeanMarathon 的多智能体框架：核心是「进化蓝图」（一个同时充当形式证明骨架、自然语言证明图和共享记录的 Lean 文件）；四个合约约束的智能体分别负责构建、审计、证明和修复该蓝图；两阶段编排器首先通过对抗性审查稳定目标保真度，然后从动态叶节点向上并行 CI 门控轮次地释放证明 DAG。

Result: 在两篇涵盖四项 Erdős 问题（#1051, #1196, #164, #1217）的最新研究论文上，三次自主运行成功形式化了全部七个目标定理（无 sorry），共证明 258 个引理和定理。

Conclusion: 可靠的 AI 协数学不仅需要更强的证明器，还需要在整个长数学发展中保持目标保真度的持久化框架。LeanMarathon 证明了这种架构的可行性。

Abstract: Long-horizon autoformalization of research mathematics fails not only at hard lemmas, but at scale: statements drift, dependencies tangle, context decays, and local repairs corrupt distant work. We present LeanMarathon, a multi-agent harness for reliable research-level Lean autoformalization. Its core abstraction is an evolving blueprint: a Lean file that serves simultaneously as formal proof skeleton, natural-language proof graph, and shared system of record. Four contract-scoped agents construct, audit, prove, and repair this blueprint. These agents are coordinated by a two-stage orchestrator that first stabilizes target fidelity through adversarial review and then discharges the proof directed acyclic graph (DAG) from its dynamic leaves upward in parallel CI-gated rounds. LeanMarathon turns one brittle multi-hour run into many local, recoverable, parallel transactions. We evaluate LeanMarathon on two recent research papers spanning four Erdős problems (#1051, #1196, #164, #1217). Across three autonomous runs, it formalizes all seven target theorems with no sorry, proving 258 lemmas and theorems. These results show that reliable AI co-mathematics requires not only stronger provers, but durable harnesses that preserve target fidelity across long mathematical developments. The code can be found at https://github.com/YuanheZ/LeanMarathon.

</details>


### [369] [Harnessing Generalist Agents for Contextualized Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05404)
*Zihao Li,Kaifeng Jin,Yuanchen Bei,Jiaru Zou,Avaneesh Kumar,Xuying Ning,Yanjun Zhao,Mengting Ai,Baoyu Jing,Hanghang Tong,Jingrui He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TimeClaw 是一个面向时间序列的智能体框架，通过集成可执行时序工具、经验驱动的能力演化和多模态情景记忆，使通用大语言模型能够在丰富的上下文环境中进行开放的时序推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列常嵌入丰富的上下文信息中，且实际应用需要端到端分析流程而非仅做预测。然而，当前通用 AI 智能体主要运作于文本空间，与结构化时序信号存在对齐鸿沟，难以胜任需要上下文感知的时序推理任务。

Method: 提出 TimeClaw 框架，包含三大核心组件：(1) 可执行时序工具（executable temporal tools），用于可追溯、可审计的分析；(2) 经验驱动的能力演化（experience-driven capability evolution），用于创建可复用的分析例程；(3) 情景化多模态记忆（episodic multimodal memory），用于检索相关推理轨迹。三者协同工作，将通用 LLM 智能体与时间序列原生运行时支持相结合。

Result: 在覆盖能源、金融、天气、交通等多个真实领域和多样化任务的基准测试上进行了广泛评估，TimeClaw 展现出显著的性能提升。

Conclusion: TimeClaw 成功弥合了通用 LLM 智能体与结构化时序数据之间的鸿沟，为上下文化的开放时序推理提供了有效解决方案，并在多领域多任务上验证了其有效性。

Abstract: Time series are often embedded in rich contexts that are essential for holistic modeling. Moreover, real-world practitioners often require end-to-end workflows for analyzing temporal dynamics, where widely studied tasks such as forecasting are only one step in a broader solution loop. While generalist AI agents offer a promising interface for such workflows under complex contexts, they still operate primarily in textual spaces that are not fully aligned with structured temporal signals. In this work, we introduce TimeClaw, an agentic harness framework for time series that equips generalist LLM agents with the time series-native runtime support needed for contextualized temporal reasoning. TimeClaw integrates executable temporal tools for grounded and auditable analysis, experience-driven capability evolution for creating reusable analytical routines, and episodic multimodal memory for retrieving relevant reasoning traces. Together, these components unlock harnessed open-ended temporal reasoning with contextual information. Extensive evaluation on multiple benchmarks covering diverse tasks across energy, finance, weather, traffic, and other real-world domains demonstrates improved performance of TimeClaw. Code is available at https://github.com/iDEA-iSAIL-Lab-UIUC/TimeClaw.

</details>


### [370] [Agents' Last Exam](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05405)
*Yiyou Sun,Xinyang Han,Weichen Zhang,Yuanbo Pang,Tianyu Wang,Yuhan Cao,Yixiao Huang,Chris Duroiu,Haoyun Zhang,Jeffrey Lin,Weishu Zhang,Tyler Zeng,Ying Yan,Bo Liu,Hanson Wen,Mingyang Xu,Xiaoyuan Spanos,Lichao Sun,Chenguang Wang,Orson Xu,Zhen Dong,Hector Gomez,Aylin Caliskan,Ali Emami,Haimin Hu,Zhi Li,Lihui Liu,Murphy Niu,Yi Shao,Jianxin Sun,Mikko Tolonen,Ting Wang,Sanjiv Das,Yanjun Gao,Wenbo Guo,Erika J Schneider,Zhiyong Lu,Mark Mueller,Radha Poovendran,Somayeh Sojoudi,Dawn Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: A new benchmark called Agents' Last Exam (ALE) is introduced to evaluate AI agents on long-horizon, real-world, economically valuable tasks. Developed with 250+ industry experts, it covers 1K+ tasks across 13 industry clusters, and current models achieve only a 2.6% average full pass rate on the hardest tier.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI systems excel on existing benchmarks, but these gains have not translated into economically meaningful real-world deployment. The core problem is an evaluation gap: current benchmarks fail to measure sustained performance on authentic, economically valuable workflows, creating a disconnect between benchmark success and GDP-relevant impact.

Method: ALE is constructed in collaboration with 250+ industry experts, organized around a task taxonomy with 55 subfields grouped into 13 industry clusters (aligned with O*NET/SOC 2018, the U.S. federal occupational taxonomy). It focuses on non-physical industries and features verifiable outcomes. ALE is designed as a living benchmark with a continuously growing task pool as new industries onboard.

Result: Across mainstream harness and backbone configurations, the average full pass rate on the hardest tier of ALE is only 2.6%, indicating that the benchmark remains far from saturated.

Conclusion: ALE is intended not merely as another leaderboard, but as an instrument to close the gap between benchmark success and economically meaningful impact. The very low pass rate demonstrates that current AI systems are far from capable of autonomously handling complex, real-world professional workflows.

Abstract: Recent AI systems have achieved strong results on a wide range of benchmarks, yet these gains have not translated into economically meaningful deployment across many professional domains. We argue that this gap is largely an evaluation problem: widely used benchmarks lack sustained performance measurement on real and economically valuable workflows. This paper introduces Agents' Last Exam (ALE), a benchmark designed to evaluate AI agents on long-horizon, economically valuable, real-world tasks with verifiable outcomes. Developed in collaboration with 250+ industry experts, ALE covers non-physical industries defined with reference to O*NET / SOC 2018 (the U.S. federal occupational taxonomy). It is organized around a task taxonomy with 55 subfields grouped into 13 industry clusters covering 1K+ tasks. Current results show that the hardest tier remains far from saturated: across mainstream harness and backbone configurations, the average full pass rate is 2.6%. ALE is designed as a living benchmark: its task pool grows continuously as new workflows and industries are onboarded. More broadly, ALE is intended not merely as another leaderboard, but as an instrument for closing the gap between benchmark success and GDP-relevant impact.

</details>


### [371] [Mutation Without Variation: Convergence Dynamics in LLM-Driven Program Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05408)
*Can Gurkan,Forrest Stonedahl,Uri Wilensky*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究LLM驱动的程序变异链在无选择压力下的收敛行为，发现存在严重的结构性趋同现象，87%的链中93%以上的变异会重复访问已知的结构形式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究LLM在反复变异程序时是探索新形式还是循环回到已知形式，揭示LLM驱动的程序演化中可能存在的系统性偏差。

Method: 在领域特定语言（DSL）中构建LLM驱动的变异链，去除选择压力，系统变化prompt设计、模型家族和随机复制条件；引入循环分析（cycle analysis）检测状态转移结构，并与经典遗传规划子树变异算子进行对比。

Result: LLM变异链一致收敛到受限的吸引子区域；结构层面趋同尤为严重，87%的链中超过93%的变异回到已见结构形式，变异主要集中在重复模板内的终端替换；转移结构以短循环和自循环为主；该现象在不同prompt和模型间均稳健存在，而经典GP子树变异未出现类似收敛。

Conclusion: LLM实现语义感知程序变换的能力与其引入系统性结构同质化偏差是同一枚硬币的两面。若要以LLM驱动开放式程序探索，必须正视并解决这一结构趋同问题。

Abstract: When an LLM repeatedly mutates a program, does it explore new forms or circle back to the same ones? We study this question by analyzing LLM-driven mutation chains in the absence of selection pressure within a domain-specific language, varying prompt design, model family, and stochastic replication. We find that LLM-based mutation consistently converges toward restricted attractor regions in program space. Convergence is especially severe at the structural level: in 87% of chains, over 93% of mutations revisit a previously seen structural form, with most variation confined to terminal substitutions within recurring templates. Cycle analysis reveals short cycles and self-loops dominating the transition structure. The rate of convergence varies with prompt wording and model choice, but the phenomenon is robust across conditions. A classical GP subtree mutation operator does not exhibit comparable convergence, suggesting that the effect is intrinsic to the LLM mutation pipeline. These findings reveal a tension at the heart of LLM-driven program evolution: the same capabilities that enable semantics-aware program transformation also carry a systematic bias toward structural homogeneity that must be accounted for if such systems are to sustain open-ended exploration. Source code is available at https://github.com/can-gurkan/lmca.

</details>


### [372] [A Motivational Architecture for Conversational AGI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05411)
*Anna Mikeda,Ben Goertzel*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出将OpenPsi动机架构重新诠释为对话原生形式，结合MetaMo高层动机支架，为基于模块化执行基底的对话智能体构建动机处理管线。核心是将内稳态从身体需求重铸为对话领域的能力、不确定性消减、亲和力等七种调节维度，并贡献了十阶段动机处理管线、双重决策策略以及前行动感受与后行动情绪的功能性区分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有认知AI的动机架构主要面向具身智能体（调节身体需求），而对话智能体运行在完全不同的机制中——其感知-动作循环是语言性的，环境是用户动态变化的心理状态，行动是言语行为、工具调用和策略性沉默。因此需要为对话智能体重新设计动机架构。

Method: （1）将OpenPsi动机谱系进行对话化重铸，定义七种对话原生调节维度：能力(competence)、不确定性消减(uncertainty reduction)、归属(affiliation)、亲和力(affinity)、合法性(legitimacy)、滋养(nurturing)和审美连贯性(aesthetic coherence)。（2）提出十阶段动机处理管线，在架构层面分离认知调制与情境评估。（3）设计双重决策策略：结合紧迫性驱动的快速响应与审慎的多目标优化。（4）引入前行动感受(pre-action feelings)与后行动情绪(post-action emotions)的功能性区分。将该框架特化到CompanionAgent和ResearchAgent两个实例中，并概述其向社会机器人和通用AGI的扩展。

Result: 提出了一个完整的对话智能体动机架构框架，包括十阶段动机处理管线和双重决策策略。成功将框架特化到CompanionAgent和ResearchAgent两个具体智能体实例中，验证了架构的可行性和灵活性。初步勾勒了向社会机器人和领域通用的人类水平AGI的扩展路径。

Conclusion: 对话智能体需要不同于具身智能体的动机架构，将内稳态重铸为对话原生调节维度是可行的方向。该框架通过模块化设计、十阶段管线、双重决策策略以及感受与情绪的功能性区分，为构建具有内在动机的对话AI提供了系统性的架构蓝图，具有向更广泛AGI场景扩展的潜力。

Abstract: Motivational architectures in cognitive AI have largely been designed for physical agents regulating bodily needs. Conversational agents operate in a different regime: their sensorimotor loop is linguistic, their environment is a user's evolving mental state, and their consequential actions are speech acts, tool invocations, and strategic silences. This paper proposes a conversational reinterpretation of the OpenPsi motivational lineage, coupled to MetaMo's higher-level motivational scaffold, for agents built on a modular execution substrate. Homeostasis is recast in dialogue-native terms: the agent regulates competence, uncertainty reduction, affiliation, affinity, legitimacy, nurturing, and aesthetic coherence rather than bodily deficits.
